jobs.title: AI/ML Data Knowledge Graph Engineer
jobs.description: Sapience AI is the collective intelligence platform for professional communities. We sit above the CRMs, AMS platforms, and knowledge bases that organizations already run, and we turn the expertise scattered across them into something every member can search, act on, and share. The intelligence a community needs is already inside it. Most organizations just cannot reach it. Knowledge lives in silos, in legacy systems, in the heads of a few experts, and in fragmented records no one can connect. We change that. Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose\-driven for the organization it serves. **Let's achieve more, together.** **Where this role sits** ======================== This role builds the structured knowledge that collective intelligence reasons over. You own the KO (knowledge object) graph: the layer that turns a community's scattered expertise into connected, queryable knowledge the COGENT architecture can use. You work where messy real\-world data becomes trustworthy structure: ingesting, resolving, connecting, and modeling knowledge so reasoning has something solid to stand on. You partner closely with neuro\-symbolic AI and applied AI, and you are the reason the platform can answer questions that span a community's knowledge instead of isolated documents. **Why this role exists** ======================== Language models are fluent, but fluency is not knowledge. To reason over a community's expertise with rigor, the platform needs that expertise structured, connected, and trustworthy, not just retrieved as text. Building a knowledge graph from real, fragmented sources is hard: entities to resolve, relationships to infer, quality to enforce, and provenance to preserve. The graph is only as good as the engineering behind it. The AI/ML Data and KO Graph Engineer builds that foundation. You turn scattered knowledge into a graph the COGENT architecture can reason over, so members get answers grounded in their community's real expertise. **What you will own (Areas of Responsibility)** =============================================== You hold seven areas of responsibility across the knowledge layer. Each one is yours to set direction on, build, and measure. **1\. Knowledge graph engineering** ----------------------------------- * Build and maintain the KO graph that structures a community's knowledge for reasoning. * Design schemas, ontologies, and relationships that reflect how expertise actually connects. * Make the graph queryable, performant, and reliable at scale. **2\. Ingestion and knowledge extraction** ------------------------------------------ * Build pipelines that extract knowledge from documents, systems, and community sources into the graph. * Turn unstructured and semi\-structured content into structured knowledge objects. * Keep the graph current as a community's knowledge changes. **3\. Entity resolution and quality** ------------------------------------- * Resolve entities, deduplicate, and connect knowledge across fragmented sources. * Enforce quality so members can trust what the graph tells them. * Detect and handle conflicts and gaps in the knowledge. **4\. Provenance and trust** ---------------------------- * Preserve provenance so every piece of knowledge can be traced to its source. * Build the structure that lets the platform show its work and earn member trust. * Protect sensitive community knowledge with correct access and governance. **5\. Serving knowledge to COGENT** ----------------------------------- * Partner with neuro\-symbolic and applied AI to serve the graph into reasoning and retrieval. * Shape the graph so it supports both symbolic reasoning and neural retrieval. * Make knowledge access fast enough for production answers. **6\. Data pipelines and platform** ----------------------------------- * Build the data pipelines and platform the knowledge layer depends on. * Instrument the pipelines so quality and freshness can be measured. * Turn recurring ingestion needs into reusable connectors. **7\. Evaluation of knowledge quality** --------------------------------------- * Measure the quality, coverage, and freshness of the graph against what communities need. * Build the evaluation that tells whether the knowledge layer is improving. * Use evidence to steer where to invest next. **AI\-augmented ways of working** ================================= You use AI to build the knowledge layer, from extraction and entity resolution to schema suggestions, while you own the correctness, structure, and trustworthiness of the graph. The standard is human in partnership: AI accelerates the work, you own the judgment, the interpretation, and the call. The people who create the most value here are not the ones producing the most output. They are the ones turning evidence into clear, durable decisions. **What this role is n l well. * **Reusable ingestion.** New sources come online faster because ingestion is reusable. * **Measured quality.** Coverage, quality, and freshness are measured and improving. **Who you are** =============== **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * Five or more years in data engineering, knowledge graph engineering, or a related field. * Hands\-on experience building and operating knowledge graphs or graph databases. * Strong data pipeline engineering, including ingestion and transformation. * Experience with entity resolution, deduplication, and data quality. * Solid grounding in knowledge representation, ontologies, or schema design. * Strong Python and SQL, plus graph query languages. * Care for provenance, trust, and protection of sensitive data. ***Preferred qualifications*** ------------------------------ * Experience serving graphs into retrieval or reasoning systems. * Familiarity with neuro\-symbolic AI and how structure supports reasoning. * Experience with embeddings, vector search, and hybrid retrieval. * Experience integrating CRM, AMS, or knowledge\-base sources. * Domain understanding of knowledge\-intensive or professional communities. **How you work** ---------------- * You name the real problem in the data before reaching for a structure. * You care about quality, provenance, and trust as much as coverage. * You build pipelines others can run and extend. * You measure the knowledge layer honestly. * You share reusable connectors and patterns. **Skills \& Competencies** ========================== * Knowledge graph and ontology engineering. * Ingestion, extraction, and transformation pipelines. * Entity resolution, deduplication, and data quality. * Provenance, governance, and protection of sensitive knowledge. * Serving graphs into retrieval and reasoning. * Evaluation of knowledge quality and coverage. * Turning recurring ingestion into reusable capability. **Services \& Tools Experience** ================================ * Graph databases (for example Neo4j\-class systems) and graph query languages (Cypher, SPARQL, or GQL). * Data pipeline and orchestration tools. * Entity resolution and data\-quality tooling. * Vector databases and embedding models for hybrid retrieval. * Python and SQL as primary languages. * Cloud data platforms and storage. * Building and serving the KO graph into the COGENT architecture and MINERVA. **Prior Experience \& Background** ================================== * Prior data or knowledge graph engineering at a software or AI company. * Experience building knowledge structures from messy, real\-world sources. * A track record of production data systems with quality and provenance. * Experience supporting reasoning or retrieval systems is a plus. **Cross\-functional partners** ============================== You work most closely with Neuro\-Symbolic AI, Applied AI, Data Engineering, and Platform Engineering. You build the KO graph that the COGENT architecture reasons over inside MINERVA. **How we hire** =============== We review every application, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not match every line above. Research shows that talented people, especially those from underrepresented communities, often hold back when they do not meet every qualification. If that is the only thing holding you back, apply anyway. Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a workplace where everyone, regardless of background, has a voice in building what comes next. **Compensation** ================ Base Salary: $204,000 \- $216,000 \+ early stage equity Generous health and wellness benefits *Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation to complete our application process, let your recruiter know.*

jobs.title: AWS Senior AI Agent Engineer
jobs.description: Job Type: 12 – month contract (potential to extend or convert to full\-time) Location: Charlotte, NC. Hybrid. Job Description: An AWS Senior AI Agent Engineer is responsible for designing and implementing highly complex agentic/prompt engineering solutions. Individuals with this role are required to: * Design and implement agentic AI solutions using AWS Bedrock, including Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Guardrails * Build serverless architectures using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and EventBridge to orchestrate AI agent workflows * Design and engineer sophisticated prompts for agentic AI systems that can plan, reason, and execute multi\-step workflows * Develop prompt architectures that enable AI agents to use tools, APIs, and external resources effectively * Create and refine chain\-of\-thought, tree\-of\-thought, and ReAct (Reasoning \+ Acting) prompting strategies * Build evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, reliability, and safety * Collaborate with ML and software engineers to integrate prompt strategies with agent frameworks (LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore) and leveraging Bedrock agents/services/foundational models. * Optimize prompts for accuracy, efficiency, cost, and latency in production environments * Implement guardrails and safety measures to ensure responsible agent behavior * Document prompt patterns, best practices, and design principles for the broader team * Stay current with the latest research in agentic AI, prompt engineering, and LLM capabilities * Design and build highly complex software solutions (specifically 2\+ years of experience with AWS serverless development and 4\+ years of experience on a programing language such as Java or Python) * Program well\-designed, efficient code independently. * Collaborate with designers, developers, and product owners to build solutions. * Clearly communicate team wide progress and identify blocking processes/patterns that hold a team back. * Participate in paired programming and code reviews with juniors to expand the team’s collective knowledge and understanding of software engineering. * Complete independent research to refine best practices and present work to peers. * Turn complex ideas into manageable pieces of work to complete as part of a product team. * Coach and mentor prompt engineers. * Provide technical guidance to leadership so that solutions are built with innovation and sustainability in mind. * Learn the business drivers of a product and help drive the technical direction of a product to fulfill the desired vision. Qualifications * 3\+ years of experience in prompt engineering, AI/ML, or related fields * Deep understanding of large language models (e.g. Claude) and their capabilities * Proven experience designing prompts for autonomous agents and multi\-step reasoning tasks * Strong knowledge of agentic frameworks and patterns (ReAct, Plan\-and\-Execute, Reflection, etc.) * Strong experience with AWS Bedrock (Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, and foundational models) * Proficiency with AWS serverless services: Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3 * Knowledge of AWS security best practices including IAM, KMS, and VPC configurations * Familiar with Terraform and HCP * Proficiency in Python and experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g LangChain) * Experience with API integration and tool\-use patterns for AI agents * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * A breadth of experience building software solutions (through a strong mix of independent research/projects and industry expertise). * 5\-9 years’ previous experience in software development. (Either 9 years of experience specifically in software development or seven years of experience in software development in combination with 2 years alternative experience in a related field). Ideally has a portfolio of work – code samples, etc. * Deep and solid understanding of APIs. Have been involved in designing/building/implementing/consuming APIs. * Familiarity with several frameworks. Resulting code is concise and easy\-to\-follow. * Experience with automation and optimization. Looks for ways to create repeatable patterns that increase the efficiency of the team. * Experience and ability to manage and optimize databases. * Understanding of functional programming and how to apply functional concepts in any language. Quick to picking up a new language or adopting a more recent version of a language. * Familiarity and able to comfortably work with multiple platforms. * Experience turning complex ideas into user stories. From that, can turn user stories into workable solutions, providing estimates to complete that work, and breaking down complex work into smaller components. * Previous experience collaborating on a cross\-functional team. * Deep understanding of development cycle. * Ability to debug and avoid future problems by building more robust solutions. * Ability to look at previous personal or team experience and use this to analyze mistakes/successes, draw conclusions, and design future solutions. Resulting solutions have few bugs and quick remediation times. * Experience building solutions with the larger team in mind. Solutions have the goal of improving software engineering at the team level. * Experience with teaching and mentoring team members at various levels. * A deep and solid understanding of cyber security principles such as authentication, authorization and encryption. * Experience working with one or more CI/CD stacks and associated best practices. Ability to setup CI/CD for new products with no guidance. Recommends and implements modifications to CI/CD processes when continuous improvement opportunities are identified. Pay: $95,977\.73 \- $115,586\.09 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Charlotte, NC 28216

jobs.title: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation
jobs.description: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation assignments. * Grade forward deployed engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Forward Deployed Engineer engineering review **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Clinical Product & Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered
jobs.description: Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered **Company:** M Systems **Location:** McKinney, Texas / Hybrid **Employment Type:** Full\-Time or Part\-Time, depending on candidate experience and availability **Industry:** Healthcare Information Technology / Electronic Health Records (EHR) About M Systems M Systems develops healthcare information technology solutions for small and medium\-sized hospitals, including rural hospitals, emergency hospitals, and other healthcare organizations. Our platform supports a broad range of hospital functions, including clinical documentation, patient care workflows, behavioral health, operating room workflows, billing, accounting, and other healthcare management capabilities. We are seeking a nursing professional who can serve as the **clinical voice of the product** and work closely with our software engineering, product, implementation, compliance, management, and customer teams. Position Summary M Systems is seeking a **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager** to provide clinical domain expertise for our healthcare software products. **Registered Nurse (RN) preferred; qualified nursing students will also be considered.** We welcome candidates who are actively pursuing an ADN, BSN, or equivalent nursing qualification and who have strong clinical knowledge, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and an interest in healthcare technology. The successful candidate will help ensure that M Systems' EHR and clinical applications accurately support real\-world hospital workflows and meet applicable healthcare regulatory, compliance, usability, and product\-quality expectations. The individual will serve as a bridge between: * Nurses and physicians * Hospital administrators * Customers * Product management * Software developers * Quality assurance teams * Implementation teams * Compliance and certification organizations This is an excellent opportunity for a nurse or nursing student interested in combining **clinical knowledge, healthcare technology, software product management, compliance, and clinical informatics**. Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Product Management Serve as an internal clinical subject\-matter resource for M Systems' EHR and healthcare applications. Review product functionality from the perspective of nurses, physicians, and other hospital users. Help engineering and product teams understand real\-world clinical workflows and identify gaps between software functionality and actual clinical practice. Provide clinical input for new product features and product improvements. Participate in product planning and prioritization discussions. Translate clinical needs into clear software requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria. Evaluate whether proposed product functionality is clinically practical, safe, and easy for hospital staff to use. Clinical Workflow Expertise Provide domain expertise for workflows such as: * Patient registration * Admission * Transfer * Discharge * Nursing assessment * Vital signs * Clinical documentation * Nursing notes * Physician notes * Medication workflows * Medication administration * Physician orders * Nursing orders * Allergies * Problem lists * Patient history * Care plans * Laboratory results * Diagnostic results * Clinical alerts * Behavioral health workflows * Operating room workflows * Emergency department workflows * Clinical handoffs * Patient discharge instructions * Follow\-up care * Patient\-safety workflows Work with customers and internal teams to understand variations in workflow between different hospitals and care environments. Product Testing \& Clinical Validation Develop and execute realistic clinical test scenarios for M Systems applications. Test software using patient\-care scenarios similar to those encountered in hospitals. Perform: * Functional testing * Clinical workflow testing * User acceptance testing * Regression testing * End\-to\-end workflow testing * Usability testing * Patient\-safety\-related testing * Release validation Create detailed clinical test cases and expected results. Document software defects, workflow issues, usability problems, and clinical concerns. Work directly with software engineers to reproduce problems. Verify fixes after engineering changes are completed. Participate in software release reviews and confirm that major clinical workflows have been appropriately tested before release. Develop regression test suites for critical clinical functions. Clinical Quality Assurance Help establish a structured clinical quality assurance process for M Systems products. Create repeatable testing procedures for clinical modules. Maintain traceability between: * Clinical requirements * Product requirements * Regulatory requirements * Software functionality * Test cases * Test results * Defects * Corrective actions Identify high\-risk clinical workflows that require additional testing. Help establish release\-readiness criteria for clinical functionality owledge or willingness to learn the following is desirable: * Electronic Health Records * Microsoft Office * Microsoft Excel * Software testing * Defect tracking * JIRA or similar tools * Clinical workflow documentation * HL7 * FHIR * USCDI * Healthcare interoperability * Healthcare terminology * Clinical coding concepts * Healthcare privacy and security Key Personal Attributes The ideal candidate should be: * Clinically knowledgeable * Detail\-oriented * Analytical * Organized * Patient\-safety focused * Comfortable using technology * Curious about how healthcare software works * Able to identify workflow problems * Comfortable communicating with software developers * Comfortable working with nurses and physicians * Able to communicate with hospital administrators * Willing to research healthcare regulations * Able to maintain detailed compliance documentation * Interested in healthcare technology and clinical informatics * Comfortable working in a growing organization The candidate should also be comfortable questioning workflows that do not make clinical sense and clearly explaining why a workflow should be changed. Initial Priorities During the initial phase of the role, the Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager will focus on: * Learning the complete M Systems clinical product suite. * Documenting major clinical workflows. * Creating standardized clinical test scenarios. * Performing end\-to\-end testing of key EHR workflows. * Identifying functional and clinical usability gaps. * Establishing a structured clinical QA process. * Building a compliance and certification requirements matrix. * Identifying certification\-readiness gaps. * Creating clinical product documentation. * Supporting customer workflow discussions and demonstrations. Key Performance Objectives Success in this role will include: * Establishing a structured clinical product testing process * Developing comprehensive clinical test scenarios * Improving product usability for clinicians * Identifying workflow issues before customers encounter them * Reducing clinical defects found after software releases * Maintaining clear product and clinical documentation * Establishing a compliance and certification roadmap * Improving traceability between requirements and testing * Providing clear clinical requirements to engineering * Improving communication between clinicians and engineering * Supporting successful hospital implementations * Improving clinical product demonstrations * Supporting certification\-readiness activities Career Growth This role can provide significant career growth for a nursing professional interested in healthcare technology. Possible career progression may include: **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager → Senior Clinical Product Manager → Director of Clinical Informatics / Clinical Product \& Compliance → Clinical Informatics Leadership** The position provides hands\-on exposure to healthcare software design, engineering, compliance, interoperability, customer implementation, and product strategy. Instead of only using an EHR system, you will have an opportunity to help **design, test, validate, improve, and shape the EHR itself**. You will work directly with software engineers, healthcare professionals, customers, and company leadership. Your clinical knowledge will influence how M Systems products are designed and how nurses, physicians, and other healthcare professionals interact with the system. For a nursing student interested in healthcare technology, clinical informatics, product management, or healthcare IT, this role can provide practical experience that is difficult to obtain through a traditional nursing position alone. Pay: Up to $40,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: Hybrid remote in McKinney, TX 75070

jobs.title: Cloud Planning Engineer
jobs.description: Sabanto is a venture\-backed, Illinois\-based technology company on a mission to drive autonomy into agriculture. We believe the agriculture industry's lack of labor will drive the adoption of Farming\-as\-a\-Service companies using autonomous equipment. It's this very spirit that drives us to build a robotic machinery platform, delivering a service that brings unprecedented efficiency, productivity, and cost to farmers. Join our fast\-growing, industrious, and passionate team of innovators as we continue to disrupt the multi\-billion\-dollar agriculture industry. As a Full Stack Engineer at Sabanto, you will be building the web and api platform that powers the orchestration of vehicle configuration, data pipeline processing and the interfaces that our customers use day\-to\-day when operating their vehicles. **RESPONSIBILITIES \& OUTCOMES** * Maintain and extend the cloud path planning engine — coverage paths, headland generation, turn optimization, and safe traversals — for autonomous agricultural robots operating in the field * Diagnose and resolve issues seen by customers related to field coverage in complex, real\-world field geometries (holes, waterways, irrigation systems) * Build and harden geospatial data pipelines that move field and equipment data through transformations, optimization, and output * Design, build, and operate Python\-based AWS Lambda services across the platform, from spec through deployment * Write tested, hardened, and safe code — unit tests, integration tests against real field data, and visual validation before every change ships * Own the build and deployment lifecycle for serverless cloud services **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's in computer science or a related field * Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem\-solving skills, with comfort reasoning about geometry and spatial data * An entrepreneurial attitude with a keen eye for detail * Organized, disciplined, and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously * Industrious – ideally can drive, or willing to learn to drive, tractors, and anything with four wheels * Ag\-gnostic – can walk up to a farmer, talk the talk, walk the walk, i.e. not intimidated **DESIRED EXPERIENCE** * Mastery of Python, including writing production\-grade, well\-tested services * Experience with geospatial and computational geometry libraries (Shapely, GeoPandas, PyProj, or similar) * 3\+ years building cloud\-native services on Amazon Web Services (AWS) — including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, and ECS * Experience working with Docker\-based software and build pipelines * Familiarity with optimization techniques or operations research (e.g. OR\-Tools, vehicle routing problems) a plus * Familiarity with robotics or vehicle kinematics (e.g. Dubins/Reeds\-Shepp paths, turning\-radius constraints) a plus * Familiarity with NodeJS/TypeScript and SQL/NoSQL database engines a plus, for cross\-team collaboration **BENEFITS** At Sabanto, every member of our team moves the needle. With a firm footing in our core company values, we've built a fast\-paced, demanding work culture that allows for the flexibility, autonomy, and career opportunities you'd expect from a growing company. We offer competitive benefits including: * Working on a concept that will forever disrupt the agriculture industry * The chance to make an immediate impact and do the best work of your life * Unlimited Vacation and flexible time * 401k, medical, dental **OUR CORE VALUES** * Own It \- Be self\-driven, entrepreneurial, and efficient * Raise the Bar \- Challenge complacency and mediocrity; be adaptable and agile; details matter * Be As One \- Trust, collaborate, and support; invest in co\-workers and customers * Embrace Curiosity \- Always be learning, be curious and share; be humbled but not embarrassed by mistakes * Do the Right Thing \- Act with integrity, even when no one is looking; be transparent * Empower Farmers \- Create solutions where customers, i.e. farmers, win At Sabanto, we value diversity of culture and background for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. Sabanto is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. This position is open to applicants who are legally authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor work visas at this time.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist (New York)
jobs.description: **About Draftwise** ------------------- Draftwise is a contract drafting, review, and negotiation AI powered by your legal knowledge. We turn a firm's guidance, precedent, and language into a legal ontology, ground our models in it, and run complex drafting, review, and search workflows directly within Microsoft Word and in the browser. We serve top law firms and legal departments globally, including over half the Vault 10, dozens of Am Law 100 firms, and Fortune 500 organizations. We are headquartered in NYC with offices in London and West Palm Beach, are Y Combinator alumni, and raised a $20M Series A from Index Ventures. **About this role** ------------------- We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to embed with leading law firms, discover where Draftwise can create transformational value, and turn that discovery into outcomes for customers and repeatable product capabilities. This is a forward\-deployed role. The center of gravity is product discovery in the field: learning how lawyers actually work, identifying the highest\-value problems, and understanding the documents, data, systems, and organizational constraints behind them. You will be accountable for driving transformational outcomes for the customer. Those outcomes must be demonstrable and measurable. You will move comfortably between conversations with managing partners and C\-level executives, working sessions with associates and knowledge teams, and technical discussions with customer IT and Draftwise engineers. You will distill what you learn into clear product requirements, scope them with Product, Engineering, and ML, track them through delivery, and validate the result with users. Every engagement should create leverage beyond a single customer. You will distinguish one\-off requests from recurring needs and help turn validated patterns into reusable product capabilities, evaluations, configurations, and playbooks. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Embed with customers, often onsite, to observe how partners, associates, knowledge professionals, innovation teams, and IT teams work, and uncover high\-value problems they may not yet be able to articulate. * Define the customer outcome before prescribing a solution, then map the workflows, decisions, documents, data, systems, organizational constraints, and incentives that shape where and how Draftwise can create the greatest value. * Work directly with customer documents, data, systems, and Draftwise tools to test feasibility and determine where AI can create transformational value. * Distill user and customer needs into clear product requirements; scope them with Product, Engineering, and ML; make trade\-offs; track the work; and drive it through delivery. * Build and configure prototypes, demos, data transformations, lightweight automations, and evaluations; put them in front of real users early and iterate from evidence. * Identify which needs are customer\-specific and which reveal repeatable patterns; help turn validated patterns into reusable platform capabilities, configurations, evaluations, and playbooks. * Present findings, requirements, trade\-offs, and outcomes credibly to managing partners, customer IT, frontline users, and Draftwise teams, using field evidence to shape what we build next. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in deployment strategy, forward\-deployed work, product discovery, solutions engineering or consulting, or another customer\-facing technical role where you owned outcomes in complex environments. * A track record of taking ambiguous, high\-stakes customer problems from discovery, to clear product requirements, to shipped solutions that produced material customer outcomes. * Strong analytical judgment and the instinct to get beneath stated requirements and understand the workflow, the data, the organizational dynamics, the real constraints, and where value is ultimately created. * Strong technical fluency and hands\-on experience with modern AI tools. You can query data, work with APIs and data models, stand up a prototype or automation, use AI coding tools as a force multiplier, and critically evaluate their outputs and limitations. * Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the range to work credibly with executives, lawyers, technical teams, and frontline users. * The delivery discipline to scope ambiguous work, make trade\-offs, manage dependencies, track progress, and keep a cross\-functional team oriented around the customer outcome. * High ownership, low ego, sound judgment, and willingness to travel and spend meaningful time onsite with customers. **Helpful, but not required** ----------------------------- * Familiarity with legal workflows, law\-firm knowledge systems, document management systems, or other complex professional\-services environments. * Experience practicing law or working in legal innovation, knowledge management, legal operations, or legal technology. **What we value** ----------------- * Clear communication and thoughtful, direct feedback. * Autonomy, ownership, and consistently high\-quality execution. * Curiosity about how people, data, and systems work in the real world. * Comfort with changing objectives and imperfect information. * A collaborative approach that builds trust across customers and internal teams. **What we offer** ----------------- * Meaningful equity, giving you a stake in Draftwise's growth. * Competitive salary. * Private medical care. * A work\-from\-home stipend for necessary equipment and accessories. * Unlimited PTO and sick leave. * The opportunity to shape how a fast\-growing company deploys AI in the legal industry.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Valorian is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (full\-stack TypeScript) to build custom software directly with industrial customers ### **About Valorian, LLC** Valorian builds intelligence systems for industrial operations by integrating data, systems, and AI—designed around how work actually gets done in the field. We combine deep industry business\-process expertise with modern technology to deliver clarity across the full execution lifecycle: planned work, its readiness for safe execution, real\-time performance in the field, outcomes at completion, and variance between plan and execution so teams can continuously learn and improve. ### **Description** **Candidates must be located in the Houston metro. In addition to your resume, please** **submit your video screening****.** **Role Summary** You won't be handed tickets from a backlog written by someone else. You'll sit with the customer, watch how the work actually gets done, prototype in the loop with the people who'll use it, and productionize what works — owning meaningful slices of real products end to end. We're a team of about ten building custom software for industrial operations in an AI\-accelerated world, and we're doing it by putting engineers closer to the customer, not further away. The work you own is visible, the decisions you make carry, and the people who depend on what you build will know your name. **Who We Are** Valorian builds intelligence systems for industrial operations by integrating data, systems, and AI — designed around how work actually gets done in the field. Our customers run petrochemical plants and field operations where visibility, safety, and efficiency have real consequences. Our products replace spreadsheets, paper, and disconnected systems with software shaped around their actual workflow, built on a shared platform: React/Next.js and TypeScript on the front end, Node.js/Fastify APIs, PostgreSQL via Prisma, and Azure underneath. **What You'll Own** * Time with customers every week — working sessions, demos, and on\-site visits — observing real workflows and turning what you learn into well\-scoped tickets with crisp acceptance criteria. * Fast prototypes built alongside customers and our Product/Project Managers to validate direction, then hardened into production\-grade features. * Vertical slices end to end: React/Next.js (TypeScript) front ends, Node.js/Fastify APIs, and PostgreSQL via Prisma. * The written record the team inherits: workflow and integration diagrams, data models, decision rules, and Architecture Decision Records for the calls that matter. * Our shared ontology and data models as new customer domains come into scope — reconciling conflicting sources of truth and naming things once, well. * Testing for your work — unit, API, and Playwright end\-to\-end — wired into CI/CD so regressions surface before a customer finds them. * Contributions to Valorian's Design System and shared packages, so what you learn on one product compounds across all of them. * How we use AI: agents as leverage across spec, implementation, and testing, and a voice in which emerging tools earn a place in the team's daily practice. **What Good Looks Like** * **By 90 days:** you've participated meaningfully in customer sessions, shipped your first vertical slice to production, and can describe a customer's workflow more accurately than the ticket does. * **By six months:** you own a product area end to end, customers ask for you by name, and change orders on your work are small because you validated before you built. You've earned the right to solve bigger problems for them. * **By a year:** your contributions are load\-bearing for the team, and you're influencing what we build next — not just how it gets built. **What We're Looking For** * You've built and shipped full\-stack TypeScript products — React/Next.js, Node, and a relational database — and can point to work running in production * You're comfortable in the room with customers: leading a working session, asking the uncomfortable question early, and saying so when what's being asked for isn't advisable * You can model a business domain and write it down clearly enough that a customer confirms it's right and an engineer can build from it * You design APIs thoughtfully (auth, pagination, error handling, rate limiting) and treat data models, migrations, and security as the places to slow down and think * You keep test suites meaningful in CI — unit, API, and end\-to\-end — rather than green by deletion * You reach for shared, reusable solutions over re\-solving the same problem on every project * You're curious about AI tooling and have the judgment to tell real leverage from novelty **Nice to Have** * Azure (App Service, Functions, Container Apps) and Docker * ETL pipelines and data migrations * AI\-powered features: RAG, embeddings, evaluation loops * Observability: metrics, logs, traces * Prior forward\-deployed, consulting, or customer\-facing engineering experience **Compensation and Benefits** * Base salary for this role is $115,000 to $140,000, depending on experience. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance begin on the first of the month following 30 days of employment. * Paid time off accrues each pay period, totaling 15 days annually. * 10 paid holidays are provided per year. * Employees are provided with the equipment necessary to perform their job. * Travel for customer and team time is company\-paid. **Eligibility Requirements** * Applicants must live in the Houston metro. * Because customer sessions happen live, you'll need to be available during U.S. Central business hours and have a quiet, professional workspace for calls, demos, and screen sharing. * This role requires professional English fluency sufficient to independently lead live customer working sessions and demos. * Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This role does not offer visa sponsorship. * Employment is contingent on a background check and pre\-employment drug screening, in accordance with applicable law. **How We Hire** * Every application is reviewed by a member of our team. We believe hiring deserves a human perspective, and we want to understand the person behind the resume. * We place significant emphasis on the video interview. Your experience and accomplishments matter, but so do the way you communicate, think through problems, collaborate, and show up as a teammate. * We’re a small but mighty company, and every employee has a meaningful impact. We hire selectively because finding the right fit matters—for our team, our culture, our clients, and for you. * Selected applicants will be invited to a 30\-minute introductory conversation. We’ll share more about Valorian, learn more about your background, and talk about what you’re looking for in your next role. * Next, you’ll meet with the hiring manager for a 30\-minute conversation focused on the role, our tech stack and workflows, and what success looks like in the position. * You’ll then participate in a practical session with one of our engineers**,** working through a real, anonymized customer problem. This gives both of us a chance to see how you approach the kind of work you’d actually be doing. * The final conversation is an introduction to several key members of the Valorian team. It’s an opportunity to get to know the people you may be working alongside and ask any remaining questions. * We respect your time. We aim to move through the hiring process efficiently and will keep you informed about timing, next steps, and where you stand throughout the process. **Our Values** These aren't posters on a wall — they're how we decide what to build and how we treat each other while we build it. We want people who bring their whole selves to work, take ownership of outcomes rather than tasks, and are direct in how they give and receive feedback. * **Trustworthy**: Committed to building long\-term trust by showing up with an authentic high level of care and taking ownership of outcomes, behaviors, and work product. * **Resourceful**: Leverages curiosity, ingenuity, creativity, and innovation to accomplish goals; thinks long term, and is focused on sustainable results. * **Passionate**: Brings infectious energy, passion, and care for what we do and who we work with. * **Balanced**: Strives for harmony in family, health, fun, and energy. * **Connected**: Committed to meaningful communication and healthy conflict through listening, transparency, and the courage to receive and give feedback. **Interested?** If you're excited about building real products, working directly with the people who use them, and helping define what AI\-accelerated development looks like in practice, we'd love to talk. Submit your resume and complete your video screening. #### **Salary** $115,000 \- $140,000 per year

jobs.title: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer, Backend - New York
jobs.description: **About Draftwise** ------------------- Draftwise is a contract drafting, review, and negotiation AI powered by your legal knowledge. We turn a firm's guidance, precedent, and language into a legal ontology, ground our models in it, and run complex drafting, review, and search workflows directly within Microsoft Word and in the browser. We serve top law firms and legal departments globally, including over half the Vault 10, dozens of Am Law 100 firms, and Fortune 500 organizations. We are headquartered in NYC with offices in London and West Palm Beach, are Y Combinator alumni, and raised a $20M Series A from Index Ventures. **The role** ------------ A Forward Deployed Engineer at Draftwise embeds with a firm, learns how their lawyers actually draft, and extends the product until it works the way they work. You will model their precedent and playbooks into our ontology and write the backend behind it, and when the platform cannot do what a firm needs, you build it. This is the early career version of that job, weighted toward backend engineering and the AI systems underneath the product. You will learn forward deployed engineering and ontology modeling from engineers who built those practices at Palantir, with real customer accounts and real code from your first month. The scope is broad. You get ownership and impact across the technology, the product, and our culture, working alongside a first rate engineering team to ship new features, scale the platform, and make it more performant. **What you will work on** ------------------------- * *Ontology modeling for legal knowledge.* Every firm has its own precedent, playbooks, and preferred language, and the ontology is how we turn that into structure the product can reason over. This is the most transferable skill in the role. * *Backend services behind drafting, review, and search.* We are not religious about languages. There is what the codebase was historically built in and there is whatever gets the job done now, and the complexity that lasts sits underneath that: Postgres, OpenSearch, a graph database, and a wide set of AWS services. You will own features end to end and learn how those pieces fit together, which is rarer to pick up early than any one language. * *LLM systems in production.* You will write and test prompts, build retrieval and evaluation scaffolding, and measure quality on real customer data, so the work looks more like building test infrastructure than tuning prompts by feel. * *Scale and performance.* We run large documents and large precedent sets under interactive latency, so profiling, query tuning, and cost work show up as regular engineering here. * *Deployments into elite law firms, with a senior FDE beside you.* You will own pieces of a firm's rollout early, and you will be the one working out why their playbook does not map cleanly onto the product yet. * *Enough frontend to finish the job.* Our surface is a Word add in and a web app in TypeScript and React, and we expect you to ship a UI change without waiting on someone else. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * *High ownership and low ego.* Most of our work arrives as a customer problem instead of a spec, so we look for people who take it off someone else's plate, ask for feedback early, and do not care who gets credit for the fix. * *A focus on user impact.* We want someone with a passion for shipping high quality products that delight users, which here means a lawyer finishing a markup faster and noticing why. * *Curiosity and intelligence over credentials.* We hire on how you reason about data models, failure modes, and tradeoffs, and you will be in unfamiliar territory often, legal concepts, an ontology, a service someone else wrote, so the learning has to be part of the appeal. * *Backend as your center of gravity.* You should already be comfortable with SQL, API design, and debugging a service you did not write, and you should want to get much better at all three. * *Comfort in the room with the customer.* You will be on calls with partners and knowledge management leads, prepared alongside a senior FDE, and the skill is asking a sharp question and saying plainly what you still need to go find out. * *The instinct to turn a vague problem into a model.* Lawyers describe problems in terms of their work, and the job is to hear "our fallbacks never come out right" and get to a schema, a retrieval change, or a bug. * *Interest in LLMs and their limits.* We use Claude Code and similar tools every day, and what matters is the judgment to see where they help and where they quietly cost you time. You do not need legal industry experience, production LLM experience, or prior customer facing work, and we care that you have built real backend software rather than which language you built it in. Bring the foundation and the curiosity, and we will teach you the rest. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Project or internship work on retrieval systems, evaluation harnesses, or agent frameworks. * Any experience in front of customers, including consulting, support, or solutions work. * Exposure to legal, financial, or other document heavy domains. * Anything you shipped to real users, personal projects included. **Why this role** ----------------- * *The real FDE experience.* You will learn deployment and ontology work directly from engineers who did it at Palantir, alongside legal professionals from top global firms, and you will do the work rather than watch it. * *Proven product market fit.* Lawyers at Vault 10, Magic Circle, and Am Law 100 firms use Draftwise for their most important work, so you are building on demand that already exists. * *Immediate feedback.* Your work directly changes how legal professionals serve their clients, and you will often hear about the impact from the customer within days. * *Ownership that compounds.* Forward deployed work puts you in front of the customer, the commercial reality, and the code at the same time, which is rare this early in a career. It is the fastest way to become an engineer who can carry a problem end to end, and that travels with you wherever you go next, including a company of your own. * *Early stage, real equity.* You are joining at Series A, when the work you do still bends the company's trajectory, and every engineer holds a meaningful equity package, so you own a piece of what you build. **Process** ----------- * Intro call with the hiring manager. * Technical conversation on a system you have built. * screen share coding exercises of about an hour on backend, data modeling, debugging * Take\-home project of about 3 hours on a self contained problem, using our stack and the AI tools you would use on the job. We share the rate and the evaluation criteria in advance. * Final conversation with a founder.

jobs.title: Foundation Model Data Engineer
jobs.description: Sciforium is an AI infrastructure company developing next\-generation multimodal AI models and a proprietary, high\-efficiency serving platform. Backed by multi\-million\-dollar funding and direct sponsorship from AMD with hands\-on support from AMD engineers the team is scaling rapidly to build the full stack powering frontier AI models and real\-time applications. **Role Overview** ----------------- Sciforium is seeking a highly technical and visionary **Foundation Model Data Engineer** to lead the strategy, creation, and curation of the massive datasets that power our foundation models. We believe that in the era of LLMs, data is the primary competitive advantage. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end data lifecycle—from raw web\-scale crawling to the fine\-grained human\-alignment datasets that define model behavior. This position is ideal for a scientist who views data as a high\-scale engineering challenge and an analytical puzzle. You will not just "provide" data; you will design the taxonomies, filtering heuristics, and post\-training pipelines that ensure our models are world\-class in reasoning, safety, and multimodal understanding. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Foundation Dataset Strategy:** Own the end\-to\-end creation of pre\-training datasets for LLMs. This includes defining the mix of jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Gravitate?** At Gravitate, we’re on a mission to put everyday supply and logistics decisions in motion, powered by innovative problem\-solving from industry experts. A lot of companies say it. We mean it: Gravitate is different. Rooted in the spirit of collaboration, we thrive on the smarts of our people and the dynamic we’ve cultivated. **Tell Me About My Job:** If you are considering this role, you are someone who has moved past needing a fully specified ticket. Hand you a feature of moderate complexity and you break it into tasks, deliver it on time, and raise the risks you spot along the way instead of surfacing them late. You’ll own features and components within your product area in Gravitate’s fuel logistics platform, and you’ll be responsible for the quality and ongoing maintenance of what you build — not just the first version that shipped. This is a genuinely full\-stack role. You’ll write Python on the service and API side, model data in MongoDB, and build the React and TypeScript interfaces on top — following a feature from the data model through the API to the screen a dispatcher actually uses. We expect you to be strong on one side of that and genuinely willing to contribute on the other. You’ll also be a reliable member of the on\-call rotation for your product area — debugging incoming bugs and incidents independently, and contributing to the monitoring, observability, and performance improvements that make your area healthier over time. This is a role with room to grow, and we’ll be explicit with you about what the next level looks like. Engineers who do well here start by delivering medium\-sized work accurately and reliably, then take on larger and more ambiguous projects, carry more weight in design discussions, and begin mentoring the engineers behind them. We’re strongly against artificial separations of responsibility and throwing work “over the wall.” As an engineer here, you’re part of the product team — in the room for the product conversation, not downstream of it. **You’re an Ideal Candidate If:** * You deliver reliably. You can take a medium or large\-sized feature with real unknowns, break it into tasks, estimate it honestly, and land it. When something threatens the date, you say so early. * You work end\-to\-end. You’re not precious about which layer a problem lives in. You’ll follow an issue from the UI through the API to the query and fix it where it actually belongs. * You write code other people can live with. Well\-tested, readable, and consistent with the codebase around it. You debug your own problems before escalating them. * You’re building your design judgment. You bring viable alternatives to design discussions rather than waiting to be told, and you can write a clear design doc for a feature in your area. * You give and take feedback well. Your code review comments are specific and constructive. You’re receptive to feedback on your own work and you act on it. * You’re curious about the business. You want to understand what fuel supply and logistics teams actually do with this software, because knowing that makes every decision you make a better one. * You want to work in an AI\-enabled workflow. You see the impact of AI on code generation and are willing and able to see how it can make you more productive. You want to help in building the harness around it so that the team can get more done. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Independently deliver features of moderate complexity on time — breaking work into manageable tasks, estimating accurately with some unknowns, and raising risks early * Build features end\-to\-end across the stack: Python services and APIs, MongoDB data models, and React/TypeScript interfaces * Own features and components within your product area — accountable for their quality and ongoing maintenance * Contribute to design discussions with viable alternatives; produce clear technical designs for features within your area * Write well\-tested, readable code and help improve our automated testing practices and coverage * Be a reliable member of the on\-call rotation — debug and resolve small\-to\-medium bugs, incidents, and issues in your product area independently * Contribute to monitoring, observability, and performance improvements within your product area * Provide constructive, specific code review feedback; informally mentor engineers newer than you * Write clear technical documents; communicate status, risks, and blockers clearly to your team **Required Qualifications:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software * Proficiency in both a server\-side language (Python preferred) and TypeScript/React — or real depth in one, plus a demonstrated track record of picking up the other * Demonstrated ability to independently deliver medium\-sized features with some unknowns, on time * Able to debug and resolve small\-to\-medium issues independently, across both the frontend and the backend * Experience writing well\-tested code, plus working knowledge of CI/CD and deployment practices * Comfortable participating in an on\-call rotation for the product area you own * Clear written and verbal communication — able to produce small\-to\-medium technical documents and give constructive code review feedback * Receptive to feedback and actively acts on it * Openness to utilizing and becoming an expert in AI\-assisted development to supercharge your ability to get stuff done. **Nice to Have Experience:** * Hands\-on experience with our stack: Python, React and TypeScript, MongoDB, Kubernetes, GCP or Azure * Experience in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment * Background in a logistics, supply chain, or energy/fuel domain * Experience with data\-dense enterprise interfaces — large tables and grids, scheduling views, or real\-time updates * AI engineering experience – working with production agentic systems and ML / operations models. **About the Gravitate Team:** To understand who our people are, you should first understand what they’re not: replaceable. Each member of the team is chosen carefully and with intention. We believe that finding the right fit is more important than a laundry list of credentials – and that people are people first, and titles second. Because we hire the Gravitate way, our team is certainly one of a kind. We’ve brought together incredible talent that regularly collaborates to create clean, fresh solutions. That effort has led to remarkable opportunities, including work with many Fortune 500 clients. We’ve found that the winning combination of exciting achievements, trust in one another and open communication lays the groundwork for long\-lasting, successful careers. That, and the fact that we clap for each other at every opportunity. Problem solvers, go\-getters and charge\-takers — we (really) want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Full\-Stack Software Engineer **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Engineering Lead **About Plug** -------------- Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. **Why Plug** ------------ * You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are looking for a Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join our growing team! this is an opportunity to grow quickly with direct mentorship from senior engineers as the team scales. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing and delivering production applications. * Solid proficiency in TypeScript across the full stack \- backend, frontend, relational databases, and API/webhook integrations. * Experience deploying and operating cloud\-hosted applications; comfort with CI/CD pipelines and observability tooling, with interest in infrastructure\-as\-code (we use Terraform) and feature flag systems. * Comfortable working in agent\-first development workflows \- defining clear acceptance criteria and reviewing AI\-generated output with a high quality bar. * A strong engineering quality bar \- writing tests, participating in code reviews, and producing code that is readable by both humans and AI agents. * Track record of owning work end\-to\-end: scoping, shipping, and measuring impact, with growing autonomy. * Startup or fast\-paced team experience is a plus. * Authorized to work in the US for any employer. * Prior experience in automotive or EV systems is a plus. **Compensation** ---------------- Annual salary: $145,000 \- $175,000 *Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect changing market conditions.* **Benefits \& Perks:** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Work from anywhere up to 30 days per year. * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles) and is an in\-person role. jobs.title: HW Systems Engineer- Mixed Signal PCB
jobs.description: TOPOLOGIQ ENGINEERING OPPORTUNITY Hardware Systems Engineer \- Mixed\-Signal PCB \& Measurement Location: Palo Alto, California ABOUT TOPOLOGIQ TopoLogiq is a venture\-backed Stanford spinout commercializing breakthrough semiconductor technology developed at Stanford’s Quantum Mechanical Engineering Laboratory (QMEL). Our mission is to transform computing and energy through topological electronics. THE OPPORTUNITY As one of our Systems Engineers, you will develop the critical hardware interface between our quantum semiconductor devices and the high\-performance electronics used to characterize and control them. Working closely with physicists, process integration engineers, analog designers, and characterization engineers, you will design the packaged\-device interface, advanced PCBs, and validation hardware that form the foundation of our next\-generation quantum platform. This is a hands\-on role. You will own boards from end to end—including schematic design, layout, bring\-up, and debugging—rather than handing them off to a separate layout team. WHY JOIN TOPOLOGIQ * Develop a breakthrough semiconductor platform for practical quantum electronics. * Work alongside world\-class scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs. * Lead development from research through technology transfer and manufacturing scale\-up. * Receive meaningful equity and help shape the future of the company. RESPONSIBILITIES * Own the complete electrical signal path from the packaged device to the measurement instrument. * Design multilayer PCBs that carry DC bias and high\-frequency signals to the same device, including bias networks and protection for sensitive front ends. * Design analog front\-end and switching electronics with a focus on channel\-to\-channel consistency. * Develop scalable hardware architectures that support on\-board multiplexing as channel counts increase. * Model the package, board, and switching path. * Design de\-embedding and calibration structures. * Correlate simulations with measured results to distinguish device behavior from fixture effects. * Define the electrical and environmental requirements for packaging partners and review their deliverables against those requirements. * Translate channel\-count requirements into electrical and interconnect budgets. * Work with characterization and device engineers to translate measurement needs into hardware requirements. * Support engineering teams in separating fixture behavior from device behavior. * Lead board fabrication, bring\-up, laboratory validation, debugging, and performance optimization. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline. * Strong analog and mixed\-signal design fundamentals. * Experience designing multilayer PCBs spanning DC through multi\-GHz frequencies, including stackup, controlled impedance, and grounding strategy. * Demonstrated ownership of hardware from concept through fabrication, bring\-up, and laboratory validation. * Hands\-on board bring\-up and debugging experience, including root\-cause analysis of hardware issues in the laboratory. * Hands\-on laboratory experience correlating measured data with simulation results. * Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent discipline. * Three or more years of relevant industry experience. * Experience designing multilayer mixed\-signal PCBs using Altium, Allegro, KiCad, or similar tools. * Hands\-on experience with schematic capture and PCB layout. * Experience with VNA and TDR measurements, S\-parameters, and fixture de\-embedding. * Knowledge of low\-noise and low\-leakage measurement techniques, including guarding, shielding, and noise budgeting. * Experience designing analog front ends for small\-signal measurement. * Experience creating board\-level isolation between bias and measurement domains. * Hands\-on laboratory experience with source\-measure units, impedance analyzers, and oscilloscopes. * Experience with electromagnetic and circuit simulation tools such as SIwave, Q3D, HFSS, or similar platforms, as well as SPICE\-class tools. * Experience with package electrical modeling and its implications at RF frequencies, including vendor qualification. * Experience designing multi\-channel and switched\-measurement architectures. * Experience with instrument control and measurement automation using Python or MATLAB. * Familiarity with taking hardware from design through production. * Experience within semiconductor, quantum computing, or other advanced\-hardware platforms. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS TopoLogiq offers a competitive salary, meaningful equity, comprehensive health benefits, paid time off, relocation support where applicable, and the opportunity to help build a category\-defining technology company. OUR CULTURE * Accountable: Taking absolute ownership. * Curious: Challenging conventional thinking. * Collaborative: Solving problems across disciplines. * Persistent: Driving relentlessly toward results. * Rigorous: Maintaining uncompromising attention to detail.

You understand the request lifecycle across layers * Clear, concise communication — you explain technical decisions well, distinguish your work from the team's, and proactively share context * Evidence of shipping and iterating — you can describe the full arc of a feature you owned: problem, solution, code, what happened after launch, and what you'd change now * A product engineering identity — you care about whether the thing you built actually worked for users, not just whether the code was clean * Genuine curiosity about AI evaluation and Arena's mission — you've looked at the product and can articulate why this domain matters to you ### **Bonus Points** * Familiarity with our stack: NextJS, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, ShadCN, HonoJS, Postgres, Vitest * Experience with Supabase or Vercel's AI SDK * You've shipped without PM or design support — determined what to build by talking to users or looking at data **What we offer** ================= * We offer competitive compensation and equity aligned to the markets where our team members are based. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.*

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations. * You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew. * You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. * You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team. **Bonus** --------- * AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background. * You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers. * Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship. * Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*
