jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description: The Full\-Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining internal software applications across frontend and backend systems. This role turns business requirements and written tickets into working functionality, collaborating across the development lifecycle to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that support firm operations. * Develop, test, and maintain full\-stack software solutions across Angular frontends and Symfony/PHP APIs, carrying features from written requirements through implementation and release. * Read requirements and tickets critically, clarify scope and assumptions, and identify edge cases or missing details before development begins. * Design and implement data changes, including Doctrine entities, relationships, migrations, API payloads, services, controllers, and the interfaces that consume them. * Work within established application patterns and conventions, extending existing modules and adapting appropriately as the codebase evolves. * Verify functionality before review by testing features in the running application, validating resulting data, and addressing scenarios not explicitly identified in the original requirements. * Debug issues across the full request path, including browser behavior, network requests, APIs, application logs, backend services, client\-side state, and user interfaces. * Write and maintain meaningful unit and end\-to\-end test coverage and partner with Quality Assurance to ensure features are tested against clear acceptance criteria. * Use AI development tools as a primary part of the development process while independently reviewing, validating, and taking accountability for all generated code and recommendations. * Create clear, reviewable pull requests and participate in code reviews, documenting changes, assumptions, and intentionally excluded scope. **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. * Demonstrated experience carrying software features from written requirements through development, testing, review, and production release. * Ability to read and work with TypeScript and PHP and to evaluate whether code, including AI\-generated code, is correct and appropriate for the application. * Strong understanding of how modern web applications work, including HTTP, authentication and permissions, APIs, object\-relational mapping (ORM), client\-side state management, and the connections between technical impact * Are highly skilled in modern frontend development, especially TypeScript and React * Have experience building reusable frontend systems, components, tools, or infrastructure * Care deeply about user experience, accessibility, performance, and maintainability * Are comfortable working in a large frontend codebase with many stakeholders * Communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and help raise the technical bar for those around you * Bonus experience * + Experience building design systems or component libraries + Experience with frontend testing frameworks such as Cypress or Jest + Experience with code generation, linting, codemods, or other developer tooling + Experience with internationalization, localization, or accessibility + Experience with Ruby on Rails For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $128,842 and $209,368/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $144,000 and $234,000/year (including bonus or commission). When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you *you*. jobs.title: Protection Applications Department Manager (Minneapolis)
jobs.description: **Description** The Protection Applications Department Manager is responsible for the managerial direction, leadership, development, and growth of the Protection Applications (PA) Department within Burns \& McDonnell’s Upper Midwest Region Transmission \& Distribution (T\&D) Global Practice. This role is responsible for developing a high\-performing team, supporting and executing business strategy, promoting Burns \& McDonnell’s MacCulture principles, and ensuring the department delivers high\-quality technical work while supporting the needs of our clients and business. The Department Manager will maintain an active connection to Protection Applications engineering and project execution while carrying full accountability for the leadership and management responsibilities of the department. Specific areas of responsibility include the following, with other duties assigned by senior management as needed: **Leadership \& Culture** * Provide overall leadership and direction to the Protection Applications Department through clear expectations, accountability, effective communication, empowerment, and sound decision\-making. * Advocate for Protection Applications staff with T\&D and Burns \& McDonnell leadership and help ensure the needs of the department and its employee\-owners are understood and appropriately addressed. * Maintain an accessible and approachable leadership presence and provide timely follow\-up on employee, project, and organizational needs. * Communicate department priorities, decisions, expectations, and business context with transparency and consistency. * Foster a healthy, collaborative, and inclusive employee\-owner culture grounded in Burns \& McDonnell’s MacCulture principles, safety, quality, integrity, accountability, teamwork, and outstanding service. * Promote equitable and consistent people practices and decision\-making across the department. * Drive a culture focused on safety and compliance with company, regional, project, and client safety requirements. * Develop and foster an innovation culture that challenges existing approaches and leverages tools, technology, and processes to improve quality, efficiency, and the employee and client experience. * Interpret and support company and T\&D policies, procedures, initiatives, and strategic objectives within the department. * Develop leadership capability within the department and create opportunities for employees to grow their influence, ownership, and leadership skills. **Career Development \& Performance Management** * Meet regularly with department staff to understand career interests, development needs, performance, workload, and short\- and long\-term goals. * Provide employees with coaching, guidance, feedback, and opportunities that support their continued development. * Educate employees about career paths and opportunities throughout T\&D and help them develop the knowledge, skills, experience, and relationships necessary to pursue their desired career path. * Lead and conduct the annual performance appraisal process and support other performance and development conversations throughout the year. * Establish clear performance expectations and provide timely, candid, and constructive feedback. * Work with Human Resources and appropriate leaders to identify, prepare, communicate, and monitor performance improvement plans when additional performance support or accountability is needed. * Identify technical, project delivery, leadership, and professional development needs and coordinate training opportunities with technical teams, business line leadership, and other departments. * Promote mentoring, knowledge sharing, succession planning, and development of future technical and people leaders within the department. **Collaboration \& Communication** * Establish effective and consistent communication practices for the department, recognizing that employees may require different methods and levels of communication to remain informed and engaged. * Proactively share relevant business, staffing, project, organizational, and Global Practice information with department staff. * Coordinate and collaborate with T\&D business line leadership, project managers, account managers, and other department leaders to align the needs and development of our people with the needs of the business. * Develop a strong partnership with Substation leadership and other closely aligned T\&D disciplines to promote coordinated project delivery and team cohesion. * Communicate and coordinate regularly with Protection Applications leadership throughout the T\&D Global Practice regarding staffing, workload, clients, pursuits, technical initiatives, training, and overall business line strategy. * Build strong relationships across offices and regions to support resource sharing, knowledge transfer, consistent practices, and successful project delivery. * Support T\&D and regional initiatives and effectively lead the department through organizational and busin t appropriate QA/QC assignments and reviews for Protection Applications work. * Maintain awareness of emerging protection technologies, industry practices, standards, and client needs and help translate those developments into department capabilities and opportunities. * Advance tools, workflows, standards, and technical practices that improve consistency, quality, and efficiency across the department. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited program. * Minimum seven (7\) years of professional experience in the design and execution of microprocessor\-based protection systems. * Minimum three (3\) years of experience preparing protection relay setting calculations. * Demonstrated technical knowledge of electric power system protection principles and practices and the ability to apply that knowledge across a broad range of assignments. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly and effectively communicate complex technical and business information to employees, management, project teams, and clients. * Strong interpersonal, collaboration, facilitation, planning, organization, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Demonstrated ability to establish priorities, make sound decisions, follow through on commitments, and hold oneself and others accountable. * Ability to navigate difficult situations and conversations with tact, poise, professionalism, and discernment. * Ability to thoughtfully and positively influence, lead, and manage change. * Demonstrated credibility and technical expertise sufficient to represent Burns \& McDonnell’s Protection Applications capabilities with clients and industry partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) registration. * Previous people leadership or management experience. * Demonstrated experience developing and implementing a vision or strategy that resulted in positive organizational or business outcomes. * Experience providing meaningful performance feedback, coaching, mentoring, or career development to others. * Demonstrated experience leading or developing technical teams. * Experience with project planning, execution, budgeting, scheduling, quality management, and client coordination. * Experience supporting client relationships, pursuits, proposals, or business development efforts. * Experience utilizing data and technology to improve decision\-making and operational efficiency, including tools such as Microsoft Excel PivotTables, data models, Power BI, Microsoft 365 applications, or similar tools. * Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries and build effective partnerships with technical, project, business, and people leaders. **Compensation** $165,000\.00\-330,000\.00 Yearly The expected compensation range for this position is displayed in compliance with all local/state regulations. The expected compensation range for this position is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, prior work experience and work location. The total annual compensation package will consist of a base salary and eligibility to participate in our discretionary year\-end incentive bonus program. **Benefits** Our extensive benefits package takes care of you so that you can focus on doing great work. From insurance and disability to time off and wellness programs, we provide the tools to meet your needs. As part of being 100% employee\-owned, eligible employees participate in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) in addition to our 401(k) retirement program. For more information, please visit the Benefits \& Wellness page. This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled. EEO/Disabled/Veterans **Job** Engineering **Primary Location** US\-MN\-Minneapolis/St Paul **Schedule:** Full\-time **Travel:** Yes, 25 % of the Time **Req ID:** 264536 **Job Hire Type** Experienced \#LI\-JNH \#T\&D

jobs.title: Senior Manager, MarTech (Salesforce)
jobs.description: **Description** **Job Summary** The Senior Manager, Martech (Salesforce) is responsible for driving the growth, strategy, delivery excellence, and operational leadership of CDW's Salesforce business within the broader MarTech practice. This leader serves as the primary delivery and business leader for Salesforce\-related services, including Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Agentforce, CRM, Industry Clouds, and AI\-powered customer engagement solutions. The role partners closely with Sales, Alliances, Solution Architecture, delivery leaders, and strategic partners to develop and execute go\-to\-market strategies, expand Salesforce services revenue, grow customer relationships, and ensure successful delivery outcomes. This leader is accountable for Salesforce business growth, financial performance, customer success, coworker development, partner alignment, and delivery quality while helping build CDW's long\-term Salesforce services capabilities. **What you will do** **Salesforce Business Strategy and Growth within MarTech** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Define and execute the Salesforce services growth strategy within the broader MarTech portfolio. * Build and scale Salesforce services across Commercial, Enterprise, Healthcare, Financial Services, State and Local Government, Education, and Federal markets. * Partner with sellers to identify, qualify, shape, and accelerate Salesforce opportunities. * Develop differentiated Salesforce service offerings, accelerators, methodologies, reference architectures, and reusable assets. * Drive Salesforce pipeline generation, services bookings, revenue attainment, backlog conversion, and margin performance. * Translate market trends and Salesforce platform innovation into credible investment plans and customer value propositions. **Salesforce Capability Ownership** ----------------------------------- * Own strategy, growth, capability development, and delivery oversight across Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce and AI, CRM, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Industry Clouds, Revenue Cloud / CPQ, and Customer Success and Managed Services. * Balance deep Salesforce specialization with integrated MarTech solutions and measurable business outcomes. * Build certification, specialization, and delivery\-readiness plans aligned to forecast customer demand. **Sales and Business Development Leadership** --------------------------------------------- * Serve as executive sponsor for strategic Salesforce pursuits and priority customer relationships. * Participate directly in executive client meetings, discovery workshops, solution reviews, proposal reviews, and deal strategy sessions. * Partner with Client Executives, Solution Executives, Alliances, and delivery leaders to develop account strategies and advance pursuits. * Ensure Salesforce delivery expertise is incorporated early in the sales process to improve solution quality, feasibility, margin, and delivery confidence. * Support proposal development, statements of work, estimation, pricing strategy, and contract review. * Lead a consistent rhythm of business for Salesforce pipeline reviews, forecasting, and account\-growth planning. **Salesforce Ecosystem and Partner Leadership** ----------------------------------------------- * Establish and maintain executive relationships across the Salesforce ecosystem, including Salesforce and strategic implementation, distribution, and services partners. * Lead joint business planning, go\-to\-market alignment, co\-sell motions, partner sourcing strategies, capacity alignment, delivery governance, and escalation management. * Educate partners on CDW capabilities, delivery models, and priority offerings. * Ensure partner\-supported delivery aligns with CDW quality, commercial, security, and customer\-experience expectations. **Delivery Excellence and Customer Success** -------------------------------------------- * Provide executive oversight for strategic Salesforce customers and complex engagements. * Ensure engagements meet customer expectations for quality, financial performance, delivery excellence, and customer satisfaction. * Establish repeatable delivery methodologies and governance across project initiation, scope management, financial controls, change management, status reporting, risk management, and engagement closure. * Monitor portfolio health, project risks, customer satisfaction, resource needs, and commercial performance. * Act as an escalation leader for significant delivery, customer, contractual, staffing, and partner issues. * Partner with project and delivery leaders to identify risks early, establish recovery plans, and maintain effective executive communication. **Financial and Operational Management** ---------------------------------------- * Coordinate with drafting personnel to ensure changes are incorporated into the design plans. Ability to review industry and municipal standards to ensure design compliance. * Preparing engineering related calculations and develop drawings and visual aids. * Working on a wide range of projects and tasks and assist with field research, data collection, data analysis, graphics, maps and data presentation, and report development. * Management of time and workload to stay on schedule and within budget. * Limited travel to assist with site investigations, construction observation and project transmittals. ### **Requirements** * Bachelors or Master’s Degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering. * EIT certification, PE preferred. * Detail\-oriented individual with strong technical and organizational skills. * Proficiency in spreadsheets, word processing and standard office software. * Works well in multidisciplinary team environments and ability to meet deadlines. * Strong oral presentation and written communication skills. * Experience with WaterCAD, ICPR and other modeling software is preferred. * Valid state\-issued driver's license with a clean driving record. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** * Dependent upon experience. * CPH offers Medical, Dental and Vision and Long\-Term Disability with a quality insurance company. * Company Paid Life Insurance and Short\-Term Disability. * 401K, Paid Personal Time Off, Paid Holidays, and Paid Paternal Leave. The unique contributions that people bring to our firm sets us apart and allows us to bring exceptional service to the communities and clients we serve. jobs.title: Director of Property Management & Operations
jobs.description: **Location:** Bergen County, New Jersey **Position:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** $120,000–$180,000 base salary, commensurate with experience, qualifications, and scope of responsibility, plus performance\-based bonus and profit\-sharing eligibility. Benefits include health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and 401k participation. Position Overview CRE Vertical Advisors is seeking a Director of Property Management \& Operations to lead and continue building our commercial property management and operations platform across a portfolio of retail, industrial, and office properties. This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role, not a desk\-bound portfolio management position. The Director will regularly visit properties, walk buildings and sites, meet with tenants, evaluate vendor work, participate in construction and capital\-project discussions, and see issues firsthand. The successful candidate should be equally comfortable discussing strategy and financial performance with ownership, walking a roof with a contractor, and resolving an operating issue in the field. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the property management and operations function, lead and develop the team, build and improve systems, and serve as a trusted resource to ownership and asset management. About CRE Vertical Advisors CRE Vertical Advisors is a commercial real estate management and advisory firm serving private owners, family offices, entrepreneurial investors, and other middle\-market commercial real estate owners. Our philosophy connects ownership strategy with property\-level execution. Effective property management requires an understanding of the entire commercial real estate ecosystem, including property operations, asset management, accounting and financial reporting, construction and capital projects, leasing and lease administration, risk management and insurance, vendor management, tenant relationships, and budgeting and capital planning. The Director will play an important role in integrating these disciplines across the portfolio. Primary Responsibilities The Director will have overall leadership responsibility for the property management function, working closely with senior management, property managers, accounting personnel, asset management, ownership, tenants, vendors, brokers, attorneys, architects, engineers, and other professionals. **Field and property oversight** * Lead day\-to\-day property management and operating activities across the portfolio, and regularly visit properties to maintain direct familiarity with their physical condition, tenants, and outstanding issues. * Conduct inspections to identify operational, physical, safety, maintenance, and capital concerns, and personally inspect significant repairs, construction work, and capital projects rather than relying solely on reports from others. * Meet directly with tenants to resolve issues, maintain relationships, and represent ownership interests. * Walk properties with contractors, vendors, engineers, architects, and consultants as needed. **Team leadership** * Manage, coach, and develop property management personnel, and establish clear standards of accountability. * Serve as the senior escalation point for significant property operating matters. * Develop and improve property management policies, procedures, systems, and operating standards. **Financial and lease administration** * Oversee preparation and execution of annual property operating budgets. * Review monthly financial reporting, operating results, variances, receivables, recoveries, and property\-level performance, coordinating with property accounting to ensure operational information is properly reflected. * Oversee CAM and other operating\-expense recovery processes. * Understand and interpret commercial lease provisions affecting property operations, including expense recoveries, maintenance obligations, rent commencement, and insurance, and assist with lease administration. **Vendor and construction management** * Oversee vendor procurement, contracting, bidding, performance, and compliance, and evaluate scopes of work and bid specifications for repairs, maintenance, and capital projects. * Coordinate construction and capital improvement projects with contractors, architects, engineers, and ownership, and review completed work in the field when appropriate. * Oversee preventative maintenance programs and major building systems. **Risk and strategic support** * Participate in risk\-management and insurance matters, including contractual risk transfer and vendor insurance compliance. * Identify operational risks before they become larger financial or ownership issues, and provide ownership with concise, practical recommendations rather than simply reporting problems. * Assist with property transitions, acquisitions, dispositions, and due diligence when appropriate. * Help continue building a scalable property management and operations platform capable of s ve and non\-cumulative caps, maintenance responsibilities, insurance obligations, and rent\-commencement provisions. * Construction documents, scopes of work, bid specifications, contractor proposals, and change orders. * Property\-level budgeting, financial reporting, accounts receivable, operating\-expense reconciliations, and variance analysis. * Vendor procurement, contractor management, and insurance and risk\-transfer concepts. * How property management connects to asset management, leasing, construction, accounting, and ownership strategy. You do not need to be an architect, engineer, attorney, accountant, or construction professional. You do need enough knowledge and judgment to coordinate those professionals, ask the right questions, identify inconsistencies, and understand how their work affects the property and ownership. Leadership Expectations This position requires more than technical property management experience. We are looking for someone who understands the difference between managing work and leading people, and who can: * Establish expectations, hold people accountable, and develop less\-experienced team members. * Delegate effectively without losing visibility, and make reasonable decisions without requiring constant senior\-management involvement. * Know when an issue can be handled independently and when ownership or senior leadership should be involved. * Create systems that reduce dependence on individual employees. * Communicate clearly with ownership, employees, tenants, and outside professionals, and remain calm and practical when unexpected issues arise. * Prioritize effectively across multiple properties, take ownership of problems through resolution, and remain close enough to the properties to know when reports and reality do not match. Experience We are intentionally flexible regarding a specific number of years of experience. Depth and progression of experience matter more than tenure alone. We would rather hire someone with seven years of progressively increasing responsibility, judgment, and knowledge than someone with twenty years of experience that amounts to the same year repeated twenty times. Candidates should have meaningful experience managing commercial real estate, involving some combination of retail, industrial, office, or mixed commercial portfolios, and must have direct experience leading other property managers or operating personnel. This is not an entry point into a first management role. Our portfolio does not include multifamily assets, and candidates whose background is primarily or exclusively in multifamily property management are not a fit for this role. Personal Characteristics The right candidate will likely be highly accountable, practical and solutions\-oriented, comfortable spending significant time in the field, organized without being bureaucratic, confident enough to challenge assumptions, and humble enough to seek expertise when appropriate. We are looking for someone curious, comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, and willing to roll up their sleeves when circumstances require it. Why This Opportunity This position offers an opportunity to do more than manage an existing portfolio. The Director will help shape how CRE Vertical operates, develop its people and systems, improve the property management platform, and participate in the continued growth of the organization. For someone who wants greater responsibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to help build something rather than occupy a position within an established corporate structure, this is a particularly attractive role. Applying Interested candidates may submit their information to hr@crevertical.com. Referrals from industry professionals are welcome. All inquiries, applications, referrals, and direct communications regarding this position will be treated confidentially. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer - Spark
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About This Role** ------------------- As a Senior Instrumentation \& Controls Engineer supporting Crusoe's modular data center platform, you will own the control system deliverables for major systems inside the modules we manufacture. Modular is how Crusoe compresses the timeline from steel to compute, and that speed only holds when the controls package is repeatable, verified in the factory, and correct the first time it lands in the field. You will independently produce and defend the point lists, instrument schedules, and control system drawings for your assigned systems, then prove them out through factory acceptance testing before a module ships. This role sits at the point where design intent meets manufactured hardware. You will move between the design desk and the factory floor, adapting standards to non\-standard conditions, resolving equipment substitutions and installation deviations without waiting for direction, and making the judgment calls that keep a production line moving. Your deliverables become the reference that construction, commissioning, and operations teams build against, and you will mentor Engineer I and II teammates on the standards behind them. Denver is your home base, with estimated travel at 25% to manufacturing partners and deployment sites. This is a full\-time position. **What You'll Be Working On** ----------------------------- * **System Design Ownership:** Own the I\&C design deliverables for assigned building\-level or major systems, including point lists, I/O assignments, instrument schedules, and control system drawings from concept through as\-built. * **Factory Acceptance Testing Leadership:** Develop and execute FAT protocols on control panels and integrated modules, adjudicate discrepancies against design intent, and hold the release gate before shipment. * **Non\-Standard Condition Resolution:** Resolve equipment substitutions requiring control specification updates, field installation deviations, and calibration discrepancies by adapting established procedures with minimal guidance. * **Platform Standardization:** Improve the repeatable design packages, drawing templates, and test procedures that let the modular platform scale across successive builds, feeding lessons from the factory floor back into the standard. * **Vendor and Integrator Coordination:** Lead technical coordination with control panel fabricators, systems integrators, and instrument suppliers on submittal review, specification compliance, and closure of open technical items. * **Commissioning Readiness:** Coordinate control loop checkout, startup support, and field verification activities so modules arrive at deployment sites commissioning\-ready with accurate documentation. * **Mentorship:** Coach Instrumentation \& Controls Engineer I and II teammates on Crusoe's control platforms, documentation standards, and field verification practices, and review their deliverables before release. * **Schedule Accountability:** Track your I\&C deliverable schedule against project milestones and flag risk to design and deployment leadership early enough to act on it. **What You'll Bring to the Team** --------------------------------- * **Instrumentation \& Controls Depth:** 5 to 8 years of professional experience in industrial instrumentation and controls, with demonstrated independent ownership of design deliverables across the design and commissioning lifecycle. * **PLC Proficiency:** Strong working command of Rockwell and Allen\-Bradley platforms, including Studio 5000 and ControlLogix or CompactLogix hardware, and the ability to read, modify, and troubleshoot existing logic. * **SCADA Capability:** Hands\-on experience with Ignition SCADA or a comparable platform, including tag architecture, screen development, historian configuration, and troubleshooting integration issues. * **Testing and Commissioning Rigor:** Proven ability to author and execute test procedures, drive discrepancies to closure, and make release decisions on the accuracy of your own verification. * **Field and Factory Judgment:** Comfort operating in active manufacturing and construction environments, with the credibility to work through installation and calibration issues directly with technicians, trades, and vendors. * **Documentation Discipline:** A track record of producing accurate, well\-documented deliverables that downstream construction and operations teams can rely on without rework. * **Mandatory Education:** A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Control Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * **Data Center or Mission\-Critical Experience:** Prior work on data center mechanical or electrical control systems, or in another high\-availability industrial environment. * **Modular or Prefabricated Delivery:** Experience supporting a productized or prefabricated equipment platform where design repeatability and factory verification drive schedule. * **Protocol Depth:** Practical fluency in Modbus TCP, BACnet, or OPC UA within multi\-vendor integration environments. * **Systems Integrator Perspective:** Experience on the integrator or EPC side of control system delivery, and an understanding of how scope, submittals, and acceptance criteria are negotiated. * **OT Cybersecurity Awareness:** Working knowledge of industrial network segmentation and OT security practices as applied to control system deployments. * **Professional Credentials:** Relevant certifications such as network certifications, Rockwell or Inductive Automation credentials. * **Mission Alignment:** A genuine interest in energy and AI infrastructure, and in the engineering rigor required to build it at speed. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $130,000 \-$150,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.description: **Expert Solutions Architect** **Wilmington, DE** **Monday – Friday 8:00 – 5:00 EDT** **Hybrid** The Expert Architect plays a critical leadership role in shaping the future\-state architecture of the Corporate and Legal Solutions (CLS) Technology Solutions Group. Working across Engineering, Product, and Business teams, you will drive architectural strategy, technology modernization, and platform evolution to enable the delivery of innovative products and capabilities. This role provides technical leadership through architecture governance, standards, and mentorship, helping teams build secure, resilient, and scalable solutions. Success is measured by the ability to influence outcomes, align technology decisions with business goals, and foster architectural excellence across the organization. **Some of the things you will be doing:** Best Practices \& Technologies * Partner with CLS application teams to guide architectural and design decisions, technology selection, and adoption of best practices and patterns, ensuring applications are scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, and aligned with CLS strategic objectives. * Respond promptly to requests for architectural guidance and technical consultation. * Proactively identify teams, initiatives, or challenges that could benefit from architectural support. * Facilitate collaboration across application teams to promote knowledge sharing, consistency, and successful project outcomes. * Leverage AI capabilities where appropriate to improve quality, productivity, innovation, and operational efficiency. Share best practices, lessons learned, and emerging AI opportunities across the CLS architecture community. * Collaborate with partner organizations across CLS and CSC (e.g., SRE, ET API Services, ET CIAM) to understand, align with, and leverage shared platforms, services, and standards that contribute to application success. * Continuously evaluate CLS applications, platforms, and development practices to identify opportunities to improve quality, security, performance, resiliency, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. * Present technical strategies, architecture recommendations, risks, and trade\-offs to senior technology and business leaders. Architecture Community * Provide architecture leadership across application, integration, data, and platform domains within the CLS portfolio. * Lead architecture reviews and design assessments to ensure adherence to CLS architectural principles, security standards, and engineering best practices. * Promote a culture of collaboration, architectural excellence, and continuous improvement. Priority Projects As an Agile organization, CLS generally has important, priority work (planned and unplanned) that may require assistance to complete. * Assist with analysis/research projects to produce recommendations, technology evaluations, risk assessments, or strategic recommendations. These efforts frequently inform strategic and technology decisions made by leadership. * Assist with tactical projects that need assistance and expertise. These can be stand\-alone mini\-projects or existing projects that require experienced, hands\-on assistance to achieve their goal(s). * Develop and maintain architectural roadmaps that balance business priorities, technical debt reduction, modernization initiatives, and cloud adoption strategies. Success Measures * Improved application reliability and resiliency * Increased technology reuse and standardization * Reduced technical debt * Accelerated delivery timelines * Adoption of architectural standards and best practices * Successful modernization of critical platforms Increased engineering productivity through AI and automation * **What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?** * 10\+ years of experience as a web application software developer/engineer * 5\+ years of experience as a team technical lead or software architect. * Strong technical expertise in web\-based application architecture, cloud\-native technologies, data architecture concepts, and Agile delivery methodologies (Scrum and Kanban). * Experience designing and supporting cloud\-native applications and distributed systems. * Understanding of application security, identity management, and secure\-by\-design principles. * Experience leveraging AI\-assisted development and architecture practices. * Strong written and oral communication skills. * Ability to change gears quickly, self\-motivate, and ensure progress on multiple concurrent projects. Communicate progress with your manager and teams with whom you participate. * Willingness to get involved in a variety of topics and projects. * Ability to establish rapport through professionalism, honesty, and respectful collaboration. Demonstrate the ability to influence technical decisions through collaboration, data\-driven recommendations, and diplomacy rather than direct authority. * \#CSC \#CSCCareers \#LI\-HL1

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** ==================== CVS Health is seeking a highly innovative, hands\-on, and technically accomplished Principal Data Scientist to serve as the senior technical leader for the Excalibur team, a strategic organization responsible for building advanced data, analytics, machine learning, and generative AI solutions that improve IT operations and productivity for more than 350,000 CVS Health colleagues. As a Principal Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of AI\-driven operational excellence across CVS Health. This role combines deep technical execution with people leadership, offering the opportunity to architect and deliver enterprise\-scale machine learning models, AI agents, advanced analytics platforms, and generative AI solutions that directly impact the colleague experience and technology operations across one of the largest healthcare organizations in the United States. The Principal Data Scientist will serve as the technical anchor for the Excalibur team, leveraging the Excalibur Data Lake, a unified Databricks platform that brings together colleague, application, operational, and telemetry data. You will personally design, build, deploy, and monitor production\-grade AI and machine learning solutions while leading and mentoring a team of talented data scientists, engineers, and analysts. This is an exciting opportunity for a Principal Data Scientist who wants to remain close to the code while influencing technical strategy, advancing enterprise AI maturity, and developing high\-performing teams. The role provides significant executive visibility, ownership of mission\-critical AI initiatives, exposure to cutting\-edge technologies, and the opportunity to create measurable business impact at enterprise scale. Success in this role will position you as a key technical leader driving the next generation of data and AI capabilities across CVS Health. **RESPONSIBILITIES** ==================== * Design, develop, deploy, and monitor machine learning models, predictive analytics solutions, and generative AI applications that improve IT operations, colleague productivity, and business outcomes. * Build and maintain scalable data pipelines, data products, and curated datasets on Databricks, transforming application, operational, and telemetry data into trusted enterprise assets. * Architect and deliver self\-service analytics, interactive reporting, and conversational "chat with your data" experiences that enable data\-driven decision making across technology and business teams. * Write and review production\-quality Python, SQL, and Spark code while establishing best practices for software engineering, data quality, testing, model development, AI governance, and MLOps. * Own the team's technical roadmap and drive architecture decisions related to machine learning approaches, feature engineering, model selection, validation strategies, AI frameworks, and platform design. * Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, engineers, architects, and technology leaders to prioritize opportunities, align technical solutions to business needs, and deliver measurable value. * Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of data scientists, engineers, and analysts through coaching, technical reviews, career development, and a culture of continuous learning and innovation. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** =========================== * 10\+ years in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or Advanced Analytics, delivering production\-ready solutions and measurable business outcomes within complex enterprise environments. * 6\+ years developing production\-quality solutions using Python, SQL, and Spark, including testing, version control, and software engineering best practices. * 4\+ years building scalable data pipelines, managing data quality at scale, and supporting cloud\-based data lake architectures, including 3\+ years with Databricks or a comparable modern data and AI platform. * 2\+ years designing and deploying Generative AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and related AI\-powered applications within enterprise environments. * 3\+ years leading or mentoring data scientists and engineers, conducting technical design and code reviews, building analytics and visualization solutions, and translating complex business challenges into machine learning, analytics, and AI products. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science,  omaly detection, recommendation, scoring, or optimization models within large\-scale enterprise environments. * Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, enterprise data governance, data sharing frameworks, and modern data management practices. * Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Publications, patents, conference presentations, open\-source contributions, or other demonstrated achievements in machine learning, analytics, artificial intelligence, or generative AI. **EDUCATION** ============= Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or equivalent work experience (High School Diploma/GED plus 4 years of relevant experience). **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** ===================== Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health**.** This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric healthcare for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make healthcare more personal, convenient, and affordable. We strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging every day. CVS Health is an affirmative action employer and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician\-owned businesses for which CVS Health provides management services. We do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotion, or any other personnel action based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active duty, veterans, reservists, National Guard members, and military spouses) to apply for CVS Health job opportunities. **Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $144,200\.00 \- $288,400\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/31/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of CVS Health's Retail and Pharmacy platforms. This role combines software engineering, operations, observability, and automation practices to proactively identify and resolve issues, improve system resilience, and support critical store operations. As part of the SRE organization, you will partner with application development, infrastructure, observability, and store operations teams to drive operational excellence, implement reliability engineering best practices, and enable highly scalable deployments across thousands of retail and pharmacy locations. **\*\*\*\*\*\*This position requires working in shifts and on weekends, with compensatory time off provided on weekdays.** **Key Responsibilities:** **Observability \& Monitoring** * Develop and implement proactive monitoring, alerting, and dashboarding strategies to detect issues before they impact store operations or customer experience. * Design and maintain operational dashboards using enterprise observability platforms. * Define, monitor, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and error budgets for critical business services. * Analyze platform telemetry, logs, traces, and metrics to improve service reliability and reduce operational risk. * Drive continuous improvements in observability maturity across Edge applications and services. **Reliability Engineering \& Incident Management** * Lead major incident response, recovery, and post\-incident reviews to minimize customer impact and prevent recurring issues. * Perform root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions through structured Problem Management practices. * Improve key operational metrics including Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), and service availability. * Collaborate with engineering teams to build reliability into applications throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). * Drive automation initiatives to reduce operational toil and improve system resiliency. **Performance \& Platform Optimization** * Identify and eliminate bottlenecks in development, testing, and deployment workflows. * Support performance tuning and capacity planning for Edge retail and pharmacy applications. * Analyze system behavior and implement improvements that enhance scalability, stability, and efficiency. * Partner with infrastructure teams to maintain highly available and resilient platform services. **Edge Platform Operations** * Support business\-critical applications deployed across CVS retail and pharmacy locations. * Collaborate with store operations and engineering teams to ensure seamless operation of Edge platforms. * Participate in on\-call rotations and provide technical leadership during production incidents. * Ensure operational readiness, deployment validation, and production support for new platform capabilities. **Cloud, Microservices \& Deployment Engineering** * Champion cloud\-native technologies and container\-based architectures. * Support and optimize Kubernetes and OpenShift environments operating in hybrid cloud ecosystems. * Leverage CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure\-as\-Code principles to enable automated, scalable deployments. * Promote best practices for microservices architecture, resiliency, and deployment automation. * Work closely with development teams to ensure services are observable, scalable, and production ready. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related technology roles. * 3\+ years of experience delivering and supporting large\-scale distributed systems utilizing reliability and resiliency concepts. * 2\+ years of experience with one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript. * 2\+ years of experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, Rancher, and containerized workloads. * Experience implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitLab, or similar platforms. * Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar technologies. * Strong scripting and automation skills using Shell, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent technologies. * Experience supporting microservices\-based and cloud\-native architectures. * Working knowledge of Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and ITIL\-based operational practices. * Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting retail, pharmacy, healthcare, or large\-scale edge computing environments. * Experience designing and implementing SLO, SLA, and Error Budget frameworks. * Knowledge of distributed tracing and observability best practices. * Experience driving platform modernization, reliability engineering initiatives, and operational excellence programs. * Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), Google SRE, or related cloud certifications. **Education** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, jobs.title: AI Engineer, Ontologies & Knowledge Graphs
jobs.description: **At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We are looking for an engineer who builds the data and interface layer that makes complex software products programmatically understandable. Many powerful products expose rich but heterogeneous surfaces — source code, scripting APIs, file formats, data structures, and workflow logic. This role builds pipelines that extract and transform those surfaces into structured, queryable knowledge — designing the schemas, constructing the knowledge graphs, and exposing them through clean, typed programmatic interfaces for downstream consumption. **Job Responsibilities** * Build ETL/ELT pipelines that extract data from source code, APIs, file formats, and documentation and load it into a structured knowledge store. * Design and maintain schemas and semantic data models capturing entities, relationships, and capabilities. * Construct and maintain knowledge graphs over heterogeneous product data. * Develop source and metadata parsers (including source\-code/AST parsing) to extract structure automatically. * Build typed programmatic interfaces and data\-access layers over the knowledge layer. * Implement retrieval and indexing layers (e.g., embeddings, RAG) over product knowledge. * Work with domain engineers to decompose complex product workflows into discrete, callable operations. * Assess data sources for coverage, quality, and schema completeness across multiple products. **Job Qualifications** * BS/MS in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or similar. * Strong Python; experience building and consuming REST APIs. * Experience building data pipelines (ETL/ELT) over structured and unstructured data. * Familiarity with graph databases and/or semantic/ontology modeling (RDF, OWL, property graphs, or equivalent). * Experience with at least one agent framework (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar). * Understanding of how LLMs consume context and call tools (retrieval, RAG, embeddings). * Exposure to CAE/FEA/CFD or a related physical\-simulation or engineering domain. * Comfortable working within unfamiliar or undocumented codebases. * Systems thinker — able to decompose a complex legacy workflow into discrete, callable steps. **Additional Skills/Preferences** Nice to have: * Vector databases. * Data\-access and API interface development. * Parsing structured file formats. * Surrogate modeling or related numerical methods. Deliberately not required: * Deep or specialist domain expertise beyond working familiarity — domain engineers provide that. * No PhD or ML research background required. **Additional Information** * Works across multiple products, building structured knowledge and interfaces over their capabilities. * Collaborates closely with domain engineers who provide subject\-matter expertise. * Works with data pipelines, graph databases, and product API surfaces. * Travel is not an expectation for this role. Occasional travel may occur for broad team alignment workshops, but these are infrequent. **We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.** -------------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: As a Principal Machine Learning Engineer I, you will design, build, and operate production ML systems at scale. You will turn advanced models for sequential and multi\-modal data into reliable products that power risk assessment, engagement, and event detection. You will partner with research, product, and platform teams to deliver measurable business impact across cloud and edge. CMT is looking for a **Principal Machine Learning Engineer I** to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life\-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT. **Qualifications:** * Master's degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in Data Science, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Mathematics * 7\+ years of professional experience in AI/ML * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing and deploying deep learning models with a strong portfolio in generative AI for sequential or spatio\-temporal data * Strong software engineering skills in Python * Must have at least two years of AWS experience and demonstrated knowledge of common AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, Athena, Redshift, etc * Must have at least 2 years of professional experience with computer languages such as Python, C\+\+, Scala, etc * Strong knowledge of SQL concepts, ability to comprehend and write complex SQL statements * Excellent problem solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration **Nice to Haves:** * Ph.D. in a relevant field. * Hands\-on experience with time\-series or multi\-modal architectures for sensor fusion and behavioral modeling * Background in self\-supervised learning on real\-world sensor data and physics\-informed modeling * Experience building large\-scale data processing and orchestration: Spark or Beam, Airflow, Kafka or Pub/Sub, Docker, and Kubernetes on AWS, GCP, or Azure * Publications in strong AI or ML venues **Compensation and Benefits:** * Fair and competitive salary based on skills and experience, and annual performance bonus * Equity may be awarded in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) * Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance, matching 401k, short\-term \& long\-term disability and parental leave * Unlimited Paid Time Off including vacation, sick days \& public holidays * Flexible scheduling and work from home policy depending on role and responsibilities **Base Salary Range** * The base salary range for this position is: $177,000 to $221,300\. This range is specifically for Cambridge, MA **A****dditional Perks:** * Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world * Join an industry leader — 65 million drivers protected, powering 140\+ programs across 25 countries * Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified * Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety * Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters * High ownership, small teams, and direct access to leadership — no layers between your work and its impact * Unlimited PTO, flexible scheduling, competitive salary, annual performance bonus, RSUs, and full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401k match * Summer Fridays provide team members with half days to recharge * Join one of our employee resource groups: Black, AAPI, LGBTQIA\+, Women, Book Club, and Health \& Wellness * Comprehensive wellness, education, and employee assistance programs **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:** At CMT, we believe the best ideas come from a mix of backgrounds and perspectives. We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace and culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their unique talents and perspectives. Diversity is essential to our success, and we actively seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our growing team. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability state. CMT is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. To learn more, visit www.cmtelematics.com and follow us on Instagram @cmt.ai **A****bout Cambridge Mobile Telematics:** Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world's largest telematics and AI company for safer mobility. Its mission is to make the world's roads and drivers safer. The company's AI\-driven platform, DriveWell Fusion®, proactively identifies and reduces driving risk, leading to fewer crashes and injuries. To date, CMT's technology has helped prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. CMT enables partners to measure risk, detect crashes, provide life\-saving assistance, and streamline claims. Headquartered in Cambridge, MA, CMT operates globally with offices in Budapest, Hungary; Chennai, India; Seattle, Washington; Tokyo, Japan; and Zagreb, Croatia. Learn more at www.cmt.ai.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect

We unite diverse skills and perspectives to transform how data, systems, and ingenuity enable each client to advance what’s possible in a changing world. As perceptive partners, our U.S\-based consultants find inspiration in the unknown and enjoy getting our hands dirty solving our clients’ myriad of challenges. Across industries and business goals, we fuse technical depth and analytical prowess with creative savvy to move clients forward. You will work closely with client stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership to drive successful outcomes across a variety of industries. and compliance * Define architecture standards, design patterns, and governance frameworks * Stay current on emerging AI trends and technologies **Qualifications** Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s experience designing and delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments * Experience with API design, microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) * Experience working with Frontier AI models, local and open source models * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their AI/ML services * Proficiency in multiple programming languages * Experience Legacy Systems and Architectures including SaaS Key Skills \& Competencies * Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills * Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value * Leadership and mentoring capabilities * Adaptability in fast\-paced, client\-facing environments What Success Looks Like * Delivering scalable, high\-impact AI solutions that drive measurable business outcomes * Building strong client relationships and becoming a trusted advisor * Contributing to the growth of AI capabilities and offerings within the firm * Enabling teams through best practices, innovation, and technical leadership **Additional Information** We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions. You decide where and how you want to develop, and we help get you there with customizable career progression and a comprehensive benefits package to support you along the way. Alongside our suite of traditional benefits encompassing generous PTO, health coverage, disability insurance, paid family leave and more, we’ve launched extended benefits to help meet our employees’ needs. * CapTech is committed to providing a flexible work environment and helping our employees achieve a work\-life balance that suits their individual needs. Employees must be available to work onsite in a client location or a CapTech office as requested. We allow CapTech employees to work remotely when compatible with CapTech and client needs. * Learning \& Development – Programs offering certification and tuition support, digital on\-demand learning courses, mentorship, and skill development paths * Modern Health –A mental health and well\-being platform that provides 1:1 care, group support sessions, and self\-serve resources to support employees and their families through life’s ups and downs * Carrot Fertility –Inclusive fertility and family\-forming coverage for all paths to parenthood – including adoption, surrogacy, fertility treatments, pregnancy, and more – and opportunities for employer\-sponsored funds to help pay for care * Fringe –A company paid stipend program for personalized lifestyle benefits, allowing employees to choose benefits that matter most to them – ranging from vendors like Netflix, Spotify, and GrubHub to services like student loan repayment, travel, fitness, and more * Employee Resource Groups – Employee\-led committees that embrace and incorporate diversity and inclusion into our day\-to\-day operations * Philanthropic Partnerships – Opportunities to engage in partnerships and pro\-bono projects that support our communities. * 401(k) Matching – Generous matching and no vesting period to help you continue to build financial wellness CapTech is committed to providing a flexible work environment and helping our employees achieve a work\-life balance that suits their individual needs. jobs.description: At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. **.** ----- **Location: 2** onsite role in **1 in Palo Alto, CA** and **1 in Irvine, CA** **About the job you’re considering:** We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Infotainment \& Telematics ECU Test Engineer to join our Automotive Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in electronics bench testing, ECU validation, and troubleshooting of Infotainment and Telematics systems. The role involves executing functional testing, validating ECU features, identifying defects, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure high\-quality automotive electronic systems. **Your Role:** * Perform bench\-level testing and validation of Infotainment and Telematics ECUs. * Set up and maintain test benches, validation environments, and laboratory equipment. * Develop, execute, and document functional test cases based on system requirements. * Validate Infotainment features such as audio, multimedia, connectivity, navigation, and user interfaces. * Perform Telematics testing including network connectivity, communication modules, and vehicle communication systems. * Analyze test results, identify defects, and track issues through closure. * Troubleshoot hardware and software issues using diagnostic and measurement tools. * Perform electrical measurements, signal analysis, and fault isolation activities. * Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and circuit documentation. * Support ECU flashing, software updates, configuration, and integration activities. * Conduct root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams to drive issue resolution. * Support regression testing for software releases and feature enhancements. * Prepare test reports, maintain documentation, and ensure compliance with quality standards. * Collaborate with Hardware, Software, System Engineering, and Quality Assurance teams to resolve technical issues. **.** ----- **Your skills and experience:** * Strong hands\-on experience in electronics bench testing / ECU testing * Good understanding of Infotainment and Telematics systems * Knowledge of automotive protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet) * Experience using test instruments (multimeter, oscilloscope, etc.) * Ability to read and interpret schematics and wiring diagrams * Basic knowledge of ECU flashing / diagnostics tools * Basic knowledge of electronics principles. * Basic knowledge of Ohm's Law, voltage, current, resistance, and circuit analysis. * Ability to identify and understand basic electronic components including: Resistors ; Capacitors ;Inductors ;
