jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Windows is where most of the world's developers build, and the agentic era is rewriting what they need from the platform underneath them. Coding agents, local inference, containerized toolchains and AI\-native workflows are all arriving at once — and the engineering organizations adopting them fastest are the ones whose experience should be shaping Windows. The Windows Platform and Developers (WPD) organization is standing up a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close that loop directly. Forward Deployed Engineers embed with strategic partners and enterprise developer organizations, build alongside their engineers inside their environments, and own the outcome: the customer's developers and agents running production workloads on Windows. We are measured on adoption. Not revenue, not renewals, not tickets closed. When a customer's engineering organization moves a real workload onto Windows and keeps it there, that is the result. This is a founding team. The engineers who join it will define the engagement model rather than inherit one. As a **Senior Software Engineer, Forward Deployed,** you will own engagements end to end — discovery through production — and carry the team's depth on **agentic workloads on Windows:** coding agents, agent runtimes, local and hybrid inference, and the AI\-native development loops that partners and enterprise engineering teams are standing up right now. You are the person who can sit with a customer's platform team, understand why their agents run worse on Windows than elsewhere, and then go fix it — in their code, in ours, or in both. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Employees who live within fifty miles of the Redmond campus must be in the office for a minimum of 3 days per week. **Responsibilities** **Own forward\-deployed engagements end to end** * Discover: embed with a customer's engineering organization to understand their development workflow, their constraints, and what is actually blocking adoption. Establish a clear technical problem statement, a baseline, agreed success measures, and a plan. * Build: design and implement solutions alongside the customer's engineers. Write the automation, configuration, provisioning logic, integrations and reference implementations. Apply real engineering standards — security, privacy, maintainability, supportability — to work that will outlive the engagement. * Validate: prove the improvement in the customer's environment with measurement they agree with, not with a demo. **Carry the team's depth on the developer platform** * Be the team's authority on how real development happens on Windows at enterprise scale: WSL and WSLC, containers and virtualization, developer machine provisioning and configuration, toolchain and build performance, CI and inner\-loop latency, and the identity, security and endpoint\-policy controls that constrain all of it. * Diagnose the friction that drives developer populations off Windows — whether it originates in the platform, in enterprise configuration, in tooling, or in a gap between them — and fix it at the right layer. * Build the artifacts customers deploy in production: configuration baselines, provisioning automation, diagnostic tooling, reference environments. **Close the loop with product engineering** * Bring evidence back to Windows, WSL, developer tooling and security product teams with enough rigour — reproductions, traces, measurements, business impact — that it changes what they build. * Drive fixes, supportability improvements and telemetry additions through to shipping. You keep accountability for the customer outcome, not just the handoff. **Scale what works** * Identify the patterns that repeat across customers and convert them into playbooks, reference configurations, tooling and guidance that serve a far larger population than the accounts you touched. * Transfer expertise to other FDEs, to Microsoft field and support teams, and to product groups, so each engagement raises the capability of everyone around it. **Deliver measurable adoption outcomes** * Demonstrate adoption through production developer workloads, telemetry, customer evidence or agreed success measures. * Build trusted relationships with customer technical leaders, platform teams and the developers themselves — the kind where you get told what is really wrong. * Communicate findings, tradeoffs, risks and progress clearly to customer engineers, engineering leaders, Microsoft field teams and executives. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages inclu  Java, JavaScript, or Python. + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: * + **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications** * Production experience building or deploying systems powered by large language models (LLMs) — agent development, prompt and context engineering, evaluation frameworks, tool and MCP integration, and deployment at scale. * Solid programming ability in Python and at least one of TypeScript, C\#, Rust, Go, C or C\+\+, with a record of shipping production software. * Experience in a customer\-facing engineering role — forward deployed engineering, field engineering, technical consulting, escalation engineering, solutions architecture, or as a technical founder — working directly with another organization's engineers in their environment. * Technical knowledge of the Windows developer platform, including several of: Windows Subsytem for Linus (WSL), containers and virtualization, developer environment and configuration, toolchain and build performance, local inference and hardware acceleration, and the security and policy controls that shape developer machines in an enterprise. * Experience diagnosing performance and reliability problems using structured methods — telemetry, traces, profiling, Windows Performance Analyzer or comparable tooling — in systems you did not write. * Demonstrated ability to turn a solution built for one customer into something repeatable that benefits many. * Experience representing customer needs in product planning and shifting engineering priorities using technical evidence and business impact. * High agency and comfort with ambiguity — this team does not yet have a playbook, and the first people here will write it. * The judgement and emotional intelligence to hold a hard conversation with a customer without losing the relationship or the truth. * Familiarity with the Windows app platform — WinUI, WPF, .NET desktop — and with application modernization. Not required for this role, but valuable when a customer's adoption conversation turns to their existing app estate. * Evidence of learning hard things fast. We do not expect anyone to arrive with every skill listed here. A solid track record of acquiring depth quickly counts as much as depth you already have. \#W\+DJOBS Software Engineering IC4 \- The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $119,800 \- $234,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 \- $261,000 per year. Our infrastructure is supported by more than 300 datacenters around the world that enable services for more than 1 billion customers in over 90 countries. The Cloud Supply Chain Engineering (CSCP\-E) group is an exciting and fast\-evolving engineering group within Microsoft that powers Microsoft’s Cloud\-first mission. We are responsible for supporting the supply chain that powers Microsoft's cloud infrastructure. This is a great opportunity to join a dynamic team and influence the way one of the world’s largest and fastest growing cloud environments is built and supported. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – BMaaS & Datacenter Networking
jobs.description: **Company Description** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** **About the Team** Our engineering team builds next\-generation, cloud\-native bare\-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo\-cloud environments. We operate on a T\-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross\-domain code reviews, and dependable on\-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open\-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work. We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry\-first operational culture. **Role Overview** We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T\-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high\-density, high\-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare\-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset. **Core Responsibilities** * Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production\-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go. * Architecture \& API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non\-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas. * Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms. * Observability \& Diagnostics: Instrument services end\-to\-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root\-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems. * Quality \& Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review\-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock\-driven testing. **Qualifications** **Technical Qualifications** * Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go. * Data \& APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution. * Concurrency \& Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock\-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock\-driven testing discipline. * Datacenter Protocols \& OS: Expertise in BGP, MP\-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands\-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first\-class NVUE client). * DPU \& Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host\-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs). * High\-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX\-M partitioning, and RoCEv2\. * Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services). * Cloud \& Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus. * Provisioning \& Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation. * Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware). * Linux Systems Internals: In\-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices. * Identity \& Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC. * Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM. * Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube\-rs or controller\-runtime with CRD\-driven reconciliation loop patterns. **Universal Requirements** * Testing Discipline: Commitment to test\-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external hardware and network dependencies. * Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross\-functional design reviews. **Educational \& Experience Baseline** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience in cloud\-native platforms, systems programming, networking, or infrastructure automation. * Demonstrated participation or maintainership in open\-source systems projects is a plus. **Additional Information** **What does Mirantis offer you?** * Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry; * Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next\-generation cloud technologies; * Be a part of cutting\-edge, open\-source innovation; * Thrive in the high\-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk\-taking, and continuous growth are valued; * Professional development and training; * Attend conferences and working groups; * Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks; * Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan. jobs.title: Fixed Income Division - Analyst, Municipal Markets (New York)
jobs.description: Join a quantitative team supporting a large municipal bond market\-making desk. We work alongside traders across electronic and voice trading, bond origination, specialized lending, and bespoke derivative products. Our team uses mathematics, statistics, machine learning, and software to solve practical trading problems. We analyze trading strategies, build electronic trading algorithms, model the financial risks associated with the desk’s inventory, and conduct detailed analysis of trading profits and losses. Municipal markets offer particularly interesting quantitative challenges. Many securities trade infrequently, bonds differ across numerous structural features, and available market data can be incomplete. We develop mathematical models that connect observable market variables to bond prices, helping the trading desk estimate value, identify relative\-value opportunities, manage risk, and make better trading decisions. **The Role** As a Quantitative Strategist, you will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, and engineers. You will use data and statistical analysis to identify potential trading strategies, assist with complex trades and hedging decisions, and improve the models and systems used to price securities and monitor risk. You will also help organize and maintain the team’s quantitative research environment, including its modeling software, research archive, Python packages, Linux environment, containers and testing. The role includes both immediate desk\-facing analysis and longer\-term research into trading strategies and market behavior. **Responsibilities** * Research and test quantitative trading strategies. * Help traders evaluate complex transactions, hedge selection, position sizing, and execution timing. * Develop pricing and risk models for municipal bonds, bond derivatives, and related products. * Analyze inventory risk, trading activity, and profit\-and\-loss performance. * Apply statistics and machine learning to trading, pricing, and risk\-management problems. * Help move machine\-learning and AI models into production. * Organize and maintain quantitative models, research code, and development environments. * Communicate analytical findings clearly to traders and other stakeholders. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in mathematics. * Strong knowledge of probability, statistics, numerical methods, and mathematical modeling. * Good programming skills, preferably in Python. * Familiarity with, or an interest in learning, Linux, Git, package management, containers, pandas, and NumPy. * Strong interest in trading and financial markets. * The ability to take ownership of software, models, and research processes. * Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills. * A collaborative personality and an interest in working closely with PEOPLE on trading desk. * Ability to stay calm under pressure * Positive, can do, extrovert personality * Experience with fixed income, derivatives, bond mathematics, JavaScript, kdb\+/q, machine learning, or production model deployment is helpful but not required. * Recent graduates and candidates with up to three years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. Prior municipal bond experience is not required. **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:** At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser. Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $110,000 and $125,000 per year at the commencement of employment for Analyst. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long\-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs. Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents. Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences. For more information, please visit : https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo .

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Network Deployment & Automation
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world! NVIDIA's Enterprise Infrastructure organization is seeking a Director, Enterprise Network Deployment \& Automation to own the global deployment of NVIDIA's enterprise network — across office sites, data centers, CM (contract manufacturing) facilities, the global backbone, SD\-WAN, campus, and DC edge — and to lead the build\-out of agentic AI and automation capabilities that scale capacity planning, design, deployment, and Day 2 change operations. Reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise Networking, this leader will translate network architecture and strategy into repeatable, automated, and globally delivered deployment programs that keep pace with NVIDIA's growth. **What you'll be doing:** * Global deployment ownership: Own end\-to\-end network deployment execution across all site types — corporate offices, campuses, HPC data centers, CM/manufacturing facilities, labs — spanning the global backbone, SD\-WAN/POP/WAN, campus, and DC edge. * Capacity planning \& rollout: Build and scale a program that plans, designs, and deploys network capacity ahead of business demand, coordinating with Real Estate, Facilities, and Data Center Engineering on site timelines. * Agentic AI \& automation: Lead the design and build of agentic AI and automation tooling to transform how the team plans capacity, designs configurations, delivers deployments, and manages Day 2 changes — reducing manual toil and human error. * Standardization \& repeatability: Establish standardized, repeatable deployment methodologies (reference architectures, golden configs, automated validation/turn\-up testing) so every new site, POP, or edge deployment follows a consistent, high\-quality playbook. * Operational metrics \& SLOs: Define and track deployment SLAs, automation coverage, and change\-success metrics; build observability into the deployment pipeline itself, not just the steady\-state network. * Day 2 change management: Manage the day\-to\-day execution of Day 2 network changes (moves/adds/changes, capacity augments, lifecycle refreshes) through automated, low\-touch workflows with strong change governance. * Team building: Recruit, mentor, and grow a globally distributed team of deployment engineers, automation engineers, and program managers; build career paths and technical depth across regions. * Multi\-functional partnership: Work closely with the Senior Director, Enterprise Networking and peer leaders across Architecture, Security, Cloud Engineering, and Site Reliability to ensure deployment plans align with the broader network strategy and roadmap. * Vendor \& partner management: Manage vendor and contractor relationships for physical deployment work (cabling, hardware staging, installation partners) across a global site footprint. **What we need to see:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent experience. * 13\+ years of overall experience in network engineering, deployment, or infrastructure operations, with 6\+ years of leadership experience managing distributed technical teams. * Hands\-on depth in enterprise networking domains relevant to deployment: LAN/WLAN, SD\-WAN/WAN, campus and DC edge, and global backbone connectivity. * Track record of standing up new physical sites (offices, data centers, CM facilities) end\-to\-end, from design through turn\-up. * Direct experience building or deploying network automation and/or AI\-driven tooling to reduce manual deployment and change effort at scale. * Experience managing Day 2 operations — change management, capacity augments, lifecycle refresh — for a large, geographically distributed network footprint. * Proven ability to build and scale high\-performing, globally distributed engineering and deployment teams. * Strong program and vendor management skills, with experience coordinating multi\-site rollouts against aggressive timelines. * Clear communication skills, able to align multi\-functional partners (Real Estate, Facilities, Security, Cloud Engineering) around deployment plans and tradeoffs. **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience deploying network infrastructure for HPC/AI data centers or GPU\-dense compute environments (InfiniBand, Spectrum\-X, RDMA/RoCE). * Background building agentic AI workflows or AI\-assisted automation (e.g., AI agents for network design validation, config generation, or change execution) rather than only traditional scripted automation. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and automation toolchains (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Netconf/YANG) applied specifically to deployment and turn\-up pipelines. * Track record operating in a hyperscale or large enterprise environment supporting rapid physical expansion — new office builds, lab stand\-ups, and data center deployments — on a global scale. * Familiarity with CM (contract manufacturing) facility networking requirements and constraints. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 284,000 USD \- 425,500 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 20, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: NVR, Inc. is seeking an experienced **Software Engineer** to work **on site in Pittsburgh, PA.** NVR’s technology teams build and support the applications, integrations, and technology platforms that enable critical business operations across the company. Join NVR Technology and be part of a collaborative team where engineers work closely with business partners, take ownership of their solutions, and have a direct impact on how the business operates. **Summary** As a Software Engineer, you will be part of a small, highly collaborative team responsible for developing and supporting technology solutions for NVR’s Mortgage and Settlement businesses. The role has a strong focus on backend application development and enterprise integrations. You will build and maintain applications, services, APIs, and integrations that connect internal systems with third\-party mortgage and settlement platforms. You will work directly with product team members, business stakeholders, and other technology teams to understand business needs and deliver reliable, maintainable solutions. The ideal candidate is a strong software developer who can independently own their work, solve problems, communicate effectively, and collaborate well within a small team. **Key Job Responsibilities** * Design, develop, enhance, and support applications and backend services using .NET, C\#, SQL, and Microsoft technologies. * Develop and maintain APIs and system integrations connecting internal applications with third\-party mortgage, settlement, and financial services platforms. * Develop system plugins and extensions using JavaScript. * Work directly with Product Managers, business stakeholders, and fellow engineers to understand requirements and translate business needs into effective technical solutions. * Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support. * Troubleshoot application and integration issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions. * Write maintainable, well\-tested code and participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of engineering practices. * Take ownership of assigned work from initial design through implementation and production support. * Collaborate effectively within a small, cross\-functional team and contribute to a culture of shared accountability and continuous learning. **Job Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional software development experience building and supporting enterprise applications. * Strong development experience with C\#, .NET, JavaScript, and SQL Server. * Experience developing backend applications, services, APIs, and enterprise system integrations. * Experience effectively using modern AI\-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot or similar tools, to improve development productivity while maintaining strong engineering judgment, code quality, and security. * Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and cloud\-based application development. * Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot technical problems and deliver high\-quality solutions. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work directly with both technical teams and business stakeholders. * Ability to work effectively in a small, collaborative team, take ownership of assigned work, and adapt as business priorities evolve. * Experience within the mortgage, lending, title, or settlement industry is a plus. * Experience developing, integrating with, or supporting the Encompass Loan Origination System (LOS) is a plus. **Life at NVR:** As the parent company of **Ryan Homes**, **NVHomes** and **Heartland Homes**, NVR is committed to your success and we will give you the tools, training, and industry knowledge you need to excel and thrive. Our management team is tenured and talented, nearly 80% of them promoted from within, so you will have mentors who can share their knowledge, and provide career guidance and encouragement. NVR offers traditional benefits, among the best in the industry. In addition, we offer all employees stock ownership through a profit sharing trust as part of our retirement savings package. NVR has had the highest Earnings Per Share growth rate in the homebuilding industry for the past 10 years, so as we grow financially, so do you! **View more about our exceptional culture and comprehensive benefits at** **https://www.nvrcareers.com/** **.** We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Drug Testing and Credit Check are required. Applicants must be legally entitled to work in the United States, as NVR does not provide visa sponsorship. *This position pays $95,000\-105,000 per year. Individual pay is determined by factors including the candidate’s job\-related skills, experience, relevant education, and location.* \#LI\-Onsite

But it’s so much more than that. National Grid supplies us with the environment to make it happen. This position can be located in Waltham, MA, Brooklyn, NY, Hicksville, NY, or Syracuse, NY** (candidates may also reside in either Connecticut, New Jersey, New Hampshire, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, or Maine). If you yearn to be innovative, contribute new ideas, and play a critical part in our Technology \& Innovation organization, we want to hear from you! ### **What you'll do** As Microsoft 365 Platform Engineer, you'll provide strategic and technical leadership for Microsoft 365 Content, Collaboration, Digital Productivity, and emerging AI\-enabled workplace capabilities within the Digital Workplace Services organization. effectively across related digital workplace technologies including SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph, Copilot, and related Microsoft 365 services. * Lead the design, engineering, implementation, and lifecycle management of Microsoft 365 services and strategic initiatives within the Content and Collaboration portfolio. * Drive engineering decisions and platform roadmaps that balance current business needs with long\-term strategic objectives, technical debt reduction, security, scalability, and operational supportability. * Partner closely with Architecture, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, Security, Operations, and delivery teams to provide a secure, reliable, and world\-class end\-user experience. * Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and Microsoft roadmap capabilities, providing recommendations for platform modernization, automation, AI enablement, and continuous improvement. * Design and implement automation solutions utilizing Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, scripting, APIs, and related technologies to improve operational efficiency and user experience. * Provide technical leadership and troubleshooting support for complex platform issues, serving as an escalation point for critical incidents and service disruptions. * Develop and maintain strong working relationships with vendors, business stakeholders, technology leaders, and strategic partners. * Establish and maintain engineering standards, architectural patterns, operational procedures, documentation, and governance practices. * Promote and support Microsoft 365 adoption through technical guidance, communications, training materials, and engagement with Business Enablement teams. * Ensure solutions align with enterprise security, compliance, information governance, and data protection requirements. * Support the introduction and adoption of emerging Microsoft capabilities including Copilot, AI\-powered productivity services, automation platforms, and future digital workplace technologies. * Collaborate with Operations teams to ensure successful service transition, operational readiness, knowledge transfer, and continual service improvement utilizing ITIL and established engineering practices. ### **About you** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. * 5\+ years of experience supporting or engineering Microsoft 365 collaboration platforms in an enterprise environment. * Experience with Microsoft 365 technologies including SharePoint Online, Teams, Exchange Online, OneDrive, and with exposure to Power Platform or related automation capabilities. * Experience with PowerShell or comparable scripting, API integration, or platform automation technologies. * Experience utilizing source control and modern engineering practices, including GitHub, version control, automation pipelines, testing, and change management processes * Experience working within Agile or product\-oriented delivery models. Review our digital benefit guide at**ngbenefitslivebrighter.com** for full details and descriptions. jobs.description: If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.**Nationwide Pet is looking to add a QE to the team. Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Playwright, Experience testing Angular or comparable single\-page applications, Experience testing REST APIs, JSON payloads, authentication, error handling, schemas, CRUD operations, and service integrations, Proficiency with Postman, Bruno, or Playwright API testing. Experience integrating automated tests into GitHub Actions, Harness, Jenkins, or equivalent CI/CD tools. Experience transitioning or maintaining existing Tosca automation while building code\-based Playwright automation.** **This role supports our Pet business and will align with Pacific Time (PT) business hours.** **The position may be based in Columbus, Ohio; Des Moines, Iowa; or Scottsdale, Arizona. Current remote associates will also be considered. This role follows a hybrid work model, with employees working in the office two days per week.** **Job Description Summary** If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry\-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you! As a Quality Engineer, you’ll plan and conduct a wide range of software quality tests and analyses to ensure all application products and services meet organizational standards aligned to their quality management approach, as well as, end\-user requirements. All Quality Engineers perform quality planning, quality design, and execution. You’ll focus on a blend of skills enabling efficient execution of risk\-based testing, test automation, performance testing, test data management, test environment management, continuous integration, and continuous deployment, all aimed at improving delivery speed for our business partners.**Job Description** **Key Responsibilities:** * Partners with architects to shape solution options, ensure product roadmaps and capabilities align with target architecture and technical guardrails, and proactively surface architectural impacts and trade\-offs during planning. * Designs, tests, and operationalizes high\-value quality engineering use cases that are ethically sound, data\-informed, and tightly aligned to client outcomes, product strategies, and operating models. * Conducts rigorous, ongoing analysis of testing trends, automation capabilities, and emerging technologies, translating insights into clear recommendations, business cases, and product strategies that shape client roadmaps and high\-impact consulting engagements. * Ensures systems and services meet organizational standards and end\-user requirements. * Reviews requirements, user stories, and technical artifacts to support test design and automation. * Applies secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities. * Defines and executes test strategies using a mix of manual, automated, and exploratory approaches to accelerate delivery. * Utilizes standard QE tools for test data, automation, performance, security, and regression testing. * Manages defects end to end, including identification, prioritization, tracking, and resolution. * Validates test results, maintains traceability from requirements to outcomes, and ensures quality coverage. Reports on results for stakeholders. * Coordinates test execution, environments, and release validation, including backout planning. * Drives continuous improvement, supports CI/CD pipelines, and ensures efficiency without compromising quality. * Aligns with testing architecture and complies with release management governance and timelines. May perform other responsibilities as assigned. **Reporting Relationships:** Reports to a Technology Manager or Director. **Typical Skills and Experiences:** **Education**: Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, or a related field are preferred. **License/Certification/Designation:** Technology certifications including TOSCA Automated Specialist 1 (AS1\), TOSCA Automated Specialist 2 (AS2\), or other related designations are preferred. **Experience**: Four or more years of experience using test optimization and automation processes and tools. Demonstrated experience in testing for agile teams, inc ge of planning. Ability to solve problems and set priorities as needed. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge is a plus. Other criteria, including leadership or technical skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence. Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner. **Values**: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values. **Job Conditions:** **Overtime Eligibility:** Exempt (Not Eligible). **Working Conditions**: Hybrid to normal office environment. Some travel may be required. **ADA**: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties. **Benefits** We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision, life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro\-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company\-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. For more information on the Iowa Smokefree Air Act, individuals may contact the Smokefree Air Act Helpline at 888\-944\-2247\. **NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES:** We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Entry Level
jobs.description: Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today! **Job Description** ------------------- The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is seeking a motivated entry\-level software engineer to join the team. In this role, you will work among a strong software team to design, develop, and support a catalog of embedded, user interface, and internal software components for use in various propulsion plant applications. The candidate should have strong programming understanding and experience in an object\-oriented programming language (C\+\+ preferred), understanding of embedded software design and application, and familiarity with modern software development processes including Agile Scrum, CI/CD build pipelines, and software testing. Further, demonstrated strong interpersonal skills and team working are necessary in this role. This position offers the opportunity to grow your technical skills while contributing to impactful, mission\-focused work in a supportive environment that values teamwork, professional development, and engineering excellence. **Required Combination of Knowledge and Skill** ----------------------------------------------- Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field.**Preferred Skills** -------------------- Preferred degree in Computer Engineering or Software Engineering GPA of 3\.2 or higher Demonstrated understanding of Object\-oriented programming (C\+\+ preferred) Understanding of embedded software and basic programmable hardware. Familiarity with modern software development processes and principles. Demonstrated software troubleshooting and debugging skills. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * Health, Dental, Vision \& Voluntary Benefits * Disability, Life \& Accident Insurance * 401(k) Savings program \& Capital Accumulation Plan * Personal \& Medical Time Off * Paid Parental Leave * Flexible Work Schedules * Tuition Assistance for Eligible Employees * Student Debt Benefit Personal Time Off Sell Program * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Wellness Program * Visit us online to view all NNL benefits! **Pay Range** ------------- $63,900\.00 \- $97,800\.00 annually Salary information provided is a general guideline only. Annual salary is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is operated for the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) by Fluor Marine Propulsion, LLC (FMP), a wholly owned subsidiary of Fluor Corporation. Naval Nuclear Laboratory personnel are FMP employees who work at four DOE facilities: Bettis Atomic Power Laboratory, Knolls Atomic Power Laboratory, Kenneth A. Kesselring Site, and Naval Reactors Facility, and at the U.S. Department of Defense\-owned Nuclear Power Training Unit\-Charleston. FMP employees also have an established presence at numerous shipyards and vendor locations. For nearly 70 years, the Naval Nuclear Laboratory has developed advanced nuclear propulsion technology, provided technical support, and trained world\-class nuclear operators to ensure the safe and reliable operation of our nation's submarine and aircraft carrier Fleets. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is a national asset solely dedicated to the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program. We rely on the dedication and innovation of our nearly 8000 engineers, scientists, technicians, and support personnel. All candidates must be U.S. citizens. Applicants selected will be subject to a Federal background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified matter. FMP is a government contractor and maintains a drug free workplace and workforce. All candidates must be able to pass a drug test in compliance with FMP company policy and 10 CFR 707\. Marijuana is a Federal Schedule I controlled substance and illegal under Federal Law. Therefore, FMP is required to test for marijuana. Fluor Marine Propulsion, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other criteria protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description: **About Nebius:** Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D. **The role** ------------ Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production. You will own our enterprise product: the roadmap for what large customers need, and the control plane that makes it possible. These are the capabilities that decide whether a large customer can adopt us, trust us, and expand with us. Our product is an API, and our enterprise buyer is an engineering organization. The people you build for are platform teams, architects, and the developers inside those companies who are putting agents into production. You need to be comfortable making product decisions about API surfaces, developer workflows, and technical tradeoffs, not only about business requirements. To build this well, you have to be in the room. You will work alongside customer success, sales, and our forward\-deployed engineers, who are in these accounts every week and already know where we fall short, and you will spend real time with customers alongside them. Delivery and implementation stay with forward\-deployed engineering and go\-to\-market. Your job is to turn what you learn into product. The hard part is judgment. Knowing which request is one account's edge case, and which one is the thing every enterprise customer will ask for six months from now. Getting that right is the difference between a platform and a pile of custom work. In your first year, we expect you to own a clear enterprise roadmap, ship the controls that block deals today, and become the person the go\-to\-market team comes to before a deal gets stuck. This is a hands\-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. The product team is small, so you will work directly with the engineers building your roadmap and with the go\-to\-market teams selling it. **Your responsibilities will include** -------------------------------------- * Own the enterprise roadmap: what we build for large customers, in what order, and why. * Own the platform behind it: organizations and identity, keys and quotas, spend controls, usage observability and audit, policy enforcement, and data residency. * Make product decisions on our API surface for enterprise use, so that the developers inside those accounts can build on us without friction. * Work with customer success, sales, and forward\-deployed engineering to understand what enterprise customers need, and spend time in accounts alongside them to see it first hand. * Tell the difference between a single\-account request and a pattern worth building for, and be able to defend the call either way. * Hand off what belongs to another product area, with the evidence that makes it actionable. * Give sales and marketing the positioning, materials, and product understanding they need to sell a technical product well. * Represent enterprise customers in roadmap decisions with evidence rather than anecdote. **We expect you to have** ------------------------- * 6\+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful part of it spent on enterprise products in B2B, developer platform, or API businesses. * Experience building developer\-facing or API products, with real understanding of what makes an API good to build against. * Experience building platform capabilities that enterprises depend on, such as identity, permissions, quotas, usage controls, audit, or compliance. * A track record of working with large enterprise accounts, including recognized logos, and turning what you learned into shipped product. * Credibility with technical buyers: platform teams, architects, security, and procurement. * Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval fit into agentic workflows. Hands\-on technical background is a strong plus. * The ability to turn many messy customer conversations into one clear, prioritized product argument. * Proven ability to drive alignment without formal authority, including with product owners who do not report to you. **It will be a bonus if you have** ---------------------------------- * Background as a forward\-deployed engineer, solutions engineer, or solutions architect before moving into product. * Experience in search, information retrieval, or NLP. * Experience in API\-first businesses running both self\-serve and enterprise motions. * Experience building for regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, or healthcare. **Benefits \& Perks:** * Competitive compensation * Career growth and learning opportunities * Flexibility and ownership * Collaborative and innovative culture * Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects * International environment and talented teams **What's it like to work at Nebius:** Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI **Equal Opportunity Statement:** Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. We are seeking a Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join our high\-performance engineering organization as a full\-time, hands\-on individual contributor. In this role, you will be embedded within a cross\-functional team owning critical segments of our consumer ecosystem. Our engineering organization is structured so that each domain team owns its vertical stack end\-to\-end—from backend microservices and APIs through frontend and DevOps. We are looking for an engineer with genuine depth across all layers of the stack who can move seamlessly between backend logic and rich frontend experiences, contributing independently within their first few weeks. Beyond technical skills, we want someone who is innovative, proactive, and self\-driven—an engineer who actively seeks out better tools, raises quality standards, and delivers without waiting for direction. We place a premium on self\-learners who challenge the status quo, take genuine pride in the reliability of what they ship, and comfortably navigate ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment. Potential Teams you will get to work on: * New Constructions * The Focus: Powering the leading builder listing platform in the US, empowering a diverse range of consumers to discover and customize their dream homes. * What You’ll Work On: Building hyper\-customized web experiences for vibrant new communities, optimizing high\-velocity frontends for substantial traffic and search engine optimization (SEO), enhancing backend services, modernizing infrastructure, expanding automated test suites, and engineering automated developer toolchains for instantaneous cloud service provisioning. * Mortgage \& Financial Services * The Focus: Building the digital future of home financing by creating seamless, secure, and transparent financial tools for buyers and lenders. * What You’ll Work On: High\-traffic loan origination flows, real\-time rate and affordability calculators, secure lead capture systems, compliance\-aware data architecture, and deep integrations with third\-party lender partner APIs. * Rentals Post\-Lead \& B2B Partnerships * The Focus: Powering what happens after the lead \- building the products and backend services that turn renter interest into completed applications and drive rental revenue for property managers and independent landlords. * What You’ll Work On: Partner\-facing portals and promoted\-listing products, external partner integrations (application and listing providers), GraphQL services and backend infrastructure at scale, revenue\-diversification features, and the data pipelines behind partner performance and reporting. What You’ll Do: * Product Delivery: Design, build, and maintain high\-traffic features and partner integrations across the full vertical stack (backend, APIs, frontend, infrastructure, databases). * Engineering Excellence: Write well\-tested, production\-ready code. Own and enforce test automation standards (unit, integration, E2E) in line with an engineering\-owned quality model. * Operational Ownership: Take full accountability for the operational quality, observability, and reliability of your services—including setting SLOs, monitoring, alerting, and incident response readiness. * Data \& Security: Ensure data integrity, secure engineering practices, and compliance\-aware design when handling sensitive consumer, financial, and high\-volume marketplace data. * Modern Workflow Innovation: Leverage and champion the adoption of AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Windsurf, Portkey, Gemini) to optimize development workflows. * Leadership \& Collaboration: Drive project delivery with strong personal ownership—managing scope, timelines, and cross\-functional dependencies. Communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders to build trust quickly. What You'll Bring: * Experience: Bring 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and scaling distributed systems and high\-traffic, consumer\-facing products. * True Full\-Stack Capability: Demonstrate proven depth across backend services, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, modern frontend frameworks (React or equivalent), and cloud/DevOps. * Backend Expertise: Utilize your strong experience with Node.js and microservice architectures. * Domain Background: Leverage your experience building search, marketplace, listing\-based, or financial services products (e.g., loan application flows, rate calculators, lender/partner API integrations). * Operational Rigor: Take direct ownership of production infrastructure, including observability, SLOs, and incident management. * Execution: Apply strong project management skills to independently drive features from scoping through delivery in an agile, matrixed environment. * Education: Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. * AI Tools: Hands\-on experience integrating AI\-assisted development tools into your daily workflow. * Data Architecture: Familiarity with event\-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS) and data pipelines (e.g., Snowflake, S3, Aurora, reverse ETL). * Cloud \& DevOps: Experience deploying and operating services on AWS using Kubernetes and containerization. * Advanced API Design: Familiarity with federated GraphQL architecture. * Compliance Awareness: Understanding of financial data sensitivity and compliance considerations relevant to consumer financial products (e.g., RESPA, TILA awareness). * Culture: Comfort working in a data\- and metrics\-driven engineering culture aligned with performance KPIs. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work three or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. You’ll help build the technical foundation for the responsible adoption of these tools by supporting areas such as configuration, identity and access, licensing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and data protection, while partnering with security, compliance, data and business teams. As a resource within our collaborative ITS team, you’ll serve as an escalation point for more complex issues, share your expertise through cross\-training, and contribute to a variety of technology projects and initiatives. You’ll also have opportunities to take ownership of well\-defined infrastructure initiatives, making this a great role for an experienced systems professional who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and helping shape a secure and modern technology environment. **Key Responsibilities:** * Determine system specifications and design, implement, and plan software/hardware upgrades to the system infrastructure. * Monitors and maintains server backup and server disaster recovery systems. * Ensure software license compliance for the systems in the organization. * Plans and performs Application and System upgrades/updates. * Ensures all servers are fully functional and secure at all times. * Ensures all network security software applications are functioning correctly. * Escalates issues to appropriate staff and/or vendors as needed. * Responds to health and performance monitoring alerts for all systems. * Ensures all systems and hardware are up to date with regard to OS patches and vendor updates. * Maintain application servers including vendor updates and new software installations. * Continually practices proper security procedures with respect to Internet access, data access, anti\-virus protection, user password protection, file system rights and permissions, and intrusion detection. * Evaluates, manages and implements vendor contracts and agreements to assure proper requirements and services are provided. * Works with other IT personnel in problem resolution and assists with level 2 help desk support requests. * Support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, licensing, service health, administration, security, and integration with identity and endpoint\-management services. * Support Microsoft Copilot and other approved AI capabilities through technical readiness, licensing, configuration, access management, service monitoring, troubleshooting, adoption support, and coordination with data governance, privacy, security, compliance, and legal requirements. * Ensures compliance with established information security policies, procedures and regulations. * Keeps up to date with new IT technologies, methods and best practices. **What You’ll Bring:** * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Technology from an accredited college or equivalent work experience. * Understanding of Microsoft Server, Windows 11, Active Directory, Exchange, SQL, M365,Copilot, Azure and AntiVirus software administration. * Deep understanding of Virtualization Technology, Virtual Desktop Infrastructure, and Storage Area Networks. * Preference will be given to candidates with technological certifications. * Troubleshooting skills required and excellent customer service skills * Familiarity with Banking Regulations and Cyber Security * Expert problem\-solving, time management, multi\-tasking, and creative thinking. * Must be able to work independently and in a team environment * Be flexible and willing to travel when needed * Responsibilities may require evening and weekend work to meet the needs of systems being maintained or for trouble resolution. **Benefits:** * 160 hours of paid time off per year * 48 hours of paid sick time per year * 11 paid holidays * Full suite of insurance benefits * Comprehensive Wellness Program, including on\-site gyms, access to our Health Coach, and individual and team challenges to earn monetary incentives * Tuition reimbursement * Employer HSA contributions * 401K with exceptional employer contributions * A hands\-on team that is committed to the growth and success of our employees **Pay:** Position starts at $65,000 per year with flexibility commensurate with experience. **Working Conditions:** Physical surroundings are generally pleasant and comfortable with minimal exposure to injury or other hazards. Minimal physical effort required; normally seated with freedom of movement on a regular basis. Some handling of light materials and supplies. **\*\*External and internal applicants, as well as position incumbents who are or who become disabled as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act must be able to perform the essential job functions (as listed) either unaided or with the assistance of a reasonable accommodation to be determined by management on a case by case basis.\*\*** Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Principal Battery Systems Engineer
jobs.description: ON.energy is setting the standard for large load interconnection. ON's patented AI UPS™ is a medium\-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid\-safe data centers. **Principal Battery Systems Engineer** **Role Overview** We're looking for a Principal Engineer to set the technical direction for our BESS product line and to own the product roadmap across multiple concurrent development cycles. This is the senior technical voice on the product team: you'll architect new products, resolve the hardest engineering trade\-offs, set the engineering standards others work to, and represent ON.energy's product engineering externally — to vendors, customers, certifying bodies, and the broader industry. You should be comfortable operating with minimal direction, holding the bar on technical quality, and moving multiple product cycles forward in parallel without losing the thread on any of them. **What You'll Own** **Architecture \& Technical Direction** * Set the architecture for the BESS product line and own the technical roadmap across multiple concurrent product cycles. * Make the hard trade\-off calls — cost vs reliability, performance vs lead time, standardization vs customization — and document the reasoning so future decisions inherit context. * Define the engineering standards, design rules, and review gates that other engineers on the team work to. Own the product\-engineering bar. * Approve major design changes; act as the final technical authority on the change baseline. **Multi\-Product Development** * Run multiple product development cycles in parallel — concept through prototype, FAT, field deployment, and revision — without losing depth on any of them. * Drive cycle cadence: decide what ships when, where the technical risk lives, what gets parallelized vs sequenced. * Identify and execute the next\-generation product moves — higher voltage class, alternate chemistries, new form factors — ahead of customer demand. **Detailed Engineering Depth** * Personally own the hardest pieces of work: novel architectures, first\-of\-kind designs, advanced component sizing (fuse coordination, busbar thermal optimization, protection coordination across cascaded systems), cabinet thermal modeling, and complex protection schemes. * Review and approve detailed engineering drawings — SLDs, GAs, schematics, panel layouts — at the level required to sign off, not just consult. **Vendor \& Supply Chain Strategy** * Own the strategic relationships with key vendors — battery, PCS, BoP. Decide the architecture of those relationships: sole\-source vs dual\-source, co\-development depth, IP boundaries. * Set the technical qualification process used by the team and enforce it. Run the highest\-stakes design reviews and resolve the highest\-stakes vendor escalations personally. **Engineering Leadership \& Mentorship** * Mentor and develop other engineers on the team. Build their technical judgment, not just their throughput. * Run design reviews. Lead post\-mortems on field issues and turn them into product changes. * Set the cadence and quality bar for ECR/ECN, FMEA, design reviews, and product handoff. **External \& Cross\-Functional Representation** * Represent ON.energy's product engineering externally — customer technical reviews, vendor escalations, industry working groups, certifying bodies, conferences. * Partner with the commercial team on the most technically complex pursuits and proposals — proposing architectures, defending positions, structuring technical exhibits in LTSAs and supply agreements. * Brief leadership on technical risk and product roadmap decisions. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a closely related technical field. MS preferred. * 10\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience in BESS, power electronics, UPS, or comparable mission\-critical industrial power systems, with a demonstrated record of operating with minimal direction in a senior technical role. * Owned multiple product development cycles end\-to\-end and independently. You've personally designed and integrated a BESS at the system level, from engineering through commissioning and into live operation, not just handed it off at FAT, and the products are still in the field. * Architecture\-level decision authority on previous BESS equipment. You've made the trade\-off calls others built around, not just executed someone else's architecture. * Deep, demonstrable skill in detailed component sizing — fuse coordination, busbar sizing, protection device selection, thermal sizing for enclosed cabinets — at the level required to sign off on production designs. * Fluency producing and reviewing SLDs, GAs, schematics, and panel layouts; expert with AutoCAD or equivalent E\-CAD; comfortable across mechanical drawings. * Strong track record running strategic vendor relationships through design, FAT, serial production, and post\-deployment escalation. * Excellent written and verbal communication — specs, technical positions, design review leadership, board\-level briefings. * Willing to travel up to 25–30% for FAT inspections, site commissioning, customer engagements, and vendor reviews. **Preferred** * Direct experience with data center / UPS / mission\-critical power or utility\-scale BESS at the architecture level. * Active involvement in standards bodies (UL, IEC, NFPA, IEEE working groups, CSA TC committees) or technical conference contributions. * Patents, peer\-reviewed publications, or other evidence of recognized technical depth in the field. * PE license. * Familiarity with UL 9540 / 9540A, NFPA 855, IEC 62619, IEEE 1547, NEC Article 706, plus the relevant codes for target markets. * Experience standing up or scaling structured PLM, ECR/ECN, and design\-review processes. * Multi\-domain depth — BMS / cell engineering, PCS / power electronics, thermal / mechanical — alongside the EE core. **For US\-based roles \- What you'll get:** * Competitive salary \+ annual performance\-based bonus eligibility * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and company holidays **For Mexico\-based roles \- What you'll get:** * Competitive salary \+ annual performance bonus eligibility * Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo): 30 days * Major medical expenses and life insurance * Paid time off and holidays (per local policy) **For all roles:** * Professional development and growth opportunities * Opportunity to grow with a mission\-driven team shaping the future of clean energy * Equal Opportunity: ON.energy is committed to equal employment opportunity and to maintaining a work environment free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation. * Benefits vary by role and location and are subject to change. **Agency Notice:** ON.energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or third\-party recruiters. Resumes submitted without a fully executed Master Services Agreement (MSA) and a written request from an authorized member of our Talent Acquisition team will be considered the property of ON.energy. No placement fees or compensation will be paid for unsolicited candidate submissions.
