jobs.title: Game Design SME (Visual & Systems)
jobs.description: **Engagement Type:** Independent Contractor (1099\) **Primary Point of Contact**: **Product Manager and Practice Leader** **Location**: Remote (US\-Based) **Opportunity Overview** We are seeking an experienced Game Design Subject Matter Expert (Visual \& Systems) to serve as an independent consultant. In this capacity, the Contractor will drive the evolution and abstraction of our interactive learning modules and graphics systems. The primary objective of this engagement is to take existing game engines and visual templates and evolve them into modular, scalable, and configurable frameworks. The Contractor will exercise independent professional judgment to establish visual standards, system abstractions, and technical specifications for interactive content. **Our Core Values:** * **Self\-Mastery**: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve. * **Ownership**: We own outcomes, not just effort. * **Shared Destiny**: We rise or fall together. Scope of Work \& Project Deliverables The Contractor will be responsible for producing and executing the following key project deliverables: **1\. Graphics \& Systems Template Abstraction** * Audit existing game assets, UI systems, and visual layouts to architect reusable, modular graphics templates. * Abstract visual components and core gameplay mechanics into configurable parameters for non\-technical content creators. * Consult with engineering and art teams to define specifications for scalable asset and content pipeline tooling. **2\. Visual \& Mechanical Design Integration** * Architect intuitive gameplay loops, progression frameworks, visual feedback loops, and reward structures for interactive modules. * Establish and document comprehensive UI/UX standards, visual design patterns, and aesthetic consistency benchmarks across all game templates. * Translate complex subject matter into clear visual communication frameworks. **3\. Technical Strategy \& Documentation** * Act as the Subject Matter Expert for game design and visual layout during client scoping and custom configuration reviews. * Execute iterative visual design reviews, aesthetic audits, and usability assessments to ensure high production standards. * Produce comprehensive documentation, including style guides, asset specifications, and technical configuration parameters. **Requirements** **To successfully complete the deliverables for this engagement, the Contractor must possess:** * 4\+ years of professional game design experience, specializing in visual design systems, UI/UX, or graphics template evolution (over pure standalone indie development). * Demonstrated history of architecting or modularizing visual game assets, level templates, or UI framework systems. * Deep technical expertise in visual communication, graphic asset pipelines, integration workflows, and user\-centric design principles. * Ability to work with complete autonomy, providing high\-level technical direction and self\-directed execution in a collaborative environment. **Benefits** **Engagement Details \& Terms*** **Contract Status:** Independent Contractor (Form 1099\-NEC). * **Compensation**: Hourly rate, commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Senior Roadway Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Rinker Design Associates (RDA)** is seeking a talented **Senior Roadway Engineer** to join our growing Transportation team. In this role, you'll lead the design and delivery of roadway projects while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to create safe, efficient, and sustainable transportation solutions. You'll have the opportunity to mentor junior staff, contribute to project success, and work on impactful infrastructure projects throughout Virginia and beyond. If you're looking for a collaborative environment where you can expand your technical expertise and take on increasing project responsibilities, we'd love to hear from you. **$5,000 \- $10,000 Sign\-On Bonus** ### **What You'll Do:** * Lead the development of roadway design plans for transportation projects * Prepare and review plans, specifications, quantities, and cost estimates. * Coordinate with project managers, clients, subconsultants, and regulatory agencies throughout project development. * Ensure designs comply with VDOT, AASHTO, MUTCD, and local agency standards. * Utilize MicroStation and OpenRoads Designer to develop and review design documents. * Support project schedules, budgets, and quality control efforts. * Collaborate with traffic, drainage, structures, and environmental teams to deliver integrated solutions. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and designers. * Assist with proposal preparation and project pursuits. ### **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field. * **7–12 years of roadway design experience**, preferably on VDOT and municipal transportation projects. * Professional Engineer (PE) license required or ability to obtain Virginia licensure through reciprocity. * Proficiency with MicroStation and OpenRoads Designer. * Strong understanding of VDOT Road Design Manual, AASHTO standards, MUTCD, and transportation design principles. * Experience preparing roadway plans, quantities, and construction documents. * Excellent communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple assignments and work effectively in a collaborative team environment. ### **Why Join RDA?** We offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401K Retirement Plan; Roth Contributions * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Life, AD\&D, short\-term and long\-term disability * Generous PTO and 8 federal holidays \+ 1 floating holiday * Parental leave * Supportive team culture RDA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and maintains a drug\-free workplace. **Applicants that require an employment visa sponsorship now or in the future will not be considered.** **Pay Transparency** The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. \#LI\-TH1### **About Rinker Design Associates** **Rinker Design Associates, LLC (RDA)** is a distinguished civil engineering firm based in Virginia, with over 250 employees and offices located in Manassas (headquarters and satellite), Fredericksburg, Richmond, Virginia Beach, Waynesboro, Abingdon, Big Stone Gap, and Galax. For more than 44 years, RDA has built a solid reputation for providing conscientious and reliable service to municipalities, governmental agencies, and private industries located throughout Virginia – service that our clients and their communities deserve. We pride ourselves in offering high quality deliverables and support services that meet project, budget, and schedule requirements, exceeding our clients’ expectations. Services provided by RDA include Transportation; Alternative Project Delivery; Site/Civil; Construction Engineering and Inspection; Right of Way; Traffic; Surveying; Structures/Bridges; Water/Wastewater; Environmental Review \& Permitting; Utilities; Inflow \& Infiltration Identification/Remediation; Public Sector Architecture; and GIS.

jobs.description: Our Design and Standards team in Centralized Facilities shapes how our brand shows up physically \- from retail spaces and workplaces to production facilities. We're looking for a Lead Creative Designer to own hands\-on concept development for scalable prototypical standards and contribute to flagship and special projects that push our brand forward. In this role, you'll translate brand direction from our Creative Studio team into clear, executable designs while working closely with our Standards team, cross\-functional partners, and external architects and engineers. You'll think deeply about design, move quickly through ambiguity, take ownership of quality, and explain design decisions in a way that lands with stakeholders. Your work will either become our standards playbook (deployed across dozens of locations) or showcase experiences that define our brand to customers and partners. * Translate brand direction from Creative Studio into executable designs and lead concept design for new customer touchpoints, creating foundational standards that stay intact as we replicate them at scale. * Own design development on select special projects and flagships, from programming through site feasibility, stakeholder workshops, and final documentation. * Balance aesthetic, functional, operational, and financial needs by partnering with end users and cross\-functional teams. * Specify smart material and finish choices that are durable and sourceable. * Collaborate with external architects and engineers to keep design intent intact through execution. * Work side\-by\-side with internal Construction Managers to provide guidance, resolve on\-site challenges, and participate in the Construction Administration phase. * Create presentations that land with end users and leadership by weaving together vision, program, and customer experience. * Partner with retail and marketing teams to provide creative direction for campaigns, seasonal store designs, and new product launches. * Adapt quickly to shifting business needs and pivot prototypical design strategies effectively to maintain alignment with the company's growth trajectory. * 6\+ years of professional architecture or interior design experience with a concentration on scalable retail, commercial, or hospitality work. * Degree in Architecture or Interior Design. * Proficiency in Revit, Rhino, Figma and modern 3D Spatial software. * Strong Design development experience with FF\&E experience, millwork detailing, and ability to present design narratives to executive level stakeholders. * A solid understanding of aligning creative work with financial constraints, scalability, and operational feasibility, paired with the agility to thrive in a fast\-paced environment characterized by rapid change, pivots, and tight deadlines. * Ability to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week (up to 5 days encouraged) at the assigned location. * Ability to travel occasionally to project sites, vendor facilities, and cross\-functional workshops.

security through automation * Help shape the technical direction and architecture of Robinhood's AI Security platform as the team and platform continue to grow **What you bring** ------------------ * authorization, identity, or encryption * Experience building AI platforms, AI infrastructure, or production systems that support AI\-powered applications or agents * Proficiency in Go or Python, with * Challenging, high\-impact work to grow your career * Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching * Top Tier benefits not. * Lifestyle wallet \- a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more * Employer\-paid life \& disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits * If our mission energizes you and you're ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Roblox Database
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 40801 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. Roblox’s database team develops the next\-generation, multi\-tenant database platform that elastically scales and underpins every online data workload at Roblox. As a senior engineer on the database team, you will shape the architecture, build and launch critical database capabilities that keep our services fast, reliable and efficient at global scale. You will report to the Technical Director for Storage. **You will:** * **Design and implement new engine features**—indexing, storage formats, WAL and replication protocols, sharding, and query\-planner enhancements—that push latency, throughput, and availability boundaries. * **Evolve the control plane** to deliver elastic scaling, autonomous healing, and zero\-downtime schema or tenant moves across global regions. * **Profile and optimize** critical code paths using kernel\-level tracing and advanced performance tooling; drive systematic tail\-latency reductions. * **Establish engineering best practices** by leading design reviews, performance benchmarks, failure drills, and post\-incident retrospectives. * **Automate everything**: develop frameworks for testing, CI/CD, rollout safety, observability, and autoscaling so that the platform operates hands\-off at scale. * **Mentor and unblock engineers**, fostering deep database craftsmanship and disseminating knowledge across Storage, Platform, and product teams. * **Engage with the open\-source community**—upstreaming patches, presenting learnings, and influencing the future of Postgres, RocksDB and related ecosystems. **You have:** * **6\+ years** of experience in software engineering or a relevant field * Deep experience with building and operating **large\-scale distributed databases** or storage engines (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL/InnoDB, RocksDB, Spanner, Aurora, AlloyDB). * Deep expertise in **database internals**—B\-trees, MVCC, WAL, query optimization, buffer management—and strong skills in **C/C\+\+, GO or Rust**. * Hands\-on experience with **consensus algorithms** (Raft, Paxos) and multi\-region replication models that deliver strong consistency and high availability. * Proven success shipping **high\-QPS, low\-latency services** on container orchestration stacks (Kubernetes or Nomad) with comprehensive observability. * Ability to turn ambiguous product requirements into a clear technical roadmap and influence cross\-functional stakeholders. * Passion for **automation, rigorous testing, and data\-driven decision\-making** that raises the reliability and efficiency bar. * **Bonus:** upstream contributions to PostgreSQL, RocksDB or other OSS databases; familiarity with disaggregated storage, HTAP workloads, or custom query languages. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job\-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full\-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**. Annual Salary Range $243,290—$295,250 USD Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). jobs.title: Lead Camera Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company** ===================== We're a small team solving one of the hardest problems in human\-computer interaction: a noninvasive wearable that turns thought into text, no surgery required. By pairing ultra\-high\-density neural sensing with our Brain Foundation Model, we decode neural signals with a fidelity once reserved for implants. Our mission is to give a billion people a direct link between mind and machine \- expanding how humans think, communicate, and create. We are building a next\-generation AI companion wearable powered by EEG/BCI technology. Our device reads and responds to neural signals in real time, creating a deeply personal experience that adapts to each user. This is not another productivity tool or a gadget — it is a new category of technology built around human potential. We are backed by strong investors, moving fast, and assembling a world\-class team to bring this to market. If you thrive at the frontier of what’s possible and want to build something that genuinely changes how people interact with their own minds, we want to talk to you. **About the Role** ================== You will own the full camera system of our wearable — from sensor selection and optical design, through image processing and compression, to multi\-camera capture, and streaming. Our first device carries multiple image sensors arranged around the head to deliver near\-360° spatial coverage on a constrained MCU using a multiplexed capture architecture, with a clear path to a more capable image\-processing pipeline and higher\-end sensors as we scale. You will report to the Head of Hardware, with regular exposure to Sabi’s CEO and CTO, and partner closely with the EE, FW, product design, and reliability leads. You will also work extensively with external engineering teams at our camera module suppliers and contract manufacturers — the work is outsourced; the accountability is yours. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Own the camera system end\-to\-end — sensor selection, optical design, capture pipeline, image processing, multi\-camera architecture, calibration, image quality. * Drive part selection and benchmarking across the camera system — image sensors, lens stacks, module suppliers — with second\-source planning. * Drive the optical design — lens FOV and stack\-up, AR coating, hyperfocal tuning, and validation across head pitches and body coupling. * Specify the electrical and mechanical interfaces cameras need from the rest of the system, and partner with the EE lead on layout, the FW lead on capture drivers, and the product design lead on pod integration. * Validate combined field\-of\-view, blind spots, and seam overlap, and define the calibration and stitching path for future panoramic and CV use cases. * Set the image\-quality bar — exposure, white balance, low\-light, dynamic range, motion handling — and the test methodology that holds it as we scale. * Partner with the reliability lead on component\-level reliability for the camera system — image sensor lifetime, lens and AR\-coating durability, optical\-stack robustness. * Ship the product by the end of year, and help build and grow the camera team. **What We’re Looking For** ========================== Must\-Haves * 10\+ years of camera engineering, with at least one shipped consumer product (smartphone, wearable, action camera, AR/VR, or comparable) where you owned the camera subsystem. * Deep expertise in image sensor architectures, sensor interfaces (parallel and high\-speed serial), and image\-processing pipelines. * Demonstrated optical design experience for compact consumer products — lens selection, FOV tuning, optical stack, AR coating. * Hands\-on experience characterizing and tuning image quality (exposure, white balance, color, low\-light, dynamic range) using structured test environments. * Direct experience driving camera component selection and benchmarking with second\-source planning. * Experience working with overseas camera module suppliers and driving DfM, calibration, and quality at volume. Nice\-to\-Haves * Deploying CV models or vision pipelines on dedicated low\-power AI accelerators. * Multi\-camera systems — calibration, synchronization, stitching, panoramic, or stereo. * Low\-power image sensors for battery\-constrained products. * Computer\-vision background — VSLAM, scene understanding, on\-device inference. * Experience navigating the social and privacy considerations of body\-worn cameras. *If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every qualification, please apply. As we build, we’re hiring for complementary strengths to form a high\-impact team* **Compensation \& Benefits** ============================ * Competitive base salary * Meaningful equity package * 401(k) with company matching * Health insurance * Flexible PTO **Our Hiring Timeline** ======================= * Evaluation completed within 14 days of first interview * Offer letter dispatched same day as go decision, valid for 10 days * Start date within 4 weeks of offer acceptance * All candidate queries responded to within 3 hours during business hours *Sabi is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* Compensation Range: $300K \- $400K

PPG is the primary focus, including the optical front\-end, the skin interface, and the algorithms that produce a reliable heart rate and HRV signal during motion. You will also own the rest of the sensor suite, including inertial, body temperature, and environmental sensing, as well as the sensor fusion across them. You report to the Head of Hardware, work regularly with the CEO and CTO, and partner with the electrical, firmware, product design, and reliability leads. Much of the build happens with external engineering teams at our contract manufacturers. The work is outsourced; the accountability is yours. **What You'll Do** * Lead the sensor system architecture and R\&D for the product's non\-EEG sensing. * Design, select, and evaluate the sensor suite, with optical sensing as the primary focus: + Optical: PPG and SpO₂ (primary focus) + Inertial: accelerometer and gyroscope + Body temperature + Environmental: ambient temperature, humidity, light, and barometric pressure * Own heart\-rate and HRV estimation, including the algorithms that stay accurate while the wearer is in motion. * Drive sensor front\-end design and component selection, with BOM ownership and second\-source strategy, partnering with the EE lead on schematic and layout. * Develop the signal conditioning, calibration, and characterization methods across the sensor suite. * Define the sensor\-fusion approach that combines these streams into reliable signals for the AI assistant. * Specify the electrical, mechanical, and firmware interfaces each sensor needs, partnering with product design on skin\-contact placement and optical windows, and with firmware on the acquisition runtime and hardware\-aligned cross\-sensor timestamping. * Partner with the AI/ML lead on anything that becomes a learned model, and with the reliability lead on skin\-contact durability, sweat tolerance, and long\-wear stability. * Lead technical reviews and design documentation for the sensing system. * Ship the product by end of year, and build and lead the sensing team. **What We’re Looking For** ========================== Must\-Haves * 10\+ years in sensor jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: Seal Dynamics (A HEICO Company) founded in 1976, with its corporate headquarters based in Hauppauge, NY is a world leader in technical sales and the distribution of aerospace components. Our unique marketing and technical sales approach are the most effective way to assist our customers in selecting products that reduce cost of ownership. Our current product portfolio includes structural, mechanical and electro\-mechanical products associated with both airframe and engine applications across all ATA Chapters. Through our strategic partnerships with some of the most respected OEMs in the aviation industry, Seal Dynamics stocks and distributes in excess of 100,000 products globally in support of our customer requirements. In addition to our distribution network, Seal Dynamics is a market leader in the design and development of FAA approved alternative parts. Our OEM licensed PMAs and Test and Computation PMAs offer our customers viable solutions in the reduction of operational costs. Seal Dynamics is growing its IT development team, and we're hiring an entry\-level developer to grow with us. You'll write SQL and C\# against the systems that keep a global aviation parts business running. ERP, eCommerce, partner integrations, document management, and warehouse logistics and you'll have a hand in the work we're building out now: REST integrations between our systems and AI capabilities wired directly into our business data. This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to learn a real enterprise stack end to end. **On\-site in Hauppauge, Long Island.** This is not a remote or hybrid position, and it is not a contract role. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States; visa sponsorship is not available for this position. * **Seal Dynamics offers a 9/80 work schedule, upon completion of the introductory period, you can opt to enroll and have every other Friday off.** Requirements: **What you'll do** ================== * Write, test, and tune T\-SQL queries, views, stored procedures against our ERP and line\-of\-business databases * Build and maintain C\#/.NET applications and services * **Build and consume REST APIs** \- the integrations that connect our core business systems to each other and to outside partners. This is core to the job, not a side task. * **Work on our AI integration efforts** \- connecting LLM APIs and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to business data, so the business can ask real questions of real systems * Write Python for data work, automation, and AI\-adjacent tooling * Support and enhance internal web applications * Work in containerized development and deployment environments * Work directly with people in purchasing, warehouse, sales, and finance to understand what they actually need before you build it * Follow source control, code review, and change management practices and help us improve them **Our stack** ============= **What we're looking for** **Required \- this is the real list** * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp, military, self\-taught with a portfolio we can look at) + Working knowledge of SQL: you can write a multi\-table join, understand what an index does, and know why SELECT \* in production code is a bad habit + Familiarity with at least one object\-oriented language \- C\# preferred, but Java, Python, or VB.NET experience transfers + Basic understanding of how REST APIs work: requests, responses, JSON, status codes, authentication + Basic familiarity with source control (Git/GitHub) + Clear written and verbal communication \- much of this job is asking a non\-technical person the right question + Curiosity and initiative: you research before you escalate, and you flag problems early rather than hoping they go away Coursework, internships, co\-ops, and personal projects all count. jobs.title: Junior Programmer - Software Quality Assurance
jobs.description: **Job Overview** Shasta QA is looking for a Junior Programmer to join our software quality assurance team. This is a great opportunity for a recent college graduate or early\-career programmer who wants to build practical software development and testing experience while working on real\-world applications. We’re looking for someone with a foundation in programming and computer science fundamentals, but previous professional QA or test automation experience is not required. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required. Depending on project needs and your skills and interests, your work may include software test automation, manual software testing, or a combination of both. You’ll work alongside experienced QA professionals and learn how software is tested throughout the development lifecycle. This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys programming, troubleshooting, investigating why things don’t work as expected, and learning new technologies. **What You'll Be Doing** * Develop automated tests for web, desktop, mobile, and other software applications * Convert existing manual test cases into automated tests * Debug failing automated tests and investigate unexpected software behavior * Maintain and improve existing test automation frameworks * Learn how automation frameworks are designed and built * Review requirements and translate them into test scenarios and procedures * Perform exploratory and structured manual testing when required by project needs * Identify, document, and communicate software defects * Verify new features, bug fixes, and application changes * Work with developers, QA engineers, and manual QA testers to investigate issues * Learn new programming languages, frameworks, tools, and technologies as projects require * Identify opportunities to improve test coverage and testing efficiency **Qualifications** * We’re looking for a solid foundation rather than expertise in a specific technology stack. **You should have:** * Programming experience in at least one general\-purpose language such as C\#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C\+\+, or a similar language * An understanding of fundamental programming concepts, including variables, functions, data structures, control flow, and object\-oriented programming * Experience debugging your own code and working through technical problems * Familiarity with source control concepts and tools such as Git * The ability to learn new technologies using technical documentation and other resources **Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required:** * HTML, XML, JSON, or YAML * SQL and relational databases * Unit or automated testing frameworks such as pytest, MSTest, NUnit, JUnit, Mocha, or similar * Web browser developer tools * REST APIs * XPath or CSS selectors * Regular expressions * CI/CD tools or concepts * Selenium, Playwright, Appium, or other test automation technologies **QA Skills You’ll Develop** Previous professional QA experience is not required. We’ll help you develop skills including: * Detecting patterns and identifying outliers * Creating clear, reproducible bug reports * Interpreting test results and investigating failures * Verifying new features and bug fixes * Identifying gaps in test coverage * Thinking about software from an end user’s perspective * Prioritizing testing based on risk, deadlines, and project requirements * Distinguishing software defects from expected behavior * Asking effective questions when requirements or behavior are unclear **What We’re Looking For** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * A keen eye for detail * Clear and concise written and verbal communication * Curiosity about how software works—and why it sometimes doesn’t * The ability to work independently while knowing when to ask for help * Comfort receiving feedback and learning from more experienced team members * Good judgment and a willingness to raise concerns when something doesn’t seem right * Dependability and follow\-through * An interest in continually developing your technical skills * The ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non\-technical teammates **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related technical field preferred * Recent graduates are encouraged to apply * Relevant coursework, internships, personal projects, open\-source contributions, or other programming experience may substitute for professional programming experience * Previous professional software testing or QA experience is **not required** **About the Role** This position is designed to provide room to grow. Some Junior Programmers may spend most of their time developing and maintaining automated tests, while others may work across both automation and manual testing depending on their abilities and the needs of our client projects. Our goal is to develop someone who can understand software at a technical level while also thinking critically about its quality from the perspective of the people who use it. We offer benefits such as paid vacations and holidays, insurance plans including health, dental and vision, and 401(k) plans with employer matching. The position we are looking to fill is in our Shreveport office for an in\-person role. This is not a remote work opening. **Applicants from out of the area will be rejected.** *All applicants are subject to a background check. Background checks will include, at a minimum, SSN verification, county criminal, federal criminal, sex offender registry, and government watch list. The background check must be completed before employment begins except when employment begins prior to the completion of the background check as a conditional offer. Once the background check is complete hiring authority and human resources will inform the conditional employee of hire based on the outcome of the background check. Shasta QA complies with California, Iowa, Louisiana, and Federal employment compliance laws.* Pay: $30,000\.00 \- $35,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value\-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately close business. As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the database space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences. This is a remote role that requires about 25% travel. Candidates can sit anywhere in the USA. **IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:** --------------------------------- * Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers * Work hands\-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation * Immerse yourself in the ever\-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them. * Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing **ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:** ------------------------------------------ * 5\-7\+ years of industry experience with a minimum of 5 years within a pre\-sales environment * Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos. * 5\+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning and generative AI solutions in the cloud. * Possesses a proactive curiosity for the AI landscape, striving to be a visionary and technical thought partner for customers navigating the space. * A proven ability to leverage AI code generation tools to accelerate productivity and efficiency. * Broad range of experience within large\-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies. For example, Data Lake, Data Mesh, Data Fabric * Hands\-on expertise with SQL,SQL analytics, and Python. * Ability to connect a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solutions * Ability to do deep discovery of customer’s architecture framework and connect those with Snowflake Data Architecture. * University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred. Masters in DataScience or Business Administration is a plus. * Experience with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, etc), would be beneficial, but not required * Expect approximately 30% travel **ABOUT OUR TEAM** ------------------ Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone. *Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.* Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * This role is eligible to participate in Snowflake's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on\-target earnings of $220,000 \- $288,750\. The estimated base salary for this role is $165,000 \- $216,562\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, CAD automation, and software engineering, directly impacting how engineers design and model products. jobs.title: Sr. Director, AI Audio
jobs.description: **Description** Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go\-to partner for the world’s most forward\-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting\-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI\-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI\-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play. **Overview** Synaptics is actively seeking a Senior Director, AI Audio to shape the future of audio technology for Astra Edge\-AI processors. The Edge Compute and Connectivity Division at Synaptics is developing high\-performance Linux processors (MPU) as well as high\-performance microcontrollers (MCU) that are built with AI from the ground up. The role requires broad knowledge around processors, AI\-compute, audio technology, software (Linux, RTOS, applications), on\-device security, and power management. This position reports to the VP of Technology and Innovation at Synaptics. The typical base pay range for this position is USD $249,000 \- $392,700 per year. Individual pay is determined by many factors including work location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This position is also eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus, equity, and other benefits. Note that compensation listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and does not include bonus, equity, or benefits. **Responsibilities \& Competencies** Job Duties * Define the AI audio technology roadmap and architecture, and strategy across MCU and MPU platforms * Lead development of audio DSP, AI models, and embedded software, and production\-ready audio solutions * Drive in\-house innovation, third\-party technology evaluation, IP strategy, and licensing decisions * Own end\-to\-end system integration, validation, characterization, optimization, and production readiness * Establish scalable validation methodologies, automation frameworks, quality metrics, and performance benchmarks * Partner across architecture, silicon, AI, compiler, software, and product teams to deliver differentiated solutions * Drive future SoC architecture, feature prioritization, technical trade\-offs, and platform evolution * Lead customer engagements, proof\-of\-concepts, and resolution of complex technical integration challenges * Build, mentor, and lead high\-performing engineering teams across AI, DSP, embedded software, and audio technologies * Provide technical leadership in embedded AI, audio systems, heterogeneous computing, and commercial product delivery Competencies * Ability to shape technology vision, roadmap, and execution to drive business growth and market leadership * Exudes technical excellence by providing executive\-level guidance on architecture, innovation, and complex technical decisions * Strong analytical and business acumen; able to make informed decisions based on experience often under pressure, while considering business implications * Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team: Achieves focus on key priorities, provides clear direction, delegates, actively communicates and coaches * Ability to influence and lead through change and motivated by the challenge of a fast\-paced, high\-growth global environment * The ability to think strategically and develop solutions that align with the company's overall business objectives and long\-term goals * Proficiency in identifying and assessing risks and developing effective strategies to mitigate those risks while ensuring the company's growth and innovation * Establishes clear expectations, sets objectives and brings multiple parties together to drive key initiatives * Excellent executive communication skills, capable of influencing senior stakeholders and cross\-functional leadership * Track record of mentoring senior engineers and developing next\-level leaders **Qualifications** (Requirements) * Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related field or equivalent * 15\+ years’ experience in audio, with a focus on AI algorithms for multi\-mic processing, AI concepts, and with 7\+ years leading teams * Deep experience leading cross\-functional teams, with experience influencing product team * Strong track record of working in a fast\-paced, innovative environment with a focus on delivering high\-quality products * Demonstrated ability to drive innovation and stay up to date on the latest technologies and trends in the semiconductor industry * Domestic and international travel up to 10% may be required *Belief in Diversity* *Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

jobs.title: Applications Engineering, Staff Engineer
jobs.description: Sunnyvale, California, United States **Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18761 **Base Salary Range** $129000\-$193000 **Date posted** 09/15/2026 ### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent years solving real engineering problems, not just running simulations. The kind where a customer's product launch depends on getting the structural analysis right, and you know how to work backward from their constraint to a solution they can actually use. You understand that the best technical answer means nothing if it does not fit their workflow, their timeline, or their team's skill set. You are comfortable walking into a room where you are the only one who understands both the physics and the software, and you can translate between those worlds without making anyone feel lost. When a customer describes a packaging failure or a thermal issue, you are already thinking about which solver to use, what assumptions to test, and how to script the setup so they can repeat it next month. You do not wait for perfect data. You work with what is available, ask the specific questions that matter, and move the project forward. If a demo does not go as planned, you troubleshoot in real time and turn it into a teaching moment. At Synopsys, you will work with customers who are building the next generation of semiconductors and electronics, and what you help them solve actually ships. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, from discovery calls where you map customer workflows to live demos where you show how Ansys software solves their specific structural, thermal, or reliability challenges * Work directly with semiconductor and electronics packaging engineers to understand their design problems, then configure, script, and deploy simulation solutions using Ansys tools that fit into their existing CAD and PLM environments * Build Python\-based automation scripts and custom workflows using Ansys APIs to help customers move from manual, one\-off analyses to repeatable, scalable simulation processes * Collaborate with Ansys product teams to translate what you are hearing from customers into feature requests, test pre\-release builds on real\-world problems, and document best practices that become part of the product roadmap * Deliver consulting services and training sessions, from introductory workshops to deep\-dive technical implementations, helping customers get value from day one * Support field marketing efforts by authoring technical content, presenting at industry conferences, and creating application examples that demonstrate differentiated value in electronics and semiconductor markets * Travel to customer sites, trade shows, and internal meetings up to 25% of the time, with flexibility to increase based on project needs ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Customers will close design cycles faster because the simulation workflows you built actually work in their environment, with their data, under their constraints * Sales teams will win competitive opportunities because you showed up with a solution that addressed the customer's specific failure mode, not a generic pitch * Product teams will build features that matter because you brought them real customer requirements, not guesses, and tested those features before they shipped * Engineers at semiconductor and electronics companies will trust simulation more because you helped them see accurate correlation between their models and physical test results * Synopsys will expand its footprint in electronics packaging and semiconductor reliability because you made the software accessible to teams who previously saw simulation as too complex or disconnected from their workflows * New users will ramp faster because the training materials, scripts, and examples you created give them a clear path from installation to productive work * The business will grow because the technical relationships you build turn into renewals, expansions, and references that open doors in new accounts ### **What You'll Need** * BS in Mechanical Engineering or related field with 5\+ years in an engineering software environment, or MS with 3\+ years, or PhD with industry exposure to structural, thermal, or reliability simulation * Deep subject matter expertise in structural mechanics applied to electronics or semiconductor domains, including packaging, PCB assemblies, or chip\-level reliability analysis * Hands\-on experience with Ansys software or other commercial CAE tools like COMSOL, Abaqus, or similar platforms used for finite element analysis * Strong Python scripting skills with demonstrated experience building automation workflows, integrating APIs, or developing custom applications on top of commercial engineering software * Ability to diagnose complex simulation problems, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders, and write documentation or presentations in fluent English * Willingness to travel domestically up to 25% of the time for customer meetings, on\-site implementations, and industry events * Experience in customer\-facing roles such as applications engineering, technical support, or consulting services is a strong plus, especially if you have worked with senior engineering leaders or executives ### **Who You Are** * You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a vague description of a product failure, and walk out with a clear plan for which analysis to run, what boundary conditions to test, and how to set up the model so they can reuse it * When a demo goes sideways, you do not panic. You troubleshoot in front of the customer, explain what you are doing, and turn the problem into a teaching moment that builds credibility * You have worked in environments where the answer is not in the user manual. You dig into APIs, test scripts, read source code if you have to, and figure out how to make the tool do what the customer actually needs * If a customer asks for a feature that does not exist yet, you do not just say no. You find a workaround, document it, and loop in the product team with enough detail that they can prioritize it properly * You are comfortable presenting technical content to a room full of PhD engineers and then simplifying the same concept for a program manager who needs to understand risk and timeline, not equations * You manage your own calendar, follow up without being reminded, and treat customer commitments like they matter, because they do ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** You will be joining the Ansys Customer Excellence team within Synopsys, a group that works directly with customers to deploy simulation software, solve real engineering problems, and support the sales process with deep technical expertise. This is a multi\-disciplinary team that spans different physics domains, industries, and customer types. You will collaborate with sales, product development, and other applications engineers to deliver solutions that help customers engineer what is ahead. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, reporting lines, and how this role fits into the broader Synopsys organization during the interview process. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary bonuses. Synopsys offers comprehensive health, wellness, and financial benefits as part of a competitive total rewards package. The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of job\-related factors, including location, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details on the total rewards package upon request. The base salary range for this role is across the U.S.

Doing** * Build, configure, and maintain Salesforce deployment pipelines in Copado, including User Stories, promotion paths, and release and environment management * Develop and maintain Salesforce customizations using Apex, Lightning components, flows, and configuration in support of DevOps tooling and internal platform needs * Manage Git\-based version control workflows for Salesforce metadata, including branching strategy, merge conflict resolution, and code promotion across environments from sandbox to production * Coordinate and execute Salesforce deployments, working closely with developers and admins to plan releases, sequence dependencies, and minimize downtime * Monitor deployment pipelines and troubleshoot failures, working through Copado job errors, validation failures, and metadata conflicts to keep releases on track * Maintain sandbox environments, including refresh scheduling, seeding, and data and configuration alignment across the org landscape * Document release processes, deployment runbooks, and Copado configuration standards so the process stays consistent as the team grows ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Give development teams a reliable, self\-service path to production so releases stop being a bottleneck * Reduce failed deployments and rollback incidents through better pipeline design, validation, and pre\-deployment checks * Shorten release cycles by streamlining promotion paths and cutting manual handoffs out of the process * Improve visibility into what is moving through the pipeline, so stakeholders always know release status and risk * Strengthen org stability by keeping sandboxes, metadata, and environments properly aligned and documented * Enable the Salesforce platform to scale safely as customizations and user base grow across the company * Create deployment patterns that other teams can adopt, multiplying your impact across the broader Salesforce organization ### **What You'll Need** * 2 to 5 years of experience in Salesforce development or Salesforce platform administration * Hands\-on experience with Copado for deployment and release management, including User Stories and promotion pipelines * Comfort with Git\-based workflows including branching, merging, resolving conflicts, and managing metadata in version control * Working knowledge of core Salesforce concepts including Apex, Lightning components, flows, and standard and custom object configuration * Understanding of Salesforce release management fundamentals including sandboxes, change sets or metadata API, and environment strategy * Basic scripting or automation skills such as shell scripting that help streamline deployment tasks is a plus * Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform Developer I, or Copado certifications are a plus ### **Who You Are** * You are detail\-oriented under pressure, a rushed deployment is exactly when you slow down and double\-check dependencies * You communicate proactively, flagging risk or blockers before they turn into a failed release * You collaborate well with both developers and admins, translating between what the code does and what the org needs * You are comfortable owning a process end to end, from a User Story's creation through its successful promotion to production * You look for patterns in recurring deployment issues and fix the root cause instead of patching around it each time * You can explain a complex deployment failure to a non\-technical stakeholder in two sentences without losing the technical nuance ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** This role sits within our Salesforce platform and DevOps team, responsible for the release engineering and deployment tooling that supports our broader Salesforce development organization. The team partners closely with Salesforce developers, admins, and business stakeholders to keep releases moving smoothly as the org and its customizations continue to grow. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. jobs.title: AI Engineer and Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Who are we?** T12 Technologies LLC is a technology services company based in Maryland that provides cloud, AI and automation, cybersecurity, contact center, and back\-office modernization services to clients at the federal, state, healthcare, and commercial levels. The current engagement involves developing an accounts payable automation system over a six\-month period for a commercial client, integrating Oracle NetSuite with Anthropic's Claude. **The problem** The client's accounts payable team handles about ten thousand invoice emails each month by hand; some arrive as clean PDFs, while others are photographs taken on a mobile phone. The intake process is managed by NetSuite Bill Capture, with Claude carrying out the extraction, classification and GL coding based on that. All automated decisions must be defensible to an auditor, since the client has already been let down by three previous vendors; nothing ships unless you can demonstrate it. **What you would own** * Get the extraction process to work on actual documents, not just on a clean set of samples. It should be tested on scans, on duplicates, and on invoices lacking the fields that are most needed. * Determine what the system does in cases of uncertainty, including where it continues, where it stops, and what a human observes when it stops. * Verify the accuracy by comparing the client's historical invoices in a manner that a controller will accept and an auditor can follow. * Run a live pilot by carrying it out in parallel with manual processing for a period of thirty days while making adjustments based on what the real world provides. * Give it to him so that it may survive you; the client doesn't have any AI facilities of their own and isn't going to hire one. **What we need** * The work involving the LLM that was actually deployed and that you then provided support for. It wasn't a proof of concept that had only reached the demo stage. * Integrating Python with a REST API to work with systems that were not built by you. * Extracting documents at production quality—such as invoices, forms, claims, and contracts—no matter how semi\-structured and imperfect they may be. * A method that can be used to check if the output is correct, together with the criterion for determining when an improvement is genuine. * The necessary legal permission to work in the United States in an independent contractor capacity. **Helpful, not required** * Specifically Anthropic Claude, or Claude via Bedrock. * Either NetSuite or any other ERP system that you needed to integrate with rather than one that you could control. * The processing of documents relating to finance or accounting by AP. * OCR and document\-capture pipelines, especially when working with low\-quality scans. **Travel** * The kickoff week is mandatory and not optional. * You can expect another 3 to 5 days during the period, with these days being grouped around the pilot and go\-live. * It is essential that you can travel at short notice, no matter where you live—that is a firm requirement. **How we screen** We check the information that the candidates give us. Their references are contacted, their credentials are verified with the issuing body, and the final screening involves using actual, complicated documents rather than having an interview about your resume. We prefer that you show us one thing that you actually built rather than providing a list of all the things you have worked on. If the best work you have done is covered by an NDA, then say so and we will adjust the scope of the exercise to include it. **To apply** Forward the following; applications not including the first two will not be considered. * **A link to something that you have built, such as a** repository, an evaluation report, a design document, or a write\-up, with any sensitive information redacted if necessary. * **Answer the question above with a few sentences**. * A resume or a profile together with two references from completed work. * The total amount you are paid on an hourly basis and whether you take on the contract as a 1099 or through your own entity. * **The location of your base and proof that you will be present** in Houston for the dates listed above. * Your availability over the following six months. Flexible work from home options available.

0 to 1 with an AI\-first vision * Develop and maintain API integrations with third\-party payment processors, banks, and other financial institutions to facilitate global market complexities * Identify and incorporate AI Agents and Large Language Models to increase automation in payments, billing, and reconciliation tasks, reducing operational toil * Implement orchestration engines for reliability and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows across FinTech platforms * Mentor junior and senior engineers, contributing to the overall growth of the engineering team and driving best practices in jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Information Intelligence and Automation (mid)
jobs.description: **Position:** Applied AI Engineer — Information Intelligence \& Automation (mid) **Employment Type:** Full Time **Location:** Falls Church, VA. (Remote within the Continental US but strong preference will be given to applicants located in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.) **Position Description:** Tesla Government is seeking an Applied AI Engineer to help turn AI capabilities into reliable tools that improve how our staff and clients work with user behavior data, open source information, and official government reporting, supporting key projects for a number of US and partner nation entities. As a mid\-level expert, the Applied AI Engineer is responsible for understanding business challenges and identifying and applying AI to solve problems. The position reports directly to the Data Team Lead. We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable exploring new technologies, understanding Tesla’s clients and products in detail, making informed decisions, testing assumptions, and creating sustainable processes and tools. In this role, there may not always be existing SOPs and we look for this position to help establish them. Applied AI Engineers own the evaluation and testing of the AI capabilities they build, and Tesla does not consider AI projects complete until their performance is measured. **About Us:** Tesla Government Inc. (no affiliation with the automotive company) is a rapidly growing small business, located in Falls Church, Virginia. Founded in 2009, Tesla Government seeks to improve how government agencies manage and share information internally and with government and external partners. Our proven agile, outcome\-oriented approach delivers results quickly, reducing risk and driving client success. We offer Flex PTO, flexible work schedule, health benefits, 4% matching on 401k contributions, competitive compensation, and work from home (telework). We have a friendly, active work environment, and our projects make a difference. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities (others may be assigned)** **Build Applied AI Solutions** * Design and develop AI\-powered applications and services using commercial and open\-source foundation models. * Work with models available through Amazon Bedrock, evaluating and selecting models based on capability, reliability, cost, latency, and operational requirements. * Project token costs, submit token budget estimates and expected output values for prior approval, and present expected ROI for each project. * Build production workflows incorporating LLMs, retrieval, structured outputs, APIs, and other AI capabilities. * Use grounding, citations, retrieval, structured generation, and appropriate refusal or uncertainty behaviors to improve reliability and reduce hallucination. * Work with Data Team and Customer Success colleagues to understand business and user needs into practical AI solutions. * Clearly communicate model capabilities, limitations, risks, and expected performance to technical and nontechnical staff and clients. **Build Data Pipelines** * Build data ingestion and transformation pipelines for structured and unstructured sources, including databases, web content, PDFs, documents, and data integrated with Tesla’s GovShare platform. * Automate data collection, cleaning, transformation, extraction, and analysis. * Develop solutions for document processing, including OCR, layout\-aware parsing, table extraction, and other techniques where appropriate. * Design systems that maintain data quality, traceability, and provenance throughout the AI pipeline. **Own AI Evaluation \& Reliability** * Own the evaluation harness for the AI features you build. * Develop representative evaluation datasets and test cases for AI applications. * Define measurable criteria for accuracy, relevance, grounding, hallucination, refusal behavior, and other task\-specific requirements. * Establish regression testing so that changes to prompts, models, retrieval systems, or code can be evaluated before implementation. * Analyze failures and use evaluation results to improve prompts, models, retrieval strategies, data, and system architecture. * Monitor production performance using AWS and Splunk, and identify opportunities to improve quality, cost, and latency. **Identify \& Automate Opportunities** * Analyze existing workflows and identify opportunities where AI or automation can reduce repetitive work, improve decision\-making, or increase efficiency. * Work with departments across Tesla Government to understand their workflows and develop appropriate automation solutions. * Prototype, evaluate, and implement approved automation opportunities. * Measure the impact of new solutions, including time savings, improved accuracy, increased adoption, or other relevant business outcomes. * Explore emerging AI technologies and determine where they can provide practical value rather than adopting technology for its own sake. **Collaborate Across Tesla** * Translate technical concepts and AI limi o client engagements when appropriate. * Participate in business development activities where technical expertise can help communicate the value and feasibility of AI solutions. **What Success Looks Like:** * Delivering production\-ready AI and automation solutions that solve meaningful government problems. * Time savings for the Data Team and other Tesla departments gained through new AI\-based tools * Building AI systems whose performance can be measured in time savings, cost avoidance, user adoption, or other KPIs you establish with your supervisor. * Implementing citation, grounding, and refusal patterns so the model says "I do not know" instead of hallucinating * Improve the speed, cost, accuracy, or usability of existing workflows. * Helping teams across Tesla Government identify practical opportunities to use AI. * Clearly communicating what AI can and cannot do. * Demonstrating a measurable improvement in a workflow or product in Tesla within the first 90 days. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. * 5\+ years of professional software, data, ML, or AI engineering experience, with demonstrated experience building and deploying technical solutions. * Professional experience developing applications using Python or another modern programming language. * Experience working with at least one commercial or open\-source LLM and its API. * Experience building AI\-powered applications using techniques such as retrieval, structured outputs, tool use, prompting, or grounding. * Experience working with APIs, data pipelines, or cloud\-based services. * Experience containerizing and deploying applications using Docker and AWS ECR/ECS. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical problems and work independently when requirements or solutions are not fully defined. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders. * Strong attention to detail and an ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs rather than assuming they are correct. **Desired Experience:** * Experience building production RAG or LLM\-based applications. * Experience designing or implementing AI evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or regression testing. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock. * Experience with Splunk. * Experience with PDF/OCR pipelines, document parsing, layout\-aware extraction, or table extraction. * Experience with vector databases, embeddings, search, or information retrieval. * Experience optimizing AI systems for cost, latency, scalability, and reliability. * Experience working with government, defense, or intelligence agencies. * Experience with data analytics, predictive modeling, or user behavior analysis. * Experience taking an AI prototype from experimentation through production deployment. **To apply please submit:** * Resume * Cover Letter **Compensation:** The expected initial salary for this role is $125,000 \- $175,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, job\-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, certifications, geographic location, and organizational needs. Individual compensation will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis. In addition to base salary, Tesla Government offers a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, retirement savings options, paid time off, paid holidays, and professional development opportunities. *Tesla Government Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

jobs.title: Engineering Supervisor - Electrical
jobs.description: **Make a Difference Through Engineering** What if the products you helped design could help protect people and advance discoveries that improve lives? The Baker Company is looking for an experienced Electrical Engineering Supervisor who wants to put their engineering expertise toward work that has a positive purpose. In this role, you will lead a team of Electrical Engineers and Technicians while helping design, develop, and improve laboratory equipment used to create safer environments for scientists and support important research. This is more than an opportunity to manage an engineering team. It is an opportunity to **build something that helps others**. Our products help protect scientists from exposure to potentially hazardous materials, help prevent contamination, and support the research behind new medicines, treatments, and scientific discoveries. For nearly 75 years, The Baker Company has designed and manufactured innovative laboratory equipment in Sanford, Maine. Our work focuses on air containment, contamination control, and controlled environments—helping scientists do their jobs safely and effectively. The products we build are used in biological and pharmaceutical research around the world. **SUMMARY:** The Electrical Engineering Supervisor has responsibility for the management and technical direction for the Electrical team consisting of Engineers and Technicians. The supervisor provides technical direction in the development, implementation, revision, and enhancement of products in accordance with applicable codes and standards. The Supervisor is the primary leadership position for both day\-to\-day and long\-term management of the Electrical team including workload management, performance management, and personnel development. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Direct supervision of assigned employees including interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems. Assess staffing needs and make recommendations. * Lead the promotion of safety in the department and lead safety projects/activities. * Direct the activity of subordinates to correctly follow work instructions and procedures. Actively review procedures and determine key improvements within and across departments. Develop and implement plans for improvements. Understand ISO\-9001 structure and be able to represent department in internal and external audits. * Direct the activities of team members to focus on quality. Represent department at Customer Complaint meetings and facilitate issue resolution. * Assign work tasks and follow up for effectiveness. Monitor KPIs and communicate results to direct reports and internal customers. * Lead new process implementations and ensure compliance. * Participate in monthly cost center and project report\-outs. * Participate in annual budgeting process. * Prepare/direct the preparation of electrical engineering drawings, schematics, and standards. Knowledgeable and fluent with CAD systems. Possess a strong base of engineering technical knowledge. Understand regulatory standards, including applicable UL, CE, and regional requirements. * Coordinate ECRs. * Coordinate ERP/Configurator interactions. * Understand ERP for engineering, sales order configuration, case management. * Ensures the successful transition of new product concepts into commercialized products managed with a product lifecycle management and project management framework. * Works with development and commercial teams to pursue and maintain intellectual property including patents, trademarks, copy rights, trade secrets, etc. * Knowledge of Biosafety Cabinets, NSF, UL fluid flow, mechanical and electric subsystems. * Working knowledge of Lean concepts including 5\-S, Standard Work, Quick Changeover, Value Stream Mapping, etc. Lead Kaizen events. * Understand stage\-gate process and participate in task deliverables. * Manage projects and guide team members in Project Management. * Provide value to our customers by using and encouraging associates to use Lean tools and concepts to identify and eliminate waste in all forms (scrap/rework, transportation, motion, waiting, inventory, over production, over processing, and under\-utilization of people). * Reinforce associates’ awareness of keeping the customer’s end use and needs in mind with every task they do. * Other duties as assigned. **KEY PERFORMANCE METRICS:** * Sales Orders process time/lead time in Engineering * Change Requests (CR’s): * Process time/Lead time in Engineering * On time to the effectivity date of the CR * Engineering Requests via case calls (process time/lead time) **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Be able to sit at computer for extended periods of time. **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:** * B.S. Degree in Relevant Engineering discipline * Minimum of five (5\) years of experience as an Electrical Engineer preferred * Five (5\) years’ experience as a technical supervisor / manager required. * Strong leadership * Electrical Engineering experience with: + Motors + Machine control systems + Hardware \& Software development * Prior experience with intellectual property including reading and writing patents, understanding of trademarks, etc. a plus * Ability to effectively communicate with customers as well as at all levels of the company. * Working experience with Project Management methodologies. PMP certification a plus * Proficiency in MS project, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc. **BENEFITS:** * Medical * Dental * Company Paid Heath Reimbursement Account * Flexible Spending Accounts * 401(k) * Company Profit Sharing * Life \& Disability Insurances * Paid Time Off * And More! **Employment sponsorship and relocation are not offered.** **The salary range for this role is $100,000\-$110,000 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. The Baker Company considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.**

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing and delivering high‑impact, scalable software that simplifies complex processes, drives meaningful insights, and creates measurable value for our customers. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross‑functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field. * jobs.description: **Junior IT Configuration Technician (Entry\-Level)** **Location:** Westchester and Danbury, CT **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Salary:** Competitive and based on experience **Ready to Boot Up Your IT Career?** Are you the person who enjoys taking technology apart just to understand how it works? infrastructure technologies. **Learn, Grow \& Level Up** * Learn directly from senior engineers and technical specialists. * Participate in team projects and process improvement initiatives. * where your passions and strengths align. **The Kind of Person We're Looking For** * Passion for technology and a desire to build a long\-term career in IT. * Basic understanding of computer hardware, software, and networking concepts. * Familiarity with Windows, macOS, or Linux operating systems. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent communication skills and a positive, team\-oriented attitude. * Ability to follow instructions, stay organized, and pay attention to detail. * Willingness to travel throughout the Northeast as needed. * Eagerness to learn,
