jobs.title: CAD Designer - ASME
jobs.description: We are seeking a detail\-oriented CAD Designer / Drafter to support the ASME Outside Sourced Production (OSP) business by creating and maintaining accurate manufacturing drawings, models, bills of material, and controlled engineering documentation for pressure vessels and related products. This role reports to the Program Manager and works closely with the ASME Design Engineer, Project Manager, Quality, Sourcing, Operations, and external manufacturing partners. The CAD Designer will translate approved engineering requirements, customer specifications, and design inputs into clear, manufacturable SolidWorks models and drawings for carbon\- and stainless\-steel pressure vessels. The role will also support drawing release, revision control, supplier technical questions, PPAP and First Article Inspection documentation, and standardized drawing practices that enable the OSP model to scale efficiently. The ideal candidate is highly accurate, organized, and experienced in mechanical drafting for fabricated products. Success in this role requires strong SolidWorks capability, practical knowledge of manufacturing drawings and GD\&T, disciplined configuration control, and the ability to work effectively with engineers, quality teams, and outside fabricators. **Responsibilities** * Create and revise SolidWorks 3D models and detailed manufacturing drawings for pressure vessels, tanks, components, weldments, and assemblies. * Translate approved engineering calculations, customer specifications, sketches, redlines, and design inputs into accurate fabrication and assembly drawings under the direction of the ASME Design Engineer. * Develop and maintain bills of material, weld details, nozzle orientations, dimensions, tolerances, GD\&T, material callouts, and fabrication notes required for production. * Prepare customer approval drawings, shop drawings, supplier drawing packages, standard\-product drawings, and configured\-to\-order documentation for OSP projects. * Manage drawing revisions, engineering changes, redlines, as\-built updates, and document release requirements using established PDM/PLM and document\-control processes. * Coordinate with the Design Engineer, Project Manager, Quality, Sourcing, Operations, and OSP suppliers to resolve drawing questions and support on\-time technical releases. * Support design\-for\-manufacturing reviews by incorporating approved supplier feedback while maintaining design intent, code requirements, and controlled revisions. * Prepare ballooned drawings and support identification of critical characteristics, dimensional requirements, and inspection\-plan inputs for PPAP and First Article Inspection activities. * Partner with Quality to support inspection documentation, including dimensional layouts, inspection points, material requirements, weld/NDE notes, pressure\-test notes, and required production records. * Perform detailed drawing checks for completeness, dimensional consistency, BOM accuracy, drawing standards, revision status, and manufacturability before engineering approval and release. * Maintain and improve standard drawing templates, model libraries, weld details, title blocks, design tables, checklists, and other reusable engineering content that improves OSP speed and consistency. * Support continuous\-improvement and digital\-automation efforts, including configuration tools, drawing\-data standardization, and responsible use of AI\-enabled tools for documentation and checking while maintaining required human technical review. **Critical Skills, Knowledge \& Abilities** * Proficiency in SolidWorks for 3D modeling, assemblies, weldments, and production drawings is required. * Strong mechanical drafting skills and ability to create clear, complete, and manufacturable engineering drawings. * Working knowledge of GD\&T and engineering drawing practices; familiarity with ASME Y14\.5 preferred. * Ability to interpret engineering calculations, customer specifications, sketches, redlines, and technical requirements and accurately translate them into controlled drawings. * Understanding of welded fabrication, sheet\-metal and plate construction, formed heads, nozzles, flanges, machining, and pressure\-vessel manufacturing processes preferred. * Working knowledge of bills of material, part numbering, revision control, engineering change processes, and PDM/PLM document management. * Familiarity with ASME Section VIII pressure\-vessel drawing requirements preferred; exposure to applicable Sections II, V, and IX is a plus. * Knowledge of pressure\-vessel fabrication, materials, welding, NDE, pressure testing, and pipe/fitting geometry; familiarity with ASME B16\.5 (flanges), B16\.9 (buttweld fittings), and B1\.20\.1 (NPT threads) preferred. * Familiarity with PPAP, First Article Inspection, ballooned drawings, critical characteristics, and inspection\-plan creation preferred. * Strong attention to detail and ability to identify dimensional conflicts, missing requirements, drawing inconsistencies, and documentation gaps before release. * Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, quality personnel, project management, sourcing, operations, and external fabricators. * Practical problem\-solving skills and willingness to support supplier RFIs, drawing clarifications, deviations, and production issues within defined engineering authority. * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and digital engineering tools; experience with ERP, PDM/PLM, or document\-control systems preferred. * Digital fluency, including responsible use of generative AI and automation tools to improve documentation, standard work, drawing checks, and workflow efficiency while maintaining technical verification. * 5% travel required. **Desired Experience** * 2\-4 years of mechanical drafting, CAD design, or engineering\-design support experience using SolidWorks in a manufacturing environment. * Experience creating production drawings, assemblies, weldments, and bills of material for fabricated industrial equipment. * Experience with pressure vessels, tanks, welded fabrication, process equipment, or similar engineered products preferred. * Experience supporting engineers, manufacturing teams, suppliers, fabricators, or contract manufacturers through drawing release and production is preferred. * Experience supporting PPAP, First Article Inspection, ballooned drawings, inspection plans, or quality documentation is preferred. * Experience managing engineering changes, drawing revisions, controlled documents, and as\-built updates preferred. * Experience with PDM/PLM, ERP, quality, or engineering document\-control systems preferred; exposure to ASME or other compliance\-driven manufacturing environments is a plus. **Education \& Training** * Associate degree, technical diploma, or certificate in CAD, drafting, mechanical design, engineering technology, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered. * SolidWorks certification or formal GD\&T training is preferred. Our Company is proud to have a dynamic and inclusive workforce where employees are empowered to innovate, thrive and grow. We believe that each employee’s unique strengths contribute to the success of our organization. This belief extends to how we consider our job applicants. Your talents may align with this position or other opportunities within our organization. Apply today to start unlocking your career potential with Worthington Enterprises. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in the application and hiring process. If you are interested in employment with Worthington Enterprises and need an accommodation or assistance using the careers website, please contact careers@wthg.com. Worthington Enterprises (NYSE: WOR) is a designer and manufacturer of market\-leading brands that help improve everyday life by elevating spaces and experiences. The Company operates with two primary business units: Building Products and Consumer Products. The Building Products segment includes cooking, heating, cooling and water solutions, architectural and acoustical grid ceilings and metal framing and accessories. The Consumer Products segment provides solutions for the tools, outdoor living and celebrations categories. Product brands within the Worthington Enterprises portfolio include Balloon Time®, Bernzomatic®, Coleman® (propane cylinders), CoMet®, Elgen, Garden Weasel®, General®, HALO™, Hawkeye™, Level5 Tools®, Mag Torch®, NEXI™, Pactool International®, PowerCore™, Ragasco®, Well\-X\-Trol® and XLite™, among others. Founded in 1955 as Worthington Industries, Worthington Enterprises follows a people\-first Philosophy with earning money for its shareholders as its first corporate goal. jobs.title: Project Engineer - ASME

The ASME Project Engineer will own code\-compliant calculations, SolidWorks models and drawings, technical supplier support, and engineering validation for carbon\- and stainless\-steel pressure vessels. The role will also support PPAP, First Article Inspection, inspection planning, and disposition of supplier technical issues. The ideal candidate combines strong mechanical design fundamentals with practical pressure\-vessel manufacturing knowledge. Success requires sound engineering judgment, working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, disciplined drawing/configuration control, and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear manufacturing and quality expectations. **Responsibilities** * Own technical execution of ASME OSP projects from quotation through design release, supplier build, First Article Inspection, and production support. * Perform and review ASME Section VIII, Division 1 calculations for shell/head thickness, MAWP, MDMT, nozzle reinforcement, external pressure, openings, and applicable components. calculations; support CFD/FEA analysis for complex structural, thermal, or flow conditions as required. * Provide technical input to quotations, including design assumptions, materials, code requirements, manufacturability, technical risks, and supplier capability. * Lead design\-for\-manufacturing reviews with OSP suppliers for forming, welding, machining, NDE, inspection, testing, and material handling. * Review and disposition supplier RFIs, deviations, substitutions, drawing comments, and NCRs in coordination with Quality and Operations. * Support PPAP and First Article Inspection through ballooned drawings, critical characteristics, inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and first\-article review. * Partner with Quality to define dimensional inspection, material traceability, weld/NDE, pressure\-test, certification, and final documentation requirements. * Ensure designs comply with ASME Section VIII and applicable Sections II, V, and IX, customer specifications, and internal standards. * Support root\-cause analysis and corrective actions; incorporate lessons learned into drawings, standards, and future designs. * Maintain controlled calculations, drawings, revisions, approvals, and design history; develop standards and templates that improve OSP scalability. **Critical Skills, Knowledge \& Abilities** * Proficiency in SolidWorks for 3D modeling and production drawings is required. * Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Division 1 pressure\-vessel design requirements and calculations. * Experience with Mathcad and COMPRESS preferred; familiarity with Comsal for CFD and FEA analysis methods/tools preferred. * Strong understanding of GD\&T and engineering drawing practices; ASME Y14\.5 knowledge preferred. * Knowledge of pressure\-vessel fabrication, materials, forming, welding, machining, NDE, and pressure testing. * Ability to perform, review, and document mechanical design calculations with clear assumptions and engineering judgment. * Ability to translate customer specifications and code requirements into manufacturable drawings and supplier requirements. * Experience with design\-for\-manufacturing and technical collaboration with fabricators or contract manufacturers. * Familiarity with PPAP, First Article Inspection, ballooned drawings, critical characteristics, and inspection\-plan development preferred. * Familiarity with ASME Sections II, V, and IX quality/documentation requirements, including materials, NDE, welding qualification, and traceability, preferred. * Practical problem\-solving skills, including evaluation of deviations, NCRs, root cause, and corrective actions. * Strong communication and ability to work across engineering, quality, sourcing, operations, project management, customers, and suppliers. * Digital fluency, including Microsoft 365 and responsible use of generative AI to improve requirements review, documentation, standardization, and workflow efficiency while maintaining technical verification. * Up to 25% travel required. **Desired Experience** * 3\-5 years of mechanical or design engineering experience in pressure vessels, tanks, welded fabrication, or related industrial equipment, including hands\-on SolidWorks production drawings. * Experience performing or reviewing ASME Section VIII, Division 1 pressure\-vessel calculations. * Experience with Mathcad, COMPRESS, and/or CFD/FEA analysis tools preferred. * Experience working with suppliers, fabricators, contract manufacturers, or outside manufacturing partners preferred. * Experience with PPAP, First Article Inspection, inspection planning, and ASME quality documentation such as material, weld, NDE, pressure\-test, and code records preferred. * Experience supporting products from quotation and design release through manufacturing, inspection, and production launch preferred. * Experience with ERP, PDM/PLM, quality, or engineering document\-control systems preferred. **Education \& Training** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline required. * Formal training or demonstrated working knowledge of ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code Section VIII preferred. Responsibilities include teaching, advising students, scholarly or creative work and department and university service. Actual assignments will depend upon department needs. **About the position:** ======================= Based upon expertise of the successful applicant, primary responsibilities will include teaching lecture and laboratory\-based courses such as: Production Materials \& Processes, Processing Metallic Materials, Processing Nonmetallic Materials, Polymer and Ceramic Technology, Automated Manufacturing (CAD/CAM), Machine Tool Design, Statics and Strength of Materials, Technical Entrepreneurship, and related applied engineering courses. jobs.title: Director, Substation & Grid Engineering
jobs.description: . **About Nscale** NScale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost\-effective, high\-performance infrastructure for AI start\-ups and large enterprise customers. NScale enables AI\-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility. At NScale, our Design and Construction team plays a critical role in delivering data center facilities that are optimized for AI deployments. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an NScaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future **About the Role** * We are looking for a Director of Substation \& Grid Engineering to lead substation and grid engineering design for NScale's data center portfolio. * This leader will own technical standards for substations, transformers, switchgear, and protection schemes supporting high\-density AI/GPU workloads. * You will own load and generator interconnection applications and studies, serving as the technical lead on interconnection requests to utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and transmission owners. * You will provide technical support to the Utility Development and Power Procurement organizations on interconnection, grid, and substation topics. * You will lead a team of Staff Engineers delivering substation and grid engineering design. **What You'll be Doing (Responsibilities)** **Engineering Design \& Standards** * Define technical requirements and design standards for substations, transformers, switchgear, protection, and metering. * Collaborate with internal and external design teams on one\-line diagrams, protection schemes, and redundancy strategies (N, N\+1, 2N). * Oversee fault and reliability studies supporting substation and grid design. * Define electrical topology and one\-line requirements for on\-site generation integration, including paralleling, synchronization, islanding, and black\-start concepts. * Establish protection and controls philosophy for generation integration (relaying, coordination, fault duty, grounding, synchronization, load sharing). * Guide equipment specification for generator sets, switchgear, transformers, e\-houses, and balance\-of\-plant, accounting for long\-lead risk. **Load \& Generator Interconnection** * Own the preparation, submission, and technical management of load and generator interconnection applications to utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and transmission owners across the portfolio. * Lead interconnection studies (feasibility, system impact, facilities studies) for both load interconnection and on\-site/behind\-the\-meter generation, tracking queue positions and study timelines. * Serve as the primary technical point of contact with utility and ISO/RTO interconnection engineering teams, resolving technical issues raised during study review. * Coordinate interconnection agreement technical exhibits (one\-lines, protection requirements, metering, telemetry) in partnership with Legal and Energy Procurement. * Track interconnection queue risk and grid upgrade requirements, escalating schedule or cost impacts to the VP of Power Infrastructure Design and affected project teams. **Team Leadership** * Lead and develop a team of Staff Engineers supporting substation and grid engineering. * Review technical designs and ensure quality and consistency across projects. * Support career development and technical growth of engineering staff. **Project Support** * Serve as the substation and grid engineering owner for data center projects from design through energization. * Visit sites as needed to support commissioning, troubleshooting, and design clarifications. * Identify and mitigate technical risks related to substation and grid design. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Utility Development and AI Load Power Strategy teams to align substation design with utility and load requirements. * Provide technical support to the Utility Development organization on interconnection processes, grid capacity assessments, and site diligence for new and existing markets. * Provide technical support to the Power Procurement organization on interconnection timelines, technical risk, and grid constraints that affect power supply agreements and market strategy. * Communicate technical design trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders. **About You (Skills / Qualifications)** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * 8\-12\+ years of experience in substation design, protection and controls, or grid engineering. * Strong ability to interpret and produce electrical one\-lines, protection schemes, and system studies. * Demonstrated success leading or mentoring engineering teams. * Direct experience preparing and managing load and/or generator interconnection applications with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, or transmission owners. * Ability to serve as a technical resource to commercial and development teams (e.g., Utility Development, Power Procurement) on interconnection and grid topics. **Preferred** * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems. * Professional Engineer (PE) license. * Experience with high\-density AI/GPU or HPC data center substation design. * Experience with generator OEMs, EPCs, and commissioning providers for large\-scale standby/prime power plants. * Experience navigating interconnection queues and study processes in multiple ISO/RTO markets. **Equal Opportunities Statement** At NScale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ\+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio\-economic backgrounds. If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. *The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.* *For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.* *Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.*

jobs.title: Backend Engineer III - Growth
jobs.description: ### **ABOUT onX** We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further. We’re a high\-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt \- continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver. Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals \- Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish \- is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most. We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact. Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access. ### **ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY** onX is seeking a Backend Engineer with a passion for building reliable, well\-tested backend services that solve user problems. Your focus will be on the shared platform infrastructure behind content experimentation, event tracking, and app\-start fidelity. You will be a part of our Growth Infrastructure team, a horizontal platform team that supports Growth engineering across all of onX's verticals (Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, Fish). This is a great opportunity to be a part of a dynamic, growing company focused on making an impact on the business, and to build infrastructure that other Growth teams rely on directly. This role will serve as a core backend contributor at onX and will report to the Growth Infrastructure Engineering Manager. ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ***Essential Job Duties \& Functions*** * Build and maintain scalable services supporting Growth Infrastructure initiatives, including content experimentation and event tracking * Write unit, integration, and acceptance tests * Participate in architectural discussions and contribute design proposals for our services * Collaborate effectively with other engineers, PMs, and cross\-functional stakeholders (mobile, BI, marketing) * Leverage and extend existing onX services rather than reinventing them * Proactively identify and use AI workflows that increase velocity while not degrading quality. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to support backend services after work hours ### **WHAT YOU’LL BRING** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, primarily in API development, is required * A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX's Company Values * Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX * Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp ### **ADDED BONUSES** Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following: * Experience with Go or similar backend languages * Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure\-as\-code technologies such as Terraform * Familiarity with a major cloud platform (Google Cloud Platform preferred) * Exposure to A/B testing or experimentation platforms (e.g., Eppo) ### **THE ONX EXPERIENCE** onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration. While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start\-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change. Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership \- they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges. ### **WHERE YOU CAN WORK** onX has created a thriving distributed workforce designed to foster connection, collaboration, and shared experience across several US locations. We have two HQ locations in Bozeman and Missoula, MT and established virtual workforce Basecamps in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. ### **HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED** onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $130,000 to $153,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full\-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and a potential annual bonus of 10% based on company performance. ### **WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU** * Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth * Comprehensive health benefits, including a no\-monthly\-cost medical plan * Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non\-birthing parents * 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3\-5% * Company\-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks * Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle * Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays ### **PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS** In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem\-solving, essential for our computer\-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com. **Position open until filled.** **\#LI\-Remote** **At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger.** By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us! onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt\-out if preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Remote
jobs.description: **About Valency** ================= Valency Systems is a small, dynamic team of engineers, scientists, and researchers building the global hub for the agentic research era. We're based in Berkeley, California, and we're building something that matters. If you care about open science, advancing research at the speed of thought, and using AI to accelerate discovery, we'd love to talk. **About the Role** ================== We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who will report to the Head of Engineering. This person thrives deep in the codebase, raises the bar for everyone around them, and ships work that stands the test of time. You'll be a trusted voice in architectural decisions, a go\-to resource for hard problems, and a mentor to the engineers around you, all while staying deeply hands\-on. Your foundation is backend systems: designing APIs people love to work with, building infrastructure that doesn't wake anyone up at 3am, and making data models that make sense six months later. You know how to make thoughtful trade\-offs under pressure, and you leave every system better than you found it. **What You'll Do** ================== **Backend Engineering** ----------------------- * Design, build, and own critical backend services — APIs, data pipelines, async workers, and the infrastructure that keeps them running reliably at scale * Make sound architectural decisions and document trade\-offs clearly so the whole team can learn from them * Drive platform and reliability investments alongside feature work — the foundational improvements that keep pace with growth * Establish and uphold high standards for code quality, test coverage, and operational excellence * Diagnose and resolve complex performance, reliability, and scalability issues; conduct thorough post\-mortems that prevent recurrence **Distributed Systems \& Infrastructure** ----------------------------------------- * Design and maintain distributed systems that are resilient to failure — applying patterns like circuit breakers, retries, idempotency, and rate limiting where they count * Own the full lifecycle of services from design through deployment, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure * Implement and iterate on observability practices: structured logging, metrics dashboards, distributed tracing, and alerting * Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code practices (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and cloud cost optimization **Data \& Integrations** ------------------------ * Design performant, well\-normalized data models across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and non\-relational (Redis, MongoDB, DynamoDB) stores * Build and maintain data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and integrations with third\-party services and external APIs * Apply caching strategies thoughtfully — CDN, in\-memory, and application\-level — and understand the failure modes of each * Work with message queues and event streaming platforms (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ) to build decoupled, async architectures **Security \& Compliance** -------------------------- * Apply secure coding practices by default: input validation, secrets management, least\-privilege access, and protection against common vulnerabilities * Contribute to compliance efforts (SOC 2, GDPR, or similar) with an understanding of how engineering decisions affect data privacy and auditability **Technical Leadership** ------------------------ * Be the go\-to engineer for hard problems — unblock teammates, provide crisp technical direction, and raise the quality of design reviews * Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through code review, pairing, and direct, constructive feedback * Write architecture decision records (ADRs) and technical documentation that outlast the original project * Partner with Product and Design to scope work realistically, surface constraints early, and deliver with clarity * Represent engineering in cross\-functional conversations and earn influence through execution, not hierarchy **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Required** * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in backend systems — APIs, databases, distributed architectures, and cloud infrastructure * Strong command of at least one backend language (Python, Go, Java, Rust, or similar) and comfort working across major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) * Hands\-on experience with relational databases (schema design, query optimization, indexing) and familiarity with non\-relational or caching layers * Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines * Demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex, ambiguous projects end\-to\-end with minimal supervision * Track record of mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction without formal authority * Clear, direct communication — you can explain a hard trade\-off to an engineer and a product manager alike ### **Nice to Have** * Experience working in a startup environment — you've built and scaled systems while the business was growing rapidly underneath them, worn multiple hats, and thrived in ambiguity * Experience with our stack or adjacent: Node.js/TypeScript, AWS Lambda/CDK/Step Functions, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare * Familiarity with auth systems (e.g. OAuth) and observability tooling * Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Temporal, Airflow, Prefect) and async job processing at scale * Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and cloud cost management **What Makes Someone Exceptional Here** --------------------------------------- This role rewards engineers who think in systems — who aren't satisfied shipping a feature that works today if it'll break at 10x scale. You're someone who: * Has deep backend instincts: clean data models, well\-designed APIs, observable services, and resilient failure modes * Leaves code, documentation, and systems measurably better than you found them * Brings a product mindset: you understand why you're building something, not just how * Earns trust through execution, not hierarchy — your opinion carries weight because of what you've shipped * Thrives in the ambiguity of a fast\-moving company and knows when to move fast vs. when to slow down and get it right * Could step into a management role if needed, but genuinely prefers to stay in the code and go deeper **Why Join Us** --------------- * Meaningful backend challenges on a product that's growing fast and reaching real users * A small, high\-trust team where your decisions have outsized impact * A culture that values engineering excellence and invests seriously in the people who drive it **Compensation, Benefits \& Equity** We offer a competitive salary, benefits, and meaningful equity in a company building something important from the ground up.

jobs.title: Field Operations Manager
jobs.description: Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person's daily commute to reducing humanity's collective environmental footprint — we've got huge goals. Via has partnered with 100\+ cities and public transit agencies around the world to deploy our mobility technology. As a **Field Manager** on Via's Transit\-as\-a\-Service (TaaS) Operations team, you'll be responsible for managing operations using our innovative technology platform. You'll manage daily operations while driving continuous improvement and growth of our services. **\*\*This is a fully in\-person position with the expectation that you will be onsite 4\-5 days per week\*\*** **What You'll Do:** * Ensure operational excellence and an unbelievable customer experience * Oversee operations in person, the business needs may dictate a need for early mornings or evenings at times * Manage driver supply to ensure the appropriate amount of vehicles are in service at any given time to meet demand expectations * Prioritize operational issues as the real\-time point of contact and implement creative solutions to solve problems as they arise * Respond to driver feedback and live customer issues * Diligently work collaboratively with a broad interdisciplinary team to scale operational processes, systems, and tools to drive rapid growth * Analyze, interpret metrics/KPIs in order to identify possible inefficiencies and apply analysis to optimize operations. **Who You Are:** * A socially perceptive, environmentally conscious individual who is aligned with promoting transportation equity and the reduction of carbon emissions. * A self\-starter who is comfortable taking on a high level of responsibility * A driven executor with a track record of end to end ownership of a book of business, and a history of hitting KPIs and revenue goals. * A team\-focused individual that takes ownership of their work and pride in their team's success. * Experienced in project management, creating and refining operational processes, and customer service. Multi\-site management experience is a plus. * An outgoing and sociable leader; skilled at communicating professionally with partners, customers and driver partners from a broad range of backgrounds. * Willing to wear multiple hats and contribute on projects of all types * Fluent in English, additional languages a plus * Experienced in managing (including scheduling) a team is a plus * Taking initiative and owning new projects * Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving / adapting as conditions change * Experienced in managing projects with multiple stakeholders is a plus * Bachelor's degree is a plus **Compensation and Benefits:** * Final salary will be determined by the candidate's experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable * Salary Range: $65,000 \- $75,000 * We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching. We're Via, and we build technology that changes the way the world moves. We're driven by a simple mission: to create modern and efficient public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. With our best in class suite of products, we make transit thrive.
